meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí xià. Placed after an action verb to make a request or suggestion sound casual and brief (看一下, 等一下).

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí gòng. Sums up items or prices before the verb or number (一共十二块 'twelve yuan in total').

examples.text: 在这儿！一共三十八块，找回十二块零钱。
examples.trans: Right here! Thirty-eight yuan in total, with twelve yuan back in change.

examples.text: 四杯红茶一共二十八块钱。
examples.trans: Four cups of black tea come to twenty-eight yuan in total.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí kè. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一刻钟 ('a quarter-hour').

examples.text: 快跑吧，小晴。四号房七点一刻就醒！
examples.trans: Run fast, Qing. Room four wakes up at a quarter past seven!

examples.text: 现在是八点一刻，早餐刚开始。
examples.trans: It is a quarter past eight right now, and breakfast has just begun.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí bàn. Combines 一 ('one') + 半 ('half'); note yī shifts to yí before 4th-tone bàn.

examples.text: 这壶热茶我们已经喝了一半。
examples.trans: We have already drunk half of this pot of hot tea.

examples.text: 第二页乐谱有一半还没有写完。
examples.trans: Half of the second page of sheet music is still unfinished.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí dìng. Expresses strong certainty or a warm, firm promise (请一定写下来).

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 一定转达！请慢用。
examples.trans: I certainly will! Please enjoy your meal.

meanings.en: completely; down to the last drop
meanings.note: Pinyin: yì gān èr jìng. Vivid four-character idiom ('clean and spotless').

examples.text: 他上楼之前把蔬菜汤喝得一干二净。
examples.trans: Before going upstairs, he drank every last drop of the vegetable soup.

examples.text: 小猫把碟子里的温牛奶舔得一干二净。
examples.trans: The kitten licked every last drop of warm milk from the saucer.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì nián nián. Reduplicated time phrase 一 + 年年 ('year after year'); yī shifts to yì before 2nd-tone nián.

examples.text: 一年年过去，院子里的老树长得越来越高。
examples.trans: Year after year passed, and the old tree in the courtyard grew taller and taller.

examples.text: 那本旧相册记下了客栈一年年的变化。
examples.trans: That old photo album recorded the inn's changes year after year.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí yàng. Pairs with 跟/和 in 跟…一样 ('the same as…').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 哎呀！我跑得太急，包装看着都一样！
examples.trans: Oh no! I was running in such a rush that the wrappers all looked alike!

meanings.en: completely identical; cast from the same mold
meanings.note: Pinyin: yì mú yí yàng. Note second-tone mú here ('one mold, one look').

examples.text: 外面一模一样，可是你看里面！
examples.trans: The outside is identical, yet look inside!

examples.text: 咬一口……志豪，闭上眼睛！跟梧桐巷的味道一模一样！
examples.trans: One bite... Zhihao, close your eyes! It tastes identical to Wutong Lane!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì diǎn. Before a noun, means 'a little bit of' (一点糖); after an adjective, 'a bit more' (快一点).

examples.text: 只有一点点牛奶、两个鸡蛋，一点黄油都没有！
examples.trans: Only a tiny bit of milk, two eggs, and no butter at all!

examples.text: 太好了！请加牛奶和一点糖。
examples.trans: Wonderful! With milk and a little sugar, please.

meanings.en: a tiny bit; just a little
meanings.note: Pinyin: yì dián diǎn. Affectionate reduplication stressing how small an amount is.

examples.text: 只有一点点牛奶、两个鸡蛋，一点黄油都没有！
examples.trans: Only a tiny bit of milk, two eggs, and no butter at all!

examples.text: 我的红茶里只加一点点蜂蜜就够了。
examples.trans: Just a tiny bit of honey in my black tea is plenty.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì zhí. Describes walking straight (一直走) or doing something non-stop.

examples.text: 出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
examples.trans: Go out the front gate, turn left, and walk straight to the stone bridge.

examples.text: 志豪先生！您一直站在后面吗？！
examples.trans: Mr Zhihao! Were you standing right there behind us?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí shùn jiān. Combines 一 ('one') + 瞬间 ('blink of an eye / instant'); yī shifts to yí before 4th-tone shùn.

examples.text: 闪电在一瞬间照亮了整个院子。
examples.trans: Lightning lit up the entire courtyard in a split second.

examples.text: 门打开的那一瞬间，大家都笑了。
examples.trans: The instant the door opened, everyone smiled.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì qǐ. Placed right before the verb to mean 'together' (一起吃晚饭 'have dinner together').

examples.text: 晚上九点？你站这儿，我们一起去开门。
examples.trans: Nine in the evening? Stay right here; let us go open the gate together.

examples.text: 等等，让我把平板屏幕和纸本子放一起看。
examples.trans: Wait—let me look at the tablet screen and the paper ledger side by side.

meanings.en: all the way; the whole journey
meanings.note: Pinyin: yí lù. Used in travel wishes and descriptions of a trip.

examples.text: 二十毫米、铜的、热水器阀门——我一路念过去！
examples.trans: Twenty millimetres, brass, water-heater valve—I will repeat it all the way!

examples.text: 祝您今天一路平安！
examples.trans: Wishing you a safe journey all the way today!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì biān. Combines 一 ('one') + 边 ('side'); yī shifts to yì before 1st-tone biān.

examples.text: 请把湿雨伞放在门口的一边。
examples.trans: Please put the wet umbrella to one side of the doorway.

examples.text: 墙上的旧照片稍微歪向了一边。
examples.trans: The old photo on the wall leaned slightly to one side.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qī. Cardinal number 7; combines with 月 for July and 点 for seven o'clock.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān. Cardinal number 3; combines with measure words (三个) and floors (三楼).

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 三瓶牛奶、二十个鸡蛋、黄油、奶酪和红苹果！
examples.trans: Three bottles of milk, twenty eggs, butter, cheese, and red apples!

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān shí. Cardinal number thirty ('three tens'); pairs directly with measure words like 三十年 ('thirty years').

examples.text: 这棵老树在院子里长了三十年。
examples.trans: This old tree has grown in the courtyard for thirty years.

examples.text: 从客栈走到地铁站只要三十分钟。
examples.trans: Walking from the inn to the metro station takes only thirty minutes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng. Used both as a directional verb/complement ('up, onto') and location word ('on top of').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng qù. Compound directional complement showing upward motion away from the speaker.

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

examples.text: 好。端上去之前，在上面撒这些新鲜绿香草。
examples.trans: Good. Before serving them, sprinkle these fresh green herbs on top.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng zhōu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 上一周 ('the previous week').

examples.text: 上周刚换了新灯泡，有干净肥皂和热水。
examples.trans: Put in a new bulb last week, with clean soap and plenty of hot water.

examples.text: 从那个星期天起我们再也没说话。上周我给他寄了一张明信片。
examples.trans: Since that Sunday we have not spoken again. Last week I mailed him a postcard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng fāng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 正上方 ('the space right above').

examples.text: 门上方只画着一把金色钥匙。拿旧阀门给店员看。
examples.trans: Only a golden key painted above the door. Show the clerk the old valve.

examples.text: 书桌上方挂着一盏暖黄色的灯。
examples.trans: A warm yellow lamp hangs directly above the desk.

related.gloss: the space right above (measure word 个)

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng zhuō. Verb-object compound 上 ('go onto') + 桌 ('table'): used for dishes brought out ready to eat.

examples.text: 热汤一做好就可以马上端上桌。
examples.trans: As soon as the hot soup is ready, it can be served onto the table right away.

examples.text: 刚出炉的热面包很快就上桌了。
examples.trans: The freshly baked warm bread was soon brought to the table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng lóu. Verb-object compound meaning 'climb/go to an upper floor'.

examples.text: 先生，上楼之前，我要诚恳跟您道个歉。
examples.trans: Sir, before going upstairs, I owe you an honest apology.

examples.text: 他上楼之前把蔬菜汤喝得一干二净。
examples.trans: Before going upstairs, he drank every last drop of the vegetable soup.

meanings.en: go to work; start one's shift
meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng bān. Everyday verb-object compound; opposite is 下班 ('get off work').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第二天上班，干得不错，新手。
examples.trans: For day two on the job, nicely done, rookie.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng kè. Used by both students and teachers for having a lesson.

examples.text: 快请坐，宋老师！千万别说我上课迟到了二十五年！
examples.trans: Please sit down, Teacher Song! Tell me I am not twenty-five years late for my lesson!

examples.text: 孩子们每天早上八点开始上课。
examples.trans: The children start class at eight every morning.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最上面 ('the very top').

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

examples.text: 上面有名字或者电话号码吗？
examples.trans: Is there a name or a phone number on it?

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià. Used for downward motion ('go down'), location ('under'), or 'next' (下周).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià wǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个下午 ('an afternoon').

examples.text: 您尽管看，宋老师。星期一下午大堂暗。
examples.trans: Go right ahead, Teacher Song. Monday afternoon the lobby was dim.

examples.text: 先别对外面透露一个字！让两兄弟先过完这个星期五下午！
examples.trans: Not a single word to anyone outside yet! Let the two brothers have their Friday afternoon first!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià qù. Compound directional complement 下 ('down') + 去 ('away from speaker'), often attached after action verbs like 按下去 ('press down').

examples.text: 把开关轻轻按下去，走廊的灯就亮了。
examples.trans: Press the switch gently down and the hallway light comes on.

examples.text: 如果雨一直下下去，我们就在屋里喝茶。
examples.trans: If the rain keeps coming down, we will drink tea indoors.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià zhōu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 下一周 ('the coming week').

examples.text: 下周我保证把半个市政厅的同事都带来小美这儿喝咖啡。
examples.trans: Next week I promise to bring half my City Hall colleagues to Mei's tables.

examples.text: 下周二我要去成都出差。
examples.trans: Next Tuesday I am going to Chengdu on business.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià lái. Compound directional complement for downward motion or writing something down to keep.

examples.text: 快问他叫什么名字！记下来！
examples.trans: Quick, ask him what his name is! Write it down!

examples.text: 请一定写下来！三楼热水：满分十分！
examples.trans: Please be sure to write that down! Third-floor hot water: ten out of ten!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià lóu. Verb-object compound for heading down to a lower floor.

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

examples.text: 我手表七点二十九分。客人下楼了。
examples.trans: Seven twenty-nine on my watch. Guests are coming down the stairs.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià cì. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 下一次 ('the next occasion').

examples.text: 下次来成都，一定再来住我们客栈！
examples.trans: Next time you come to Chengdu, be sure to stay at our inn again!

examples.text: 今天聊得很开心，我们下次见！
examples.trans: It was lovely chatting today—see you next time!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià yǔ. Literally 'fall rain'; Mandarin expresses weather with verb + weather noun.

examples.text: 下雨的时候，纸不会弄丢房间名单。
examples.trans: When it rains, paper will not lose the room list.

examples.text: 每次弹完琴，他都问为什么下雨天钢琴声音更暖。
examples.trans: Whenever I finished playing, he asked why the piano sounded warmer on rainy days.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最下面 ('the bottom part').

examples.text: 快拿到楼下灯光下面看看吧！
examples.trans: Let's bring it downstairs under the light and take a look!

examples.text: 志豪先生早！在木房梁下面睡得好吗？
examples.trans: Morning, Mr Zhihao! Did you sleep well beneath the wooden beams?

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Standard negation for present/future/habitual verbs and adjectives; shifts to bú before a 4th tone (不是 bú shì).

examples.text: 下雨的时候，纸不会弄丢房间名单。
examples.trans: When it rains, paper will not lose the room list.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

meanings.en: excuse me; sorry to bother you; shy
meanings.note: Pinyin: bù hǎo yì si. Polite everyday softener for minor apologies or getting someone's attention.

examples.text: 晚上好。不好意思，把干净地板弄湿了。
examples.trans: Good evening. Sorry for getting your clean floor wet.

examples.text: 打扰一下，志豪先生？不好意思这么晚敲门。
examples.trans: Excuse me, Mr Zhihao? Sorry to knock so late.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù rú. Compares two options ('not equal to / less than'), or introduces a suggestion ('might as well').

examples.text: 坐公交车去集市还不如走路快。
examples.trans: Taking the bus to the market is not even as fast as walking.

examples.text: 今天风大，我们不如坐在屋子里喝茶。
examples.trans: It is windy today; we might as well sit indoors and drink tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù xiǎo xīn. Literally 'not careful'; placed before a verb to mean 'by accident / inadvertently'.

examples.text: 我刚才不小心把水洒在桌子上了。
examples.trans: I accidentally spilled water on the table just now.

examples.text: 他没戴眼镜，不小心看错了日期。
examples.trans: Without his glasses, he accidentally misread the date.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù shǎo. Litotes literally meaning 'not few', i.e. 'quite a lot of / plenty of'.

examples.text: 星期六早上有不少邻居来买热面包。
examples.trans: Quite a few neighbours come to buy warm bread on Saturday morning.

examples.text: 打折以后，我们省下了不少零钱。
examples.trans: After the discount, we saved plenty of spare change.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bú shì. In 不是……吗？, forms a rhetorical question ('didn't you...? / isn't it...?'); bù shifts to bú before 4th-tone shì.

examples.text: 你不是说今天下午要去集市吗？
examples.trans: Didn't you say you were going to the market this afternoon?

examples.text: 那把钥匙不是一直放在抽屉里吗？
examples.trans: Hasn't that key been in the drawer all along?

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù rán. Links a warning or alternative ('otherwise…').

examples.text: 快去跟他聊聊，小晴，不然木地板都要踩破了！
examples.trans: Go talk to him quickly, Qing, or he will wear right through the wooden floorboards!

examples.text: 快带上雨伞吧，不然会淋湿的。
examples.trans: Bring an umbrella quickly, otherwise you will get soaked.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù néng. Modal negation expressing inability or prohibition ('cannot / must not'); bù stays 4th tone before 2nd-tone néng.

examples.text: 油漆还没干，现在不能坐在椅子上。
examples.trans: The paint is not dry yet, so you cannot sit on the chairs right now.

examples.text: 修电线的时候千万不能开总开关。
examples.trans: You must not turn on the main switch while repairing electrical wires.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bú guò. Gentle conversational 'though / however', softer than 但是.

examples.text: 很安静，谢谢，不过这个行李箱今天特别重。
examples.trans: Very quiet, thank you, though this suitcase feels especially heavy today.

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bú cuò. Warm everyday praise meaning 'really quite good!'.

examples.text: 第二天上班，干得不错，新手。
examples.trans: For day two on the job, nicely done, rookie.

examples.text: 这家小店的红茶味道真不错。
examples.trans: The black tea at this little shop tastes really good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuān yè. Describes skilled, professional work or a field of study.

examples.text: 别瞒了，小晴，我们很专业！先生，我们敬重成都旅游指南！
examples.trans: No hiding it, Qing, let's be professional! Sir, we respect the Chengdu Travel Guide!

examples.text: 他的声学测量工具非常专业。
examples.trans: His acoustic measuring tools are very professional.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōng xi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个东西 ('a thing / item').

examples.text: 深呼吸，周经理。还没人写任何东西呢。
examples.trans: Take a deep breath, Manager Zhou. Nobody has written anything yet.

examples.text: 白纸里面包的东西是给我哥哥志鹏的，不是我的。
examples.trans: What is wrapped inside that white paper is for my brother Zhipeng, not mine.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sī dài. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条丝带 ('a ribbon').

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

examples.text: 我的行李箱！快打开上面口袋……对，红丝带！
examples.trans: My suitcase! Let me open the top pocket... yes, the red ribbon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: diū. Often follows a verb as a result complement (弄丢 'lose by accident').

examples.text: 下雨的时候，纸不会弄丢房间名单。
examples.trans: When it rains, paper will not lose the room list.

examples.text: 我以为卖房子时早就丢了！为什么一直替我留着？
examples.trans: I thought it was lost long ago when we sold the house! Why keep it for me?

meanings.note: Pinyin: liǎng. Used instead of 二 when counting things with a measure word (两个, 两把, 两间).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yán zhòng. Describes serious problems or damage.

examples.text: 比水管严重……中午房东寄来了一封挂号信。
examples.trans: Worse than a pipe... at noon a registered letter arrived from the landlord.

examples.text: 好在漏水不严重，很快就能修好。
examples.trans: Thankfully the leak is not serious and can be fixed soon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè. Most common Mandarin measure word (量词), placed between a number/demonstrative and a noun (一个人, 这个).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè rén. Describes personal items or individual matters.

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

examples.text: 请带好您的个人随身物品。
examples.trans: Please remember your personal belongings.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 高个子 ('a tall build').

examples.text: 我手在发抖——车上下来穿深灰色外套的高个子男人吗？
examples.trans: My hands are shaking—is a tall man in a dark grey coat stepping out?

examples.text: 高个子，深灰色外套，正抬头看我们客栈招牌呢！
examples.trans: Tall, dark grey coat, looking up at our inn sign right now!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个中心 ('a center').

examples.text: 我梦想中的咖啡馆——就在自家院子里！等我去告诉市场老板们！
examples.trans: My dream café—right in our own courtyard! Wait until I tell the market stall owners!

examples.text: 这是我人生中最棒的第一周！
examples.trans: This is the best first week of my whole life!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng wǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个中午 ('a noon hour').

examples.text: 先生？他说：请别打开白纸包，我星期五中午来。
examples.trans: Sir? He says: Please do not open the white paper parcel; I will come Friday at noon.

examples.text: 等星期五中午箱子主人进来，我一定坐第一排看！
examples.trans: When the suitcase owner walks in Friday at noon, I am sitting in the front row!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng yāng. Compound 中 ('middle') + 央 ('center'); also used in music for the middle register (中央八度 'middle octave').

examples.text: 院子中央摆着一张干净的木头圆桌。
examples.trans: A clean round wooden table stands in the center of the courtyard.

examples.text: 请把手放在钢琴键盘的中央。
examples.trans: Please place your hands at the center of the piano keyboard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng jiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 正中间 ('the exact middle').

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

examples.text: 两栋砖房中间是一个安静的小院。
examples.trans: Between the two brick buildings lies a quiet small courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēng shèng. Specifically praises a generous spread of food.

examples.text: 太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
examples.trans: Wonderful! Now I would like to eat a big breakfast.

examples.text: 周末早上的早餐总是格外丰盛。
examples.trans: Weekend morning breakfast is always extra hearty.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wèi. Introduces a beneficiary or purpose before the verb (为您准备 'prepare for you').

examples.text: 请别担心！我们特意为您准备好了安静的三楼阁楼书房。
examples.trans: Please do not worry! We specially prepared our quiet third-floor attic study for you.

examples.text: 等周经理听说他为分贝慌了一整夜，表情一定精彩！
examples.trans: Wait until Manager Zhou hears he panicked all night over decibels!

meanings.en: in order to; for the sake of
meanings.note: Pinyin: wèi le. Introduces a goal or purpose, typically at the start of the sentence.

examples.text: 为了一个木头小火车紧张？这事越来越怪了。
examples.trans: Nervous over a wooden toy train? This story gets stranger by the hour.

examples.text: 说实话，我选这一带，也是为了一桩家里的旧事。
examples.trans: Honestly, I also chose this neighbourhood for an old family matter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wèi shén me. Asks for a reason; answered with 因为 ('because').

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

examples.text: 为什么把鞋和木头小火车留到星期五呢？
examples.trans: Why leave the shoes and little wooden train here until Friday?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǔ rén. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位主人 ('an owner / host').

examples.text: 箱子的主人肯定很快会来找的。
examples.trans: The suitcase's owner will surely come looking for it soon.

examples.text: 等星期五中午箱子主人进来，我一定坐第一排看！
examples.trans: When the suitcase owner walks in Friday at noon, I am sitting in the front row!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhú guǎn. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位主管 ('a supervisor').

examples.text: 别抢人，小美！小晴，你愿意留下来当正式前台主管吗？
examples.trans: No poaching, Mei! Qing, are you willing to stay on as our permanent front-desk manager?

examples.text: 新来的前台主管做事又快又稳。
examples.trans: The new front-desk supervisor works quickly and steadily.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǔ yào. Describes the main pipe, main reason, or chief task.

examples.text: 主要设计小图书馆和院子，测量老石墙怎么挡住街上噪音。
examples.trans: Mostly small libraries and courtyards, measuring how old stone walls block street noise.

examples.text: 这条老街主要是安静的小茶馆。
examples.trans: This historic lane is mainly quiet little teahouses.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǔ. Describes duration rather than physical length (很久 'a very long time').

examples.text: 三年等得太久了，小晴。两个冬天前我就该打电话给他。
examples.trans: Three years was too long to wait, Qing. Two winters ago I should have phoned him.

examples.text: 让你久等了。
examples.trans: Sorry to keep you waiting so long.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhī nèi. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 三天之内 ('within three days').

examples.text: 十分钟之内你能跑个来回吗？
examples.trans: Can you run there and back within ten minutes?

examples.text: 三天之内一定给您回电话。
examples.trans: We will definitely call you back within three days.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhī qián. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 那之前 ('before that time').

examples.text: 好。端上去之前，在上面撒这些新鲜绿香草。
examples.trans: Good. Before serving them, sprinkle these fresh green herbs on top.

examples.text: 先生，上楼之前，我要诚恳跟您道个歉。
examples.trans: Sir, before going upstairs, I owe you an honest apology.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhī yè. Literary attributive 之 + 夜 ('night'), used in event titles such as 开幕之夜 ('opening night').

examples.text: 星期五的音乐之夜吸引了许多街坊。
examples.trans: Friday's music night drew many neighbors.

examples.text: 大家都期待着小院客栈的开幕之夜。
examples.trans: Everyone is looking forward to Courtyard Inn's opening night.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuè pǔ. Measure word (量词): 本 (běn), e.g. 一本乐谱 ('a book of sheet music').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 完全是意外！到表哥家打开一看，里面是乐谱和红丝带。
examples.trans: Completely by accident! At my cousin's home I opened it and saw sheet music and a red ribbon.

related.gloss: a book of sheet music (measure word 本)

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǔ. Cardinal number 9.

examples.text: 晚上九点？你站这儿，我们一起去开门。
examples.trans: Nine in the evening? Stay right here; let us go open the gate together.

examples.text: 九分钟！牛奶、鸡蛋和苹果都买来了！
examples.trans: Nine minutes! The milk, eggs, and apples are all here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yě. Always stands directly before the verb or adjective, never at the end of a clause.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yé xǔ. Expresses a gentle guess before the subject or verb.

examples.text: 看，已经十二点零四分了。也许他把明信片扔进垃圾桶了。
examples.trans: Look, it is twelve-oh-four already. Maybe he tossed the postcard into the bin.

examples.text: 也许他坐的是下一班火车。
examples.trans: Perhaps he took the next train.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xí guàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个好习惯 ('a good habit').

examples.text: 没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
examples.trans: Exactly! You already fit right in here.

examples.text: 我习惯每天早起喝一杯温水。
examples.trans: I am in the habit of waking early for a glass of warm water.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shū. Measure word (量词): 本 (běn), e.g. 一本书 ('a book').

examples.text: 书桌上放着两本安静的旧书。
examples.trans: Two old books sit on the desk.

examples.text: 她喜欢坐在院子里看书。
examples.trans: She likes sitting in the courtyard reading a book.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shū fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间书房 ('a study').

examples.text: 那间向阳的旧阁楼书房……快跟我来！
examples.trans: That sunny old attic study... follow me, quickly!

examples.text: 请别担心！我们特意为您准备好了安静的三楼阁楼书房。
examples.trans: Please do not worry! We specially prepared our quiet third-floor attic study for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shū jià. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个书架 ('a bookcase').

examples.text: 看这个箭头——指着走廊里的书架！
examples.trans: Look at this arrow—it points at the bookcase in the hallway!

examples.text: 那个大书架靠着那面墙，已经二十年了！
examples.trans: That big bookcase has stood against that wall for twenty years!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shū zhuō. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张书桌 ('a desk').

examples.text: 有，结实的木床、干净书桌，风景全院最好。
examples.trans: Yes, a solid wooden bed, a clean desk, and the best view in the courtyard.

examples.text: 挂在书桌右边吧，那里光线好。
examples.trans: Hang it to the right of the desk, where the light is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mǎi. Everyday verb for purchasing goods; contrasts in tone with 卖 (mài 'sell').

examples.text: 看我的！快说要买什么。
examples.trans: Watch me! Tell me quickly what to buy.

examples.text: 九分钟！牛奶、鸡蛋和苹果都买来了！
examples.trans: Nine minutes! The milk, eggs, and apples are all here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: mǎi jiā. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位买家 ('a buyer').

examples.text: 新买家来看房子之前，只给我们三十天时间！
examples.trans: Before new buyers inspect the building, they give us only thirty days!

examples.text: 那位买家对老木窗很感兴趣。
examples.trans: That buyer is very interested in the old wooden windows.

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēng chǎo. Measure word (量词): 场 (chǎng), e.g. 一场争吵 ('an argument').

examples.text: 老房子连着旧回忆——那种争吵最伤人。
examples.trans: Old houses are tied to old memories—arguments like that cut deepest.

examples.text: 兄弟俩已经忘了以前的争吵。
examples.trans: The two brothers have already put their old quarrel behind them.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件事 ('a matter').

examples.text: 您好好休息，有事随时按铃。
examples.trans: Rest well, ma'am; ring the bell anytime if you need anything.

examples.text: 为了一个木头小火车紧张？这事越来越怪了。
examples.trans: Nervous over a wooden toy train? This story gets stranger by the hour.

meanings.note: Pinyin: èr. Used in counting, ordinals (第二), room numbers, and multi-digit numbers (二十); use 两 before measure words.

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

meanings.note: Pinyin: èr shí bā. Cardinal number 二十 ('twenty') + 八 ('eight'); becomes ordinal with 第 (第二十八 'twenty-eighth').

examples.text: 这首曲子的第二十八小节非常温柔。
examples.trans: The twenty-eighth bar of this piece is very gentle.

examples.text: 二月通常只有二十八天。
examples.trans: February usually has only twenty-eight days.

meanings.note: Pinyin: èr shí sì. Cardinal number twenty-four ('two tens four'); followed by a measure word before nouns.

examples.text: 一天有二十四个小时。
examples.trans: There are twenty-four hours in a day.

examples.text: 两打茶杯一共是二十四个。
examples.trans: Two dozen teacups come to twenty-four in total.

meanings.note: Pinyin: èr chóng zòu. Measure word (量词): 首, e.g. 一首二重奏 ('a duet piece').

examples.text: 生活安排的二重奏比我们自己写得更妙，孩子们。
examples.trans: Life arranges finer duets than we write ourselves, boys.

examples.text: 老师和学生一起弹了一首欢快的钢琴二重奏。
examples.trans: Teacher and student played a cheerful piano duet together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǔ. Cardinal number 5.

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǔ zhé. In Chinese discounts, numbers show the percentage YOU PAY: 五折 = 50% of original price (half off).

examples.text: 这家书店今天所有的旧书都打五折。
examples.trans: All secondhand books in this bookshop are fifty percent off today.

examples.text: 下午五点以后，面包店的点心打五折。
examples.trans: Pastries at the bakery go for half price after five in the afternoon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǔ xīng jí. Describes luxury hotel service.

examples.text: 我们客栈都是五星级服务……哎呀！
examples.trans: At our inn, everything is five-star service... whoops!

examples.text: 热！小晴你听到没？稳定、现代、五星级热水！
examples.trans: Hot! Qing, did you hear that? Reliable, modern, five-star hot water!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǔ yuè. Fifth month of the year ('month five').

examples.text: 五月的成都院子里到处都是花香。
examples.trans: In May, courtyards in Chengdu are filled with the scent of flowers everywhere.

examples.text: 这张旧照片是五月的一个晴天拍的。
examples.trans: This old photo was taken on a sunny day in May.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǔ jīn. Traditionally 'the five metals' (gold, silver, copper, iron, tin); modern term for tools, screws, and hardware.

examples.text: 街角的五金店卖螺丝、锤子和胶带。
examples.trans: The hardware shop on the corner sells screws, hammers, and tape.

examples.text: 老陈去五金摊买了一卷新电线。
examples.trans: Chen went to the hardware stall and bought a roll of new wire.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǔ jīn diàn. Measure word (量词): 家 (jiā), e.g. 一家五金店 ('a hardware store').

examples.text: 冬天用掉最后一个了。只有桥那边的老五金店有这个尺寸。
examples.trans: Used the last one in winter. Only the old hardware shop past the bridge carries this size.

examples.text: 那家五金店早上几点开门？
examples.trans: What time does that hardware shop open in the morning?

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiāo. Often pairs with 给 (交给 'hand over to') or 到 (交到 'deliver to').

examples.text: 交给我吧。我们下楼欢迎他。
examples.trans: Leave it to me. Let's go downstairs and welcome him.

examples.text: 您为什么不直接去志鹏家门口把木头小火车交给他呢？
examples.trans: Why not go straight to Zhipeng's door and hand him the wooden train?

meanings.en: hand back; return to its owner
meanings.note: Pinyin: jiāo huán. Formal-polite compound with 还 read huán ('return something').

examples.text: 不许盯着客人看。把箱子交还，干自己的活。
examples.trans: No staring at guests. Hand back the bag and do our own work.

examples.text: 捡到钥匙后，他马上交还给了前台。
examples.trans: After finding the key, he promptly returned it to the front desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chǎn quán. Measure word (量词): 份 (fèn), e.g. 一份产权 ('a property title').

examples.text: 产权转让通知：八号小院整栋建筑将作为商业办公楼出售。
examples.trans: Property Transfer Notice: Courtyard Building Eight offered for sale as commercial offices.

examples.text: 这栋老房子的产权手续很清楚。
examples.trans: The ownership paperwork for this old house is crystal clear.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liàng. Describes bright light or a surface polished clean (擦亮 'polish bright').

examples.text: 隔壁的小洗手间呢？灯亮吗？
examples.trans: What about the small bathroom next door? Does the light work?

examples.text: 火苗亮了——稳稳的蓝火，正合适。
examples.trans: The flame is lit—steady blue fire, right as it should be.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qīn shǒu. Highlights personal care in making, baking, or carving something.

examples.text: 拆开白纸……不会吧！爷爷亲手雕的木头火车头！
examples.trans: Unwrap the white paper... no way! Grandfather's hand-carved wooden locomotive!

examples.text: 这块柠檬蛋糕是她亲手烤的。
examples.trans: She baked this lemon cake with her own hands.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rén. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个人 ('a person').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: rén shēng. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 一段人生 ('a life journey').

examples.text: 这是我人生中最棒的第一周！
examples.trans: This is the best first week of my whole life!

examples.text: 老街坊们常在茶桌旁聊人生。
examples.trans: Old neighbors often chat about life around the tea table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shén me. Asks 'what?' on its own (什么？) or modifies a noun (什么茶 'what kind of tea').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīn tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 今天一天 ('all day today').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房今天到。
examples.trans: Right, eight guest rooms, eight brass keys. Room four arrives today.

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīn wǎn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 今天晚上 ('this evening').

examples.text: 今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
examples.trans: Tonight I should be able to sleep well after all.

examples.text: 老陈……小晴……快告诉我今晚六号房空着。
examples.trans: Chen... Qing... please tell me room six is free tonight.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiè yì. Common in polite questions (您介意吗？ 'Do you mind?').

examples.text: 真的？您不介意多爬几步楼梯？
examples.trans: Really? You do not mind climbing a few extra stairs?

examples.text: 一点也不介意！窗下这张宽书桌正适合我工作。
examples.trans: Not at all! And this wide desk beneath the window suits my work ideally.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cóng. Marks a starting point in space or time (从早上到晚上 'from morning to night').

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cóng róng. Describes a relaxed, unhurried pace or manner without panic.

examples.text: 宋老师说话的声音总是温和又从容。
examples.trans: Teacher Song's voice is always warm and unhurried.

examples.text: 提前准备好材料，做饭时就能很从容。
examples.trans: When you prepare the ingredients ahead of time, you can cook calmly and unhurriedly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cóng lái. Almost always paired with 没 or 不 to mean 'never before / never at all'.

examples.text: 我以前从来没见过这么古老的钢琴。
examples.trans: I have never seen such an old piano before.

examples.text: 老陈修东西从来不马虎。
examples.trans: Chen is never careless when repairing things.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǐ xì. Describes checking details or listening closely.

examples.text: 仔细看这一页——记的是分贝和安静度，不是酒店星级！
examples.trans: Look closely at this page—it records decibels and quietness, not hotel stars!

examples.text: 出门前请仔细检查一下门锁。
examples.trans: Please check the door lock carefully before going out.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tā. Third-person singular masculine pronoun; pronounced identically to 她 and 它.

examples.text: 他没要回那个装木头小火车的箱子吗？
examples.trans: Did he not ask back for that case with the wooden train?

examples.text: 他留了纸条，请我们保管到星期五。
examples.trans: He left a note asking us to keep it until Friday.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tā men. Third-person plural pronoun for male or mixed groups.

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

examples.text: 小晴，把热水倒进茶壶里，他们来了！
examples.trans: Qing, pour the hot water into the teapot—here they come!

meanings.note: Pinyin: fù. Used for paying money or bills (付钱 'pay money').

examples.text: 付了现金！打开工具箱等我，我往桥那边跑回来了！
examples.trans: Paid in cash! Open your toolbox and wait—I am running back across the bridge!

examples.text: 我已经付过房租了。
examples.trans: I have already paid the rent.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fù qián. Separable verb-object compound for paying.

examples.text: 哎呀，怎么好意思拿房东烦心事打扰付钱的客人！
examples.trans: Oh dear, how could we bother a paying guest with our landlord troubles!

examples.text: 您可以用现金付钱，也可以刷卡。
examples.trans: You may pay in cash or by card.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐ wéi. Signals a belief that turned out not to be true ('I thought…, but actually…').

examples.text: 成都旅游指南？等等——你们以为我是酒店评审员？
examples.trans: The Chengdu Travel Guide? Wait—did you think I am a hotel inspector?

examples.text: 我以为卖房子时早就丢了！为什么一直替我留着？
examples.trans: I thought it was lost long ago when we sold the house! Why keep it for me?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐ qián. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 以前的日子 ('days in the past').

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

examples.text: 哦？您家里人以前住在这附近吗？
examples.trans: Oh? Did your family live near here once?

related.gloss: days in the past (measure word 段)

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐ hòu. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 以后的时间 ('time afterward').

examples.text: 三年前爷爷去世以后，我和志鹏因为卖老房子大吵了一架。
examples.trans: Three years ago after Grandfather passed away, Zhipeng and I argued bitterly over selling the old house.

examples.text: 十二点以后再拆吧，老板！看钟：差五分十二点！
examples.trans: Open it after twelve, boss! Look at the clock: five minutes to twelve!

meanings.note: Pinyin: men. Attaches to pronouns (我们, 你们, 他们) and human nouns (孩子们).

examples.text: 生活安排的二重奏比我们自己写得更妙，孩子们。
examples.trans: Life arranges finer duets than we write ourselves, boys.

examples.text: 我梦想中的咖啡馆——就在自家院子里！等我去告诉市场老板们！
examples.trans: My dream café—right in our own courtyard! Wait until I tell the market stall owners!

件.gloss: measure word for tops, luggage, matters

meanings.en: measure word for tops, luggage, matters
meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn. Counts upper-body garments (一件外套), suitcases (一件行李), and affairs (一件事).

examples.text: 不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
examples.trans: It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!

examples.text: 您看，这件软羊毛开衫是全新的，试试吧。
examples.trans: Look, this soft wool cardigan is brand-new; try it on.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jià qian. Everyday spoken word for price (note neutral-tone qian); more conversational than 价格.

examples.text: 这种本地蜂蜜味道好，价钱也公道。
examples.trans: This local honey tastes great, and the price is fair too.

examples.text: 买之前先问清楚每公斤的价钱。
examples.trans: Ask clearly about the price per kilo before buying.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rèn hé. Emphasizes 'any at all' in negative or conditional sentences (没有任何东西).

examples.text: 深呼吸，周经理。还没人写任何东西呢。
examples.trans: Take a deep breath, Manager Zhou. Nobody has written anything yet.

examples.text: 如果有任何需要，请随时告诉我。
examples.trans: If you need anything at all, please let me know anytime.

份.gloss: measure word for portions, copies, jobs

meanings.en: measure word for portions, copies, jobs
meanings.note: Pinyin: fèn. Counts documents, newspapers, meals, and shares (一份文件 'a document').

examples.text: 整份文件还没读完呢，周经理，别先认输。
examples.trans: We have not even finished reading the whole document, Manager Zhou—don't give up yet.

examples.text: 请再给我一份早餐。
examples.trans: Please bring me one more portion of breakfast.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiū xi. Everyday verb for resting after a trip or shift.

examples.text: 您好好休息，有事随时按铃。
examples.trans: Rest well, ma'am; ring the bell anytime if you need anything.

examples.text: 您的房间准备好了，请上楼休息吧。
examples.trans: Your room is ready; please head upstairs and rest.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huì. Expresses either an acquired skill (会弹钢琴) or likelihood in the future (会下雨).

examples.text: 下雨的时候，纸不会弄丢房间名单。
examples.trans: When it rains, paper will not lose the room list.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuán. Used for sounds, messages, or traditions traveling from one place or person to another.

examples.text: 因为湿木头百叶窗会柔化石板路传回来的回声……
examples.trans: Because wet wooden shutters soften the echo bouncing off the flagstones...

examples.text: 院子里传来好听的琴声。
examples.trans: Lovely piano music drifted across the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shāng. Used for physical injury or emotional hurt (伤人 'hurt someone's feelings').

examples.text: 老房子连着旧回忆——那种争吵最伤人。
examples.trans: Old houses are tied to old memories—arguments like that cut deepest.

examples.text: 别因为小事伤了感情。
examples.trans: Do not hurt feelings over a small matter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wèi. Polite counterpart of 个 when counting guests, customers, or teachers (一位客人, 这位老师).

examples.text: 太谢谢你们两位了。
examples.trans: Thank you both so very much.

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wèi zhi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个好位置 ('a good spot').

examples.text: 好位置。两把结实椅子，朝着花草，别朝着大堂窗户。
examples.trans: Good spot. Two sturdy chairs, facing the plants rather than the lobby window.

examples.text: 靠窗的那个位置光线最好。
examples.trans: That seat by the window has the best light.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dī. Describes low height, volume, or pitch (声音很低 'voice is low').

examples.text: 先生，到了。小心碰头，这根木房梁比较低。
examples.trans: Here we are, sir. Mind your head—this wooden beam is fairly low.

examples.text: 她说话的声音很低。
examples.trans: Her speaking voice is very soft and low.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dī tóu. Describes looking down or yielding in an argument.

examples.text: 等等，低头看石头台阶上。
examples.trans: Wait—look down on the stone step.

examples.text: 他低头看了一眼手表上的时间。
examples.trans: He glanced down at the time on his wristwatch.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhù. Means 'reside/stay overnight' as a main verb, or 'firmly in place' as a result complement (记住, 拿住).

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhù mǎn. Resultative verb compound 住 ('stay/live') + 满 ('full').

examples.text: 每年春天，这家小客栈都会住满客人。
examples.trans: Every spring, this little inn fills up with guests.

examples.text: 周末的时候，二楼的房间全都住满了。
examples.trans: On the weekend, every room on the second floor was booked full.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tǐ liàng. Warm polite word thanking guests for their patience.

examples.text: 谢谢您这么体谅！老陈马上去地下室检查。
examples.trans: Thank you for being so understanding! Chen will check the basement right away.

examples.text: 谢谢各位客人的耐心和体谅。
examples.trans: Thank you to all our guests for your patience and understanding.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé zhǐ. Rhetorical opener meaning 'more than just…!'.

examples.text: 何止认识！整整六年，每个星期五我都爬那座木楼梯教钢琴！
examples.trans: More than know it! Every Friday for six whole years I climbed those wooden stairs to teach piano!

examples.text: 这棵树何止五十年，快一百年了！
examples.trans: More than fifty years—this tree is nearly a hundred years old!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuò. Appears in compounds and verb-complement pairs like 装作 ('pretend to be').

examples.text: 而且大哥想装作镇定的时候，绝对不会早到。
examples.trans: Besides, when older brothers want to act calm, they never arrive early.

examples.text: 他装作什么都不知道。
examples.trans: He pretended not to know anything at all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuò wéi. Introduces a role or basis ('as a heritage building').

examples.text: 产权转让通知：八号小院整栋建筑将作为商业办公楼出售。
examples.trans: Property Transfer Notice: Courtyard Building Eight offered for sale as commercial offices.

examples.text: 作为老邻居，我当然要来帮忙。
examples.trans: As an old neighbor, of course I came to lend a hand.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuò qǔ jiā. Combines 作曲 ('compose music') + specialist suffix 家 ('master/specialist').

examples.text: 这位年轻的作曲家写了好几首钢琴曲。
examples.trans: This young composer has written several piano pieces.

examples.text: 我最喜欢的作曲家经常从民间音乐里找灵感。
examples.trans: My favorite composer often finds inspiration in folk music.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ. Everyday singular 'you' among colleagues, friends, and peers; use 您 for polite respect.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ men. Plural 'you' for addressing two or more people (including polite groups).

examples.text: 太谢谢你们两位了。
examples.trans: Thank you both so very much.

examples.text: 不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
examples.trans: It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!

meanings.note: Pinyin: ní hǎo. Everyday greeting formed from 你 ('you') + 好 ('good'); pronounced ní hǎo by 3rd-tone sandhi.

examples.text: 你好，请问前台在哪里？
examples.trans: Hello, excuse me, where is the front desk?

examples.text: 你好，很高兴认识你！
examples.trans: Hello, nice to meet you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎo. Core verb in 保住 ('save/keep safe') and 保护 ('protect').

examples.text: 小晴，你真是天生的店长！我的血压保住了！
examples.trans: Qing, you are a born innkeeper! My blood pressure is saved!

examples.text: 大家一起保住了这栋老房子。
examples.trans: Everyone worked together to save this old house.

meanings.note: Pinyin: báo yǎng. Used for maintaining wooden instruments, buildings, or tools.

examples.text: 电线本来就该拉直了。正常保养，别多想。
examples.trans: The wire needed straightening anyway. Routine maintenance—don't read into it.

examples.text: 听听保养大师说的！昨天修热水器，今天修两兄弟！
examples.trans: Listen to the maintenance master! Yesterday fixing the boiler, today fixing two brothers!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎo mì. Separable verb-object compound meaning 'keep confidential'.

examples.text: 放心吧，老陈，我们替你保密！
examples.trans: Rest assured, Chen—we will keep your secret!

examples.text: 这是给她的惊喜，大家先保密哦。
examples.trans: This is a surprise for her, so let's keep it a secret first.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎo hù. Used for protecting historic neighborhoods or people.

examples.text: 房产信？让志豪和我看看——我管市政合同，他懂老建筑保护法！
examples.trans: A property letter? Let Zhihao and me see it—I handle municipal contracts, and he knows heritage building law!

examples.text: 成都老城区保护条例第十四条——窗外我哥哥刚点头了！
examples.trans: Clause fourteen of the Chengdu Old Quarter Act—and my brother outside just nodded!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎo hù bàn. Shortened municipal office name from 保护 ('protect / conservation') + 办公室 ('office').

examples.text: 老建筑保护办下周三来院子里看木窗。
examples.trans: The historic building conservation office is coming to check the wooden windows next Wednesday.

examples.text: 保护办的工作人员很喜欢这扇老木门。
examples.trans: The staff from the conservation office really liked this old wooden door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎo chí. Followed by an adjective like 安静 or 镇定 ('stay calm').

examples.text: 有进步！今天小院迎接兄弟重逢——大家保持安静端庄！
examples.trans: Progress! Today our courtyard hosts a brotherly reunion—quiet dignity from everyone!

examples.text: 三楼书房整天都保持得很安静。
examples.trans: The third-floor study stays quiet all day long.

meanings.note: Pinyin: báo nuǎn. Describes warm wool sweaters or insulated rooms.

examples.text: 老砖墙保暖，房间到天亮都暖和，放心。
examples.trans: Old brick walls hold heat, so the rooms stay warm until daybreak—don't worry.

examples.text: 冬天穿一件羊毛衣最保暖。
examples.trans: Wearing a wool sweater in winter keeps you warmest.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎo wēn. Verb-object compound 保 ('preserve') + 温 ('warmth'); used for thick mugs, thermoses, and walls.

examples.text: 厚陶土茶杯比薄玻璃杯更保温。
examples.trans: Thick stoneware teacups hold heat better than thin glass cups.

examples.text: 冬天出门，我喜欢带一个保温水壶。
examples.trans: When going out in winter, I like bringing an insulated flask.

meanings.note: Pinyin: báo guǎn. Used at hotel front desks for storing guests' luggage.

examples.text: 我念念：对不起拿错了，请帮我保管到星期五。
examples.trans: Let me read it: Sorry for taking the wrong one; please keep mine until Friday.

examples.text: 他留了纸条，请我们保管到星期五。
examples.trans: He left a note asking us to keep it until Friday.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎo zhèng. Strong personal assurance ('I promise!').

examples.text: 下周我保证把半个市政厅的同事都带来小美这儿喝咖啡。
examples.trans: Next week I promise to bring half my City Hall colleagues to Mei's tables.

examples.text: 我向您保证，八点以前一定修好。
examples.trans: I promise you it will definitely be fixed before eight o'clock.

meanings.note: Pinyin: báo xiǎn sī. Measure word (量词): 根 (gēn), e.g. 一根保险丝 ('a fuse').

examples.text: 是旧电线，把一楼的保险丝烧断了。
examples.trans: It was the old wire—it blew the ground-floor fuse.

examples.text: 老陈，午饭以前能修好吗？你有新的保险丝吧？
examples.trans: Chen, can you fix it before lunch? You do have new fuses, right?

meanings.note: Pinyin: xìn. Measure word (量词): 封 (fēng), e.g. 一封信 ('a letter').

examples.text: 我在看天气，小美！铃铛旁边这封厚信是谁放的？
examples.trans: I am checking the weather, Mei! Who put this thick letter beside the bell?

examples.text: 周经理！您脸色全白了！快坐下——信上写了什么？
examples.trans: Manager Zhou! Your face went completely white! Sit down quickly—what does the letter say?

meanings.note: Pinyin: xìn fēng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个信封 ('an envelope').

examples.text: 看，把手上贴着一个白信封。
examples.trans: Look, there is a white envelope taped onto the handle.

examples.text: 桌子上放着一个白色的信封。
examples.trans: A white envelope is lying on the table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liǎ. Colloquial fusion of 两个, never followed by 个 (我们俩 'the two of us').

examples.text: 啊！黄色柠檬糖霜——每个星期五我们俩都抢边角那一块！
examples.trans: Oh! Yellow lemon glaze—every single Friday the two of us fought over the corner piece!

examples.text: 别动，你们俩。听到路边汽车停下的声音了吗？
examples.trans: Hold still, both of you. Hear that car engine stopping at the curb?

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiū. Used for fixing pipes, locks, furniture, or appliances (修好 'fix completely').

examples.text: 这么快就修好了？老陈你随身带着螺丝刀啊！
examples.trans: Fixed that fast? Chen, you carry a screwdriver everywhere on you!

examples.text: 听听保养大师说的！昨天修热水器，今天修两兄弟！
examples.trans: Listen to the maintenance master! Yesterday fixing the boiler, today fixing two brothers!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bèi. Marks multiplication or doubling (翻一倍 'double').

examples.text: 听听他说的！老陈比我们好奇两倍！
examples.trans: Listen to him! Chen is twice as curious as we are!

examples.text: 比现在翻一倍！我们真的要对整条街开放小院咖啡馆吗？
examples.trans: Double what I bake now! Are we really opening the courtyard café to our whole street?

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Used for pouring tea, water, or juice into a cup or pot (倒茶 'pour tea').

examples.text: 小晴，把热水倒进茶壶里，他们来了！
examples.trans: Qing, pour the hot water into the teapot—here they come!

examples.text: 宋老师，让我来给您倒新鲜橙汁！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, allow me to pour fresh orange juice for you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào chē. Separable verb-object compound; note 倒 is read 4th-tone dào ('reverse/invert'), not 3rd-tone dǎo ('fall').

examples.text: 胡同有点窄，司机慢慢地往后倒车。
examples.trans: The lane is a bit narrow, so the driver slowly backed the van up.

examples.text: 倒车的时候一定要先看后面的行人。
examples.trans: Always check for pedestrians behind you when reversing.

meanings.note: Pinyin: juè. Describes an affectionate or wry 'stubborn streak' (倔脾气).

examples.text: 哈！你怕签了名字，倔脾气大哥就不出门了！
examples.trans: Aha! You feared that if you signed your name, stubborn big brother would stay home!

examples.text: 倔了三年……说实话，老弟，我也想你。
examples.trans: Three stubborn years... honestly, little brother, I missed you too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhí de. Followed by a noun, score, or action worth the effort.

examples.text: 你的服务值得十分！其实我是声学建筑师。
examples.trans: Your service deserves ten points! Actually, I am an acoustic architect.

examples.text: 这家安静的小客栈很值得再来。
examples.trans: This quiet boutique inn is well worth visiting again.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuò. Everyday verb for preparing food, doing work, or making objects.

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 小晴买了海盐黄油，今天我们做嫩炒蛋！
examples.trans: Qing bought sea-salt butter, so today we are making soft scrambled eggs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuò mèng. Separable verb-object compound ('dream').

examples.text: 我在做梦吗？！志豪，这场重逢是你安排的吗？
examples.trans: Am I dreaming?! Zhihao, did you plan this whole reunion?

examples.text: 昨晚我睡得真香，连做梦都没有。
examples.trans: I slept so soundly last night that I did not even dream.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tíng. Used for vehicles pulling up, rain stopping, or pausing an action.

examples.text: 别动，你们俩。听到路边汽车停下的声音了吗？
examples.trans: Hold still, both of you. Hear that car engine stopping at the curb?

examples.text: 一辆黄色出租车刚停在铁大门外头！
examples.trans: A yellow taxi just pulled up outside the iron gate!

meanings.note: Pinyin: tōu. Before a verb, means 'quietly/secretly' (偷看 'peek secretly').

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

examples.text: 说这话的人每隔三十秒就扒着窗帘偷看一次！
examples.trans: Says the man peeking through the window curtain every thirty seconds!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bàng wǎn. Combines 傍 ('draw near to') + 晚 ('evening'): the golden hour around sunset.

examples.text: 傍晚的时候，院子里的灯笼一盏接一盏亮了。
examples.trans: At dusk, the lanterns in the courtyard lit up one after another.

examples.text: 夏天的傍晚最适合坐在院子里乘凉。
examples.trans: Summer evenings at dusk are perfect for sitting in the courtyard to enjoy the breeze.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chǔ cáng shì. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间储藏室 ('a storage room').

examples.text: 我把那个蓝色行李箱锁在储藏室里了。
examples.trans: I locked that blue suitcase safely inside the storeroom.

examples.text: 储藏室里有两个软枕头和一块蓝地毯！
examples.trans: In the storeroom there are two soft pillows and a blue rug!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàng. Introduces a likeness or example ('look like, be like').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 他长得真像他哥哥。
examples.trans: He really looks like his older brother.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàng yàng. Describes a proper meal, repair, or setup.

examples.text: 阁楼里真的有像样的床吗？
examples.trans: Does the attic really have a proper bed?

examples.text: 十分钟就做出了一顿像样的早餐。
examples.trans: In ten minutes she put together a proper breakfast.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiōng dì. Measure word (量词): 对 (duì), e.g. 一对兄弟 ('a pair of brothers').

examples.text: 宋老师，快多讲讲梧桐巷那两兄弟吧！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, tell me more about those two brothers on Wutong Lane!

examples.text: 听听保养大师说的！昨天修热水器，今天修两兄弟！
examples.trans: Listen to the maintenance master! Yesterday fixing the boiler, today fixing two brothers!

related.gloss: a pair of brothers (measure word 对)

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiān. Placed before the verb to sequence actions: 先…再… ('first…, then…').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiān sheng. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位先生 ('a gentleman').

examples.text: 等等——先生您好！您问那个深蓝色行李箱吗？
examples.trans: Wait—hello, sir! Are you asking about that dark-blue suitcase?

examples.text: 先生，箱子安全锁在柜子里。请问您贵姓？
examples.trans: Sir, the bag is locked safely in our closet. May I ask your surname?

meanings.note: Pinyin: guāng. Rays of light or brightness (阳光 'sunlight', 灯光 'lamplight').

examples.text: 早上的光从玻璃窗照进阳光房里。
examples.trans: Morning light shines through the glass windows into the sunroom.

examples.text: 换上新灯泡以后，屋子里的光很柔和。
examples.trans: After putting in the new bulb, the light in the room is very gentle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guāng lín. Polite hospitality word paired with 欢迎 in 欢迎光临 ('Welcome!').

examples.text: 欢迎光临！早上好，您好！
examples.trans: Welcome! Good morning, hello!

examples.text: 欢迎光临我们的院子咖啡馆！
examples.trans: Welcome to our courtyard café!

meanings.note: Pinyin: guāng tū tū. Vivid ABB adjective 光 ('bare') + 秃秃 ('bald/stripped'), used for leafless branches or unpainted bare wood.

examples.text: 冬天的树枝光秃秃的，一片叶子也没有。
examples.trans: In winter the branches are bare, without a single leaf.

examples.text: 打磨完的木板光秃秃地靠在墙边。
examples.trans: The sanded wooden boards leaned bare against the wall.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guāng xiàn. Measure word (量词): 道 (dào), e.g. 一道光线 ('a beam of light').

examples.text: 挂在书桌右边吧，那里光线好。
examples.trans: Hang it to the right of the desk, where the light is good.

examples.text: 向阳的阁楼早上光线特别好。
examples.trans: The south-facing attic has wonderful morning light.

related.gloss: a beam of light (measure word 道)

meanings.note: Pinyin: miǎn fèi. Literally 'exempt from fee'.

examples.text: 今晚半价，而且一整周早餐免费！
examples.trans: Half price tonight, plus free breakfast all week!

examples.text: 住店客人早上都可以免费喝热茶。
examples.trans: Overnight guests can enjoy complimentary hot tea every morning.

meanings.note: Pinyin: quán. Emphasizes entirety before 都 or a verb (全都 'every single one').

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

examples.text: 四张桌子，八把椅子，全摆好了！
examples.trans: Four tables, eight chairs—everything is set in place!

meanings.note: Pinyin: quán xīn. Stronger than 新 ('completely brand-new').

examples.text: 您看，这件软羊毛开衫是全新的，试试吧。
examples.trans: Look, this soft wool cardigan is brand-new; try it on.

examples.text: 浴室里刚换上了全新的铜阀门。
examples.trans: Brand-new brass valves were just fitted in the bathroom.

meanings.note: Pinyin: quán bù. Combines 全 ('whole') + 部 ('part'): precedes numerals + measure words or nouns (全部四张桌子).

examples.text: 小晴把全部窗户都擦得干干净净。
examples.trans: Qing wiped all the windows sparkling clean.

examples.text: 客人们把盘子里的点心全部吃完了。
examples.trans: The guests ate up all the pastries on the plate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bā. Cardinal number 8.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房今天到。
examples.trans: Right, eight guest rooms, eight brass keys. Room four arrives today.

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bā dù. Musical interval of eight scale degrees: 八 ('eight') + 度 ('degree/interval').

examples.text: 请把这段旋律升高一个八度再弹一次。
examples.trans: Please raise this melody by one octave and play it again.

examples.text: 钢琴中央八度的音色最温暖。
examples.trans: The tone of the piano's middle octave is the warmest.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gōng shì. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件公事 ('a piece of official business').

examples.text: 说得对。公事等一等——先放在账本旁边。
examples.trans: Right you are. Paperwork can wait—set it beside the ledger for now.

examples.text: 今天不谈公事，只喝茶聊天。
examples.trans: No work business today—just tea and conversation.

related.gloss: a piece of official business (measure word 件)

meanings.note: Pinyin: gōng zhòng. Measure word (量词): 群, e.g. 一群公众 ('members of the public').

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

examples.text: 小院花园每天上午向公众开放。
examples.trans: The courtyard garden opens to the public every morning.

related.gloss: members of the public (measure word 群)

meanings.note: Pinyin: gōng sī. Measure word (量词): 家 (jiā), e.g. 一家公司 ('a company').

examples.text: 搬家公司清空梧桐巷之前，我从阁楼架子救下了这个盒子。
examples.trans: Before the movers cleared Wutong Lane, I saved this box from the attic shelf.

examples.text: 他工作的律师公司在市中心。
examples.trans: The law firm where he works is downtown.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gōng jīn. Standard metric weight classifier ('kilogram', equal to two 斤 jīn).

examples.text: 小美在水果摊买了三公斤黄柠檬。
examples.trans: Mei bought three kilos of yellow lemons at the fruit stall.

examples.text: 这个竹篮子最多能装五公斤水果。
examples.trans: This bamboo basket can hold at most five kilograms of fruit.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liù. Cardinal number 6.

examples.text: 老陈……小晴……快告诉我今晚六号房空着。
examples.trans: Chen... Qing... please tell me room six is free tonight.

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guān. Used for closing doors/windows and turning off lights, taps, or valves.

examples.text: 拿稳了！你已经关掉总水阀了吗？
examples.trans: Steady! Did you turn off the main water valve already?

examples.text: 关掉了，水也放空了。把左边那把重扳手递给我。
examples.trans: Turned off and drained. Pass me that heavy wrench on your left.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qí shí. Gently reveals the real truth behind a misunderstanding.

examples.text: 其实我下楼是想问问，洗手间水龙头怎么有点凉。
examples.trans: Actually, I came down to ask why the bathroom tap felt a bit cool.

examples.text: 你的服务值得十分！其实我是声学建筑师。
examples.trans: Your service deserves ten points! Actually, I am an acoustic architect.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. Marks a next step in sequence (先提再推) or a future repetition (再见 'see you again').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài jiàn. Standard Mandarin farewell at any time of day.

examples.text: 路上小心，我们明天再见！
examples.trans: Take care on the road—see you again tomorrow!

examples.text: 谢谢您的帮忙，再见！
examples.trans: Thank you for your help—goodbye!

meanings.note: Pinyin: mào yǔ. Compact verb phrase meaning 'go out despite the rain'.

examples.text: 谢谢你们实话实说，没让我冒雨再找地方。
examples.trans: Thank you both for speaking honestly instead of sending me back into the rain.

examples.text: 邮递员冒雨送来了一封挂号信。
examples.trans: The mail carrier braved the rain to deliver a registered letter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiě. Used for writing characters, notes, letters, or reviews.

examples.text: 到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
examples.trans: Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiě wán. Resultative verb compound 写 ('write') + 完 ('finish').

examples.text: 宋老师终于在傍晚前写完了整首圆舞曲。
examples.trans: Teacher Song finally finished writing the whole waltz before dusk.

examples.text: 我写完这张明信片就去邮局寄出。
examples.trans: As soon as I finish writing this postcard, I will mail it at the post office.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōng tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个冬天 ('a winter').

examples.text: 冬天用掉最后一个了。只有桥那边的老五金店有这个尺寸。
examples.trans: Used the last one in winter. Only the old hardware shop past the bridge carries this size.

examples.text: 两个都买下！留一个备用明年冬天也省心。
examples.trans: Buy both! Keeping a spare saves worry next winter too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bīng. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块冰 ('a piece of ice').

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

examples.text: 杯子里加了两块冰。
examples.trans: Two ice cubes were added to the glass.

related.gloss: a piece of ice (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: bīng liáng. Vivid adjective stronger than 凉.

examples.text: 明天早上七点，洗澡水会冰凉。
examples.trans: At seven tomorrow morning, the shower water will be ice-cold.

examples.text: 冰凉的洗澡水？！成都旅游指南评审员就住在三楼啊！
examples.trans: Ice-cold shower water?! The Chengdu Travel Guide inspector is staying on floor three!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bīng xiāng. Measure word (量词): 台, e.g. 一台冰箱 ('a refrigerator').

examples.text: 送牛奶的车在城外坏了。你们看冰箱！
examples.trans: The milk delivery van broke down outside town. Look at the fridge!

examples.text: 我把新鲜牛奶放进冰箱里了。
examples.trans: I put the fresh milk into the refrigerator.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chōng. Used for pouring boiling water to brew tea or coffee (冲茶 'brew tea').

examples.text: 小晴你真是救星！先给我牛奶冲咖啡。
examples.trans: Qing, you are a lifesaver! Hand me the milk first to make coffee.

examples.text: 慢慢拧……听！水冲进来了！
examples.trans: Turning slowly... listen! Water is rushing in!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lěng. Describes cold weather, unheated rooms, or cold water.

examples.text: 热汤？在冷站台吹了风，喝碗热汤太好了。
examples.trans: Hot soup? After the cold wind on the station platform, hot soup sounds wonderful.

examples.text: 那今晚房间会冷吗？也没有热水了吗？
examples.trans: Will the rooms get cold tonight? And is there no hot water either?

meanings.note: Pinyin: léng shuǐ. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯冷水 ('a glass of cold water').

examples.text: 周经理，给您干净布和冷水。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, here is a clean cloth and cold water for you.

examples.text: 定好闹钟吧，老陈。明早我们跑赢冷水！
examples.trans: Set your alarm, Chen. Tomorrow morning we outrun the cold water!

related.gloss: a glass of cold water (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǔn. Describes accurate clocks or spotting something accurately (看准).

examples.text: 一定看准里面铜圈是二十毫米宽。
examples.trans: Make sure the brass ring inside is twenty millimetres wide.

examples.text: 这块老钟走得非常准。
examples.trans: This old clock keeps very accurate time.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǔn bèi. Used for preparing rooms, breakfast, or plans.

examples.text: 大家早上好！欢迎你，小晴。都准备好了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning, everyone! Welcome, Qing. Is everything ready?

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǔn shí. Praises trains or guests arriving right on schedule.

examples.text: 我？哦，我只是喜欢准时！七点十四分真美妙！
examples.trans: Me? Oh, I simply love punctuality! Seven fourteen is a lovely minute!

examples.text: 早上七点半的火车一向很准时。
examples.trans: The seven-thirty morning train is always right on time.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liáng. Describes pleasantly cool air or hot water/food that has cooled down (放凉).

examples.text: 谢谢你，小美。刚才吓了一跳，手都凉了！
examples.trans: Thank you, Mei. That gave me such a start just now that my hands went cold!

examples.text: 我刚试了洗手池水龙头，水先是温的，马上变凉了。
examples.trans: I just tested the sink tap—the water started warm, then turned cool right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liáng shuǐ. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯凉水 ('a glass of cool water').

examples.text: 志豪先生，喝口凉水吧。纸上写的什么？
examples.trans: Mr Zhihao, drink a sip of cool water. What is written on that paper?

examples.text: 夏天洗把凉水脸真舒服。
examples.trans: Splashing cool water on your face in summer feels refreshing.

related.gloss: a glass of cool water (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Pinyin: jǐ. Asks about small numbers (几点 'what time', 几个 'how many') before a measure word.

examples.text: 真的？您不介意多爬几步楼梯？
examples.trans: Really? You do not mind climbing a few extra stairs?

examples.text: 那家五金店早上几点开门？
examples.trans: What time does that hardware shop open in the morning?

meanings.note: Pinyin: chū. Core directional verb meaning 'outward'.

examples.text: 糟了！周经理，小晴，厨房出急事了！
examples.trans: Oh no! Manager Zhou, Qing, we have a kitchen emergency!

examples.text: 出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
examples.trans: Go out the front gate, turn left, and walk straight to the stone bridge.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chū qù. Directional compound moving from inside to outside.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 雨停了，我们出去走走吧。
examples.trans: The rain has stopped—let's go outside for a walk.

related.gloss: come fresh out of the oven

meanings.note: Pinyin: chū shòu. Formal verb used on property notices ('put up for sale').

examples.text: 产权转让通知：八号小院整栋建筑将作为商业办公楼出售。
examples.trans: Property Transfer Notice: Courtyard Building Eight offered for sale as commercial offices.

examples.text: 商业办公楼出售？！把我们的客栈和厨房变成灰色办公室？！
examples.trans: Commercial office sale?! Turn our inn and kitchen into grey offices?!

related.gloss: come fresh out of the oven

meanings.note: Pinyin: chū lái. Directional complement for coming out or figuring something out (认出来).

examples.text: 明信片上整齐的方格字，我两秒钟就认出来了。
examples.trans: That neat block handwriting on the postcard—I recognized it in two seconds.

examples.text: 看合页边露出来的折纸图纸——一楼画着一扇暗门！
examples.trans: Look at the folded blueprint sticking out of the hinge—a hidden door is drawn on the ground floor!

related.gloss: come fresh out of the oven

出炉.gloss: come fresh out of the oven

meanings.en: come fresh out of the oven
meanings.note: Pinyin: chū lú. Literally 'exit the oven' (刚出炉 'freshly baked').

examples.text: 刚出炉的：星期五柠檬蛋糕，多切了边角！
examples.trans: Fresh from the oven: Friday lemon cake, with extra corner pieces!

examples.text: 第一盘肉桂卷刚从烤箱出炉。
examples.trans: The first tray of cinnamon rolls has just come out of the oven.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chū zū chē. Measure word (量词): 辆 (liàng), e.g. 一辆出租车 ('a taxi').

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

examples.text: 一辆黄色出租车刚停在铁大门外头！
examples.trans: A yellow taxi just pulled up outside the iron gate!

meanings.en: go out the door; head out
meanings.note: Pinyin: chū mén. Separable verb-object compound for leaving home or the inn.

examples.text: 你们守着，我出门啦！
examples.trans: Hold the fort—I am heading out the door!

examples.text: 出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
examples.trans: Left out the gate, straight to the bridge. Do I cross the river?

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēn. Counts clock minutes (五分), test/review points (十分), and currency cents.

examples.text: 十、十一、十二。一分不差，谢谢！
examples.trans: Ten, eleven, twelve. Exact to the last cent—thank you!

examples.text: 我手表七点二十九分。客人下楼了。
examples.trans: Seven twenty-nine on my watch. Guests are coming down the stairs.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēn chéng. Resultative compound 分 ('divide') + 成 ('into / become').

examples.text: 小美把热柠檬挞分成了八小块。
examples.trans: Mei divided the warm lemon tart into eight small pieces.

examples.text: 我们可以把大扫除分成三个简单的步骤。
examples.trans: We can divide the big cleanup into three simple steps.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēn bèi. Acoustic unit measuring sound volume; takes numbers directly.

examples.text: 仔细看这一页——记的是分贝和安静度，不是酒店星级！
examples.trans: Look closely at this page—it records decibels and quietness, not hotel stars!

examples.text: 分贝？所以九分不是给我前台服务打的分？
examples.trans: Decibels? So nine points was not a score for my front-desk service?

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēn zhōng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 五分钟 ('five minutes').

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiē. Used for slicing bread, cake, fruit, or vegetables with a knife.

examples.text: 他爷爷会切热柠檬蛋糕，上面撒一层白糖粉！
examples.trans: His grandfather sliced warm lemon cake with a dusting of powdered sugar on top!

examples.text: 刚出炉的：星期五柠檬蛋糕，多切了边角！
examples.trans: Fresh from the oven: Friday lemon cake, with extra corner pieces!

列.gloss: measure word for trains and rows

meanings.en: measure word for trains and rows
meanings.note: Pinyin: liè. Counts multi-car trains and lined-up series (一列火车 'a train').

examples.text: 五分钟演讲稿，列了十九条理由解释那年春天我们都错了。
examples.trans: A five-minute speech listing nineteen reasons why we were both wrong that spring.

examples.text: 下一列火车八点到站。
examples.trans: The next train arrives at the station at eight o'clock.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāng. Placed right before a verb to show the action happened moments ago.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

examples.text: 一到七号钥匙全拿走了，八号房刚刷了油漆。
examples.trans: Every key from one to seven is taken, and room eight just got fresh paint.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāng cái. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 刚才那一刻 ('that moment just now').

examples.text: 谢谢你，小美。刚才吓了一跳，手都凉了！
examples.trans: Thank you, Mei. That gave me such a start just now that my hands went cold!

examples.text: 您刚才忘在楼下前台汤碗旁边了。
examples.trans: You left it downstairs beside the soup bowl at the front desk.

related.gloss: that moment just now (measure word 个)

meanings.note: Pinyin: bié. Most commonly means 'do not' in polite commands (别担心 'don't worry'); as a verb, 'pin/clip on'.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 您先坐下，别着急，我们马上看行李牌。
examples.trans: Please sit down first and do not worry; we will check the luggage tag right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bié rén. Refers to someone else ('other people').

examples.text: 让我猜猜，你把没有的房间答应给别人了？
examples.trans: Let me guess: you promised someone a room we do not have?

examples.text: 别拿错了别人的蓝色行李箱。
examples.trans: Be careful not to take someone else's blue suitcase by mistake.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Works as main verb ('arrive') or result complement ('succeed in reaching/perceiving', 找到, 听到).

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房今天到。
examples.trans: Right, eight guest rooms, eight brass keys. Room four arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào chù. Usually pairs with 都 ('everywhere').

examples.text: 啊，我的皮笔记本！谢谢！我正到处找呢。
examples.trans: Oh, my leather notebook! Thank you! I was looking everywhere for it.

examples.text: 我到处找眼镜，原来在桌子上。
examples.trans: I looked everywhere for my glasses, and they were on the table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào dǐ. Adds urgent curiosity inside a question (到底在哪儿？ 'where on earth is it?').

examples.text: 老弟，你到底撞进了一家什么神奇客栈？
examples.trans: Little brother, what kind of magical inn did you stumble into?

examples.text: 这家客栈向来只有八间客房！九号房到底在哪儿？！
examples.trans: This inn has only ever had eight guest rooms! Where on earth is Room Nine?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuā. Used for painting walls, brushing, or swiping a card.

examples.text: 一到七号钥匙全拿走了，八号房刚刷了油漆。
examples.trans: Every key from one to seven is taken, and room eight just got fresh paint.

examples.text: 周末我们要刷院子里的木门。
examples.trans: This weekend we are going to paint the wooden courtyard gate.

刷漆.gloss: paint; apply paint with a brush

meanings.en: paint; apply paint with a brush
meanings.note: Pinyin: shuā qī. Separable verb-object compound 刷 ('brush') + 漆 ('paint/lacquer').

examples.text: 天晴的时候最适合给木头窗板刷漆。
examples.trans: Clear sunny weather is best for painting wooden shutters.

examples.text: 老陈戴上手套，准备给旧木门刷漆。
examples.trans: Chen put on gloves and got ready to paint the old wooden door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kè. Used as a verb for carving wood/stone (刻着) or noun/classifier for 15 minutes (一刻).

examples.text: 等一下……梧桐巷十二号，角上还刻着两个小时候的缩写！
examples.trans: Wait a moment... Number twelve, Wutong Lane, with two childhood initials carved on the corner!

examples.text: 木头盒上刻着他的名字。
examples.trans: His name is carved onto the wooden box.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个前面 ('a front side').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián tái. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个前台 ('a front desk').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 您刚才忘在楼下前台汤碗旁边了。
examples.trans: You left it downstairs beside the soup bowl at the front desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最前面 ('the very front').

examples.text: 前面锁扣有个小锁孔，再看底下贴着：一把旧铜钥匙！
examples.trans: There is a tiny keyhole on the front latch, and taped underneath: an old brass key!

examples.text: 前面路口往右拐就是火车站。
examples.trans: Turn right at the intersection ahead and you are at the station.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shèng. Describes time, items, or money remaining (只剩五分钟 'only five minutes left').

examples.text: 而且他坐晚上八点的火车到——只剩四十分钟了！
examples.trans: And he arrives on the eight o'clock evening train—only forty minutes left!

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎn. Action verb specifically for cutting with two-bladed scissors, shears, or clippers.

examples.text: 别剪那根绿藤条，把它放到花架上吧。
examples.trans: Don't cut that green vine; lift it onto the trellis.

examples.text: 小晴从院子里剪了两枝新鲜薄荷。
examples.trans: Qing snipped two sprigs of fresh mint from the courtyard.

副.gloss: measure word for glasses, sets, expressions

meanings.en: measure word for glasses, sets, expressions
meanings.note: Pinyin: fù. Counts eyeglasses, gloves, chess sets, and facial expressions (一副眼镜 'a pair of glasses').

examples.text: 法律条文我戴两副眼镜看都头疼！
examples.trans: Legal clauses give me a headache even with two pairs of glasses!

examples.text: 桌子上放着一副旧眼镜。
examples.trans: A pair of old glasses is sitting on the table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lì qi. Combines 力 ('force/strength') + neutral-tone 气 ('energy').

examples.text: 搬这张厚木桌需要不少力气。
examples.trans: Moving this thick wooden table takes quite a bit of strength.

examples.text: 开旧锁要靠巧劲，光用力气可不行。
examples.trans: Opening an old lock takes knack; sheer muscle alone won't do.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bàn shì yuán. Combines 办事 ('handle official business') + agent suffix 员 ('staff member').

examples.text: 市政厅的办事员星期三下午三点过来检查。
examples.trans: The city hall clerk is coming over at three on Wednesday afternoon to inspect.

examples.text: 窗口的办事员耐心地帮我们填好了表格。
examples.trans: The clerk at the counter patiently helped us fill out the form.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bàn gōng shì. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间办公室 ('an office').

examples.text: 失陪一下，宋老师，我先回办公室整理一下！
examples.trans: Excuse me a moment, Teacher Song; I shall step back to my office to tidy up!

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bàn gōng lóu. Measure word (量词): 栋 (dòng), e.g. 一栋办公楼 ('an office building').

examples.text: 产权转让通知：八号小院整栋建筑将作为商业办公楼出售。
examples.trans: Property Transfer Notice: Courtyard Building Eight offered for sale as commercial offices.

examples.text: 商业办公楼出售？！把我们的客栈和厨房变成灰色办公室？！
examples.trans: Commercial office sale?! Turn our inn and kitchen into grey offices?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiā. Used for adding sugar, milk, or extra items (加糖 'add sugar').

examples.text: 请给我不加糖的红茶，再来一片热面包。
examples.trans: Black tea without added sugar, please, and one slice of warm bread.

examples.text: 太好了！请加牛奶和一点糖。
examples.trans: Wonderful! With milk and a little sugar, please.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiā bèi. Means doubling an effort or amount.

examples.text: 哎呀！透过窗户看见周经理了？我明明加倍用力微笑了！
examples.trans: Oh dear! You spotted Manager Zhou through the window? I smiled twice as wide!

examples.text: 有了好搭档，干活效率加倍。
examples.trans: With a great partner, our work goes twice as fast.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dòng. Used for physical movement (别动 'don't move!').

examples.text: 全都别动！现在几点？九点三十五分！
examples.trans: Hold everything! What time is it right now? Nine thirty-five!
