examples.text: 别动，你们俩。听到路边汽车停下的声音了吗？
examples.trans: Hold still, both of you. Hear that car engine stopping at the curb?

meanings.note: Pinyin: sháo. Used both as a noun (勺子 'spoon') and as a measure word for spoonfuls (一勺蜂蜜 'a spoonful of honey').

examples.text: 喝热柠檬茶的时候，加一勺蜂蜜最香。
examples.trans: Hot lemon tea smells best when you add a spoonful of honey.

examples.text: 请给我拿一把干净的小木勺。
examples.trans: Please bring me a clean little wooden spoon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sháo zi. Measure word (量词): 把 (bǎ), e.g. 一把勺子 ('a spoon').

examples.text: 小勺子和餐巾放在哪里？
examples.trans: Where do the small spoons and napkins go?

examples.text: 每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
examples.trans: Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bāo. As a verb, 'wrap up' (白纸包着); as a noun/classifier, 'bag/packet'.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

examples.text: 等一下，小晴……你拿了哪一包黄油？
examples.trans: Wait a second, Qing... which packet of butter did you grab?

meanings.note: Pinyin: bāo zhuāng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个包装 ('a wrapper / package').

examples.text: 最上面架子上金色包装那包。怎么了？
examples.trans: The gold-wrapped packet on the top shelf. Why?

examples.text: 哎呀！我跑得太急，包装看着都一样！
examples.trans: Oh no! I was running in such a rush that the wrappers all looked alike!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qū. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个区 ('a district').

examples.text: 真奇怪！我们坐同一班早火车到同一个区。
examples.trans: How strange! We rode the very same morning train to the same district.

examples.text: 我们住在安静的老城区。
examples.trans: We live in the quiet old district.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí. Cardinal number 10; building block for 11–99.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí èr. Cardinal number 十 ('ten') + 二 ('two').

examples.text: 阳光房里一共可以摆十二把木椅。
examples.trans: Twelve wooden chairs in all can be arranged in the sunroom.

examples.text: 一年有十二个月。
examples.trans: There are twelve months in a year.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí liù. Cardinal number 十 ('ten') + 六 ('six').

examples.text: 这首圆舞曲最后还缺少十六个小节。
examples.trans: This waltz is still missing sixteen bars at the end.

examples.text: 茶壶里泡的薄荷茶够倒十六小杯。
examples.trans: The mint tea steeped in the teapot is enough to pour sixteen small cups.

meanings.en: by all means; be sure (not) to
meanings.note: Pinyin: qiān wàn. Strong, caring emphasis before 别 or 要 (千万别忘 'whatever you do, don't forget').

examples.text: 我还没喝早咖啡呢，千万别说急事！
examples.trans: I have not had my morning coffee yet; please do not say emergency!

examples.text: 小美，千万别因为我们多忙活。
examples.trans: Mei, please do not go to extra trouble on our account.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shēng. Means 'rise' (太阳升起来) or 'promote' someone to a higher post (升职).

examples.text: 小晴做事认真，经理升她做正式前台。
examples.trans: Qing works conscientiously, so the manager promoted her to permanent receptionist.

examples.text: 太阳升起来以后，石板路很快就干了。
examples.trans: Once the sun rose, the flagstone path dried quickly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shēng zhí. Separable verb-object compound 升 ('rise/promote') + 职 ('post/rank').

examples.text: 哥哥上个月刚升职，请全家人吃了一顿晚饭。
examples.trans: My older brother just got promoted last month and treated the whole family to dinner.

examples.text: 她工作认真负责，很快就升职了。
examples.trans: She works conscientiously and was promoted before long.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǔ cān. Combines 午 ('noon') + 餐 ('meal'); slightly more formal/menu-friendly than 午饭.

examples.text: 咖啡角每天中午提供热汤和面包做午餐。
examples.trans: Every day at noon the café corner serves hot soup and bread for lunch.

examples.text: 我们星期天中午一起吃顿简单的午餐吧。
examples.trans: Let's have a simple lunch together at noon on Sunday.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǔ fàn. Measure word (量词): 顿 (dùn), e.g. 一顿午饭 ('a lunch').

examples.text: 午饭以后，两位能帮我们把地下室的桌子搬进来吗？
examples.trans: After lunch, could you two help us carry the cellar tables in?

examples.text: 老陈，午饭以前能修好吗？你有新的保险丝吧？
examples.trans: Chen, can you fix it before lunch? You do have new fuses, right?

meanings.note: Pinyin: bàn. Follows a measure word for 'and a half' (七点半 '7:30') or precedes a measure word for 'half a' (半个小时).

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bàn jià. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 半价优惠 ('a half-price rate').

examples.text: 今晚半价，而且一整周早餐免费！
examples.trans: Half price tonight, plus free breakfast all week!

examples.text: 因为我们的失误，今晚半价，还送早餐。
examples.trans: Because of our mistake, tonight is half price, with complimentary breakfast.

半夜.gloss: midnight; the middle of the night

meanings.en: midnight; the middle of the night
meanings.note: Pinyin: bàn yè. Everyday spoken noun 半 ('half') + 夜 ('night').

examples.text: 半夜突然下起了大雨，把院子的石板淋湿了。
examples.trans: Heavy rain suddenly started at midnight and wet the courtyard flagstones.

examples.text: 半夜街上很安静，连一辆车都没有。
examples.trans: At midnight the street is quiet, without a single car.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dān zi. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张单子 ('a list').

examples.text: 看我的单子：两桶绿油漆，十二个简单的杯子，还有市场的柠檬。
examples.trans: Look at my list: two cans of green paint, twelve simple cups, and lemons from the market.

examples.text: 请在这张单子上写您的名字。
examples.trans: Please write your name on this form.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mài. Everyday verb for selling goods; fourth tone contrasts with 买 (mǎi 'buy').

examples.text: 三年前爷爷去世以后，我和志鹏因为卖老房子大吵了一架。
examples.trans: Three years ago after Grandfather passed away, Zhipeng and I argued bitterly over selling the old house.

examples.text: 我以为卖房子时早就丢了！为什么一直替我留着？
examples.trans: I thought it was lost long ago when we sold the house! Why keep it for me?

meanings.note: Pinyin: nán fāng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 南方地区 ('a southern region').

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

examples.text: 成都冬天没有北方那么干，属于南方气候。
examples.trans: Chengdu winters are milder and belong to southern China's climate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhàn. Read 4th-tone zhàn when meaning 'take up space or time' (占地方 'take up room').

examples.text: 这张大圆桌占了客厅一半的地方。
examples.trans: This big round table takes up half the space in the living room.

examples.text: 折叠椅收起来以后一点也不占地方。
examples.trans: Once folded up, the folding chairs take up almost no space at all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kǎ. Read 3rd-tone qiǎ or colloquial kǎ when something gets wedged tight in a slot, hinge, or latch.

examples.text: 硬币卡在抽屉缝里，拿不出来了。
examples.trans: The coin got wedged in the drawer crack and won't come out.

examples.text: 有一张旧纸卡在木头合页后面。
examples.trans: An old sheet of paper is wedged behind the wooden hinge.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiǎ zhù. Describes a door handle, zipper, or hinge jamming (also spoken kǎ zhù).

examples.text: 星期一你打开了卡住的门；这一周你救了客房、水管、早餐和租约。
examples.trans: On Monday you opened our sticking door; this week you saved rooms, pipes, breakfast, and our lease.

examples.text: 抽屉被一本厚账本卡住了。
examples.trans: The drawer got jammed on a thick ledger.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kǎ kòu. Mechanical catch, buckle, or side latch that locks a folding frame or lid in place.

examples.text: 轻轻按下金属卡扣，椅子就能收起来。
examples.trans: Press the metal latch lightly and the chair folds right up.

examples.text: 背包上的塑料卡扣扣得很紧。
examples.trans: The plastic buckle on the backpack snaps shut tightly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kǎ chē. Phonosemantic compound 卡 (from English 'car/cart') + 车 ('wheeled vehicle').

examples.text: 清早有一辆送蔬菜的小卡车停在巷口。
examples.trans: Early in the morning a small vegetable truck stopped at the lane entrance.

examples.text: 重卡车开过老街时，窗户都会轻轻震动。
examples.trans: When a heavy truck drives down the old street, the windows vibrate slightly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yìn zhāng. Measure word (量词): 枚, e.g. 一枚印章 ('a seal / stamp').

examples.text: 邮递员刚让我签收的，上面盖着红色房产印章。
examples.trans: The postman just had me sign for it; it carries a red property-office stamp.

examples.text: 通知右下角盖着一枚圆印章。
examples.trans: A round official stamp sits in the bottom-right corner of the notice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: què. Always sits AFTER the subject and BEFORE the verb to mark contrast ('yet, surprisingly').

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 没错。外面大街很吵，进了院子却只听见树叶和小鸟。
examples.trans: Exactly. Outside on the main road it is noisy, yet inside the courtyard you only hear leaves and birds.

meanings.note: Pinyin: juǎn. Read 3rd-tone juǎn as the measure word for rolled items (一卷胶带 'a roll of tape', 一卷纸 'a roll of paper').

examples.text: 工具箱里还有半卷黑色的胶带。
examples.trans: There is still half a roll of black tape in the toolbox.

examples.text: 画家把三卷白纸放进了布袋里。
examples.trans: The painter put three rolls of white paper into a cloth bag.

meanings.note: Pinyin: juán chǐ. Measure word (量词): 把 (bǎ), e.g. 一把卷尺 ('a tape measure').

examples.text: 我弟弟早饭还没吃完，就拿着卷尺跑下来了。
examples.trans: My little brother grabbed his tape measure before he even finished breakfast.

examples.text: 老陈用卷尺量了一下门。
examples.trans: Chen measured the door with a tape measure.

meanings.note: Pinyin: juǎn lián mén. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇卷帘门 ('a rolling shutter').

examples.text: 太好了！卷帘门开了吗？
examples.trans: Great! Is the shutter open?

examples.text: 早上八点，五金店准时拉开了铁卷帘门。
examples.trans: At eight sharp, the hardware shop pulled up its rolling metal shutter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiè. Means taking parts off a frame/hinge (卸下来) or unloading cargo from a vehicle.

examples.text: 老陈先把旧木窗板从合页上卸下来打磨。
examples.trans: Chen first took the old wooden shutters off their hinges to sand them.

examples.text: 工人们正在把木箱从卡车上卸下来。
examples.trans: The workers are unloading the wooden crates from the truck.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lì shǐ. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 一段历史 ('a stretch of history').

examples.text: 一位研究成都历史小院建筑的建筑师啊！
examples.trans: An architect who studies historic courtyard buildings in Chengdu!

examples.text: 这条老街已经有两百年的历史了。
examples.trans: This old street already has two hundred years of history.

related.gloss: a stretch of history (measure word 段)

meanings.note: Pinyin: yā lì. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种压力 ('a kind of pressure').

examples.text: 坏消息。老热水器上的铜压力阀门裂了。
examples.trans: Bad news. The brass pressure valve on the old water heater cracked.

examples.text: 换了新阀门，三楼的水压没有压力问题了。
examples.trans: With the new valve in place, the upstairs water pressure is steady.

related.gloss: a kind of pressure (measure word 种)

meanings.note: Pinyin: hòu. Describes thick coats, walls, books, or blankets.

examples.text: 我床上有厚被子，今晚睡着很舒服。
examples.trans: I have a thick quilt on my bed, so sleeping tonight is very comfortable.

examples.text: 我在看天气，小美！铃铛旁边这封厚信是谁放的？
examples.trans: I am checking the weather, Mei! Who put this thick letter beside the bell?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hòu hòu. Vivid reduplication of 厚 ('thick'), usually followed by 的 before a noun (厚厚的杯子).

examples.text: 冬天盖着厚厚的棉被睡得真香。
examples.trans: Sleeping under a nice thick quilt in winter is so cosy.

examples.text: 这种厚厚的白瓷碗端在手里不烫。
examples.trans: This kind of thick white porcelain bowl doesn't burn your hands when held.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuán lái. Marks an 'aha!' discovery ('so it was X all along!').

examples.text: 原来星期五的神秘客人一直睡在我阁楼屋顶下面。
examples.trans: So our mystery Friday caller was sleeping under my attic roof all along.

examples.text: 原来留着爷爷旧物的神秘人一直是你，志豪。
examples.trans: So the mystery person holding Grandfather's keepsake was you all along, Zhihao.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chú fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间厨房 ('a kitchen').

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 糟了！周经理，小晴，厨房出急事了！
examples.trans: Oh no! Manager Zhou, Qing, we have a kitchen emergency!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qù. Movement away from the speaker, as main verb (去车站) or directional complement (上去).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 晚上九点？你站这儿，我们一起去开门。
examples.trans: Nine in the evening? Stay right here; let us go open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qù shì. Respectful verb meaning 'die / pass away'.

examples.text: 三年前爷爷去世以后，我和志鹏因为卖老房子大吵了一架。
examples.trans: Three years ago after Grandfather passed away, Zhipeng and I argued bitterly over selling the old house.

examples.text: 老房子是爷爷去世前留给他们的。
examples.trans: The old house was left to them before their grandfather passed away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu. Marks an action repeating, or pairs two qualities in 又A又B ('both A and B').

examples.text: 真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
examples.trans: Is that really alright? It looks both lovely and warm!

examples.text: 又是深蓝色行李箱！这是宋老师的吗？
examples.trans: Another dark-blue suitcase! Is this Teacher Song's?

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuāng. Counts naturally paired items: shoes, socks, chopsticks, hands (一双皮鞋 'a pair of leather shoes').

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

examples.text: 天哪……看这双眼睛！第三级台阶上的小志豪？！
examples.trans: Good heavens... look at those eyes! Little Zhihao from the third step?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuāng bāo tāi. Measure word (量词): 对 (duì), e.g. 一对双胞胎 ('a pair of twins').

examples.text: 呀，这就是星期一火车上那只双胞胎箱子吗？
examples.trans: Oh, is this that twin suitcase from Monday's train?

examples.text: 这两个蓝箱子长得就像一对双胞胎。
examples.trans: Those two blue suitcases look just like a pair of twins.

related.gloss: a pair of twins (measure word 对)

meanings.note: Pinyin: fǎn yìng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个反应 ('a reaction').

examples.text: 呼，好在反应快，早餐又有救了！
examples.trans: Phew, quick thinking saves breakfast once again!

examples.text: 听到这个好消息，大家的反应都很开心。
examples.trans: Hearing the good news, everyone reacted with joy.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fā dǒu. Describes hands or voice trembling from cold or nerves.

examples.text: 我手在发抖——车上下来穿深灰色外套的高个子男人吗？
examples.trans: My hands are shaking—is a tall man in a dark grey coat stepping out?

examples.text: 外面风太大，他冷得手有点发抖。
examples.trans: The wind outside was so cold his hands shivered slightly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fā huǒ. Literally 'emit fire'.

examples.text: 怎么样？他发火了吗？要退钱吗？
examples.trans: How did it go? Did he lose his temper? Did he ask for a refund?

examples.text: 遇到急事也要冷静，别乱发火。
examples.trans: Stay calm in an emergency instead of losing your temper.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fā xiàn. Used when noticing a clue or uncovering an object.

examples.text: 椅子找到了——在一堵旧砖墙后面，我还发现了这个。
examples.trans: Found the chairs—and behind an old brick partition wall, I also uncovered this.

examples.text: 打扫地下室的时候，他发现了一个旧木盒。
examples.trans: While cleaning the cellar, he discovered an old wooden box.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fā chē. Verb-object compound 发 ('dispatch/set out') + 车 ('train/bus') for scheduled departures.

examples.text: 去成都东站的那趟火车晚上七点发车。
examples.trans: That train to Chengdu East Station departs at seven in the evening.

examples.text: 请大家提前十分钟上车，大巴马上发车。
examples.trans: Please board ten minutes early; the coach is about to depart.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fā ruǎn. Describes knees going weak or wet cardboard softening.

examples.text: 啊……不好。我的椅子在哪儿？我腿发软。
examples.trans: Oh... oh no. Where is my chair? My legs feel weak.

examples.text: 纸箱淋了雨，边角有点发软。
examples.trans: Caught in the rain, the corners of the carton went soft.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shū shu. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位叔叔 ('an uncle').

examples.text: 我想起来了！我十岁的时候，叔叔叫它冬天茶室！
examples.trans: Now I remember! When I was ten, my uncle called it the winter tea room!

examples.text: 我叔叔在成都开了一家小饭馆。
examples.trans: My uncle runs a small restaurant in Chengdu.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shòu. Used for experiencing or enduring conditions.

examples.text: 那你们的客栈租约就受市里法律再保护十年！
examples.trans: Then your inn lease is protected by city law for another ten years!

examples.text: 这间咖啡馆很受街坊欢迎。
examples.trans: This café is very popular with the neighbors.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shòu cháo. Verb-object compound 受 ('be affected by') + 潮 ('dampness/moisture').

examples.text: 木头琴键受潮以后就容易卡住。
examples.trans: Once wooden piano keys absorb dampness, they easily stick.

examples.text: 饼干要放进密封罐里，免得受潮变软。
examples.trans: Keep the biscuits in an airtight jar so they don't get damp and soft.

meanings.note: Pinyin: biàn. Describes a shift in state (变凉 'turn cool', 变成 'turn into').

examples.text: 我刚试了洗手池水龙头，水先是温的，马上变凉了。
examples.trans: I just tested the sink tap—the water started warm, then turned cool right away.

examples.text: 我一紧张，句子就变得又长又正式！
examples.trans: Whenever I get nervous, my sentences turn long and formal!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dié. Used for folding cloth or paper and for piling things up (叠衣服 'fold clothes').

examples.text: 宋老师，小心脚下。请帮我叠这块白布。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, watch your step. Please help me fold this white sheet.

examples.text: 小美把干净的毛巾叠好了。
examples.trans: Mei folded the clean towels neatly.

meanings.en: mouth; doorway; measure word for sips/breaths
meanings.note: Pinyin: kǒu. Counts mouthfuls of food/tea, breaths of air (一口气), or family members.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

examples.text: 宋老师早上好！看昨晚大门口送来了什么。
examples.trans: Good morning, Teacher Song! Look what arrived at our front gate last night.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kǒu dài. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个口袋 ('a pocket').

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

句.gloss: measure word for sentences and remarks

meanings.en: measure word for sentences and remarks
meanings.note: Pinyin: jù. Counts spoken or written sentences (一句话 'one sentence / a word').

examples.text: 先说三句短话。第一句：你好，志鹏，谢谢你来。
examples.trans: Start with three short lines. First: Hello, Zhipeng, thank you for coming.

examples.text: 你好，志鹏，谢谢你来。好，这句记得住。
examples.trans: Hello, Zhipeng, thank you for coming. Okay, I can remember that line.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jù zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个句子 ('a sentence').

examples.text: 我一紧张，句子就变得又长又正式！
examples.trans: Whenever I get nervous, my sentences turn long and formal!

examples.text: 请用这个新词写一个简单的句子。
examples.trans: Please write a simple sentence with this new word.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lìng wài. Before a number + measure word, means 'the other…' (另外两把 'the other two chairs').

examples.text: 这六把椅子放院子，另外六把放屋里。
examples.trans: Put these six chairs in the courtyard and the other six indoors.

examples.text: 我买了一袋苹果，另外还买了一罐果酱。
examples.trans: I bought a bag of apples, and in addition a jar of jam.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ. Read zhǐ as the adverb 'only' before verbs, and zhī as a measure word for cups, boxes, and small animals.

examples.text: 而且他坐晚上八点的火车到——只剩四十分钟了！
examples.trans: And he arrives on the eight o'clock evening train—only forty minutes left!

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ shì. Softens an explanation ('I simply…').

examples.text: 不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
examples.trans: It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!

examples.text: 我只是检查安全。这是我的工作。
examples.trans: I am simply checking security. That is my job.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhí yǒu. Combines 只 ('only') with 有 ('have / there is').

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ yào. Pairs with 就 in the next clause: 只要…就… ('as long as…, then…').

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

examples.text: 只要一点黄油，谢谢。周经理，您怎么老看手表？
examples.trans: Just a little butter, thank you. Manager Zhou, why do you keep looking at your watch?

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiào. Introduces a person's given or full name (我叫小晴 'My name is Xiaoqing') or calls a cab.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kě. Adds emphatic warmth before an adjective/verb, or means 'but'.

examples.text: 我可不穿四十四码的鞋！
examples.trans: I certainly do not wear size forty-four shoes!

examples.text: 今天外面的风可真大。
examples.trans: The wind outside today is really strong.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ké yǐ. Polite modal verb for asking or granting permission (可以吗？ 'Is that alright?').

examples.text: 真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
examples.trans: Is that really alright? It looks both lovely and warm!

examples.text: 阁楼书房？我可以先上去看看吗？
examples.trans: An attic study? May I go up and see it first?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kě lián. Often used affectionately or playfully ('poor Chen!') as well as genuinely ('pitiful').

examples.text: 可怜的周经理急得连手里的咖啡杯都忘了。
examples.trans: Poor Manager Zhou was so flustered he forgot the coffee cup in his hand.

examples.text: 那只淋了雨的小猫看起来真可怜。
examples.trans: That little cat caught in the rain looked truly pitiful.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kě xī. Expresses sympathetic regret.

examples.text: 可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
examples.trans: Unfortunately there is no phone number, only two letters and an old street name.

examples.text: 真可惜，最后一盘柠檬蛋糕刚卖完。
examples.trans: What a pity—the last plate of lemon cake just sold out.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kě shì. Conversational 'but' introducing a contrast.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 外面一模一样，可是你看里面！
examples.trans: The outside is identical, yet look inside!

meanings.note: Pinyin: tái dēng. Measure word (量词): 盏 (zhǎn), e.g. 一盏台灯 ('a desk lamp').

examples.text: 好：有床、桌子和椅子，可是没有床头台灯。
examples.trans: Okay: there is a bed, a table, and a chair, yet no bedside lamp.

examples.text: 楼下我的工具房里有一盏铜台灯。
examples.trans: Downstairs in my workshop there is a brass desk lamp.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tái jiē. Measure word (量词): 级 (jí), e.g. 一级台阶 ('a step').

examples.text: 等等，低头看石头台阶上。
examples.trans: Wait—look down on the stone step.

examples.text: 我们不知道。有人放在台阶上，按了门铃。
examples.trans: We do not know. Someone set it on the step and rang the bell.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu. Pairs with 往 or 边: 往右 ('to the right'), 右边 ('the right side'); opposite of 左.

examples.text: 往右用力转一下……开了！
examples.trans: One firm turn to the right... and it's open!

examples.text: 过了桥往右走。
examples.trans: After the bridge, go right.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu shǒu. Measure word (量词): 只 (zhǐ), e.g. 一只右手 ('a right hand').

examples.text: 对，过了桥，右手边会经过一家绿药店。
examples.trans: Right, after crossing the bridge, you pass a green pharmacy on your right.

examples.text: 进大门往右手边看就是前台。
examples.trans: Step through the main gate and look to your right for the front desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu bian. Measure word (量词): 边 (biān), e.g. 右边 ('the right side').

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

examples.text: 挂在书桌右边吧，那里光线好。
examples.trans: Hang it to the right of the desk, where the light is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hào. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个号码 ('a number').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房今天到。
examples.trans: Right, eight guest rooms, eight brass keys. Room four arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hào mǎ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个号码 ('a number').

examples.text: 上面有名字或者电话号码吗？
examples.trans: Is there a name or a phone number on it?

examples.text: 可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
examples.trans: Unfortunately there is no phone number, only two letters and an old street name.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sī jī. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi) or 个 (gè), e.g. 一位司机 ('a driver').

examples.text: 送货司机把木箱轻轻放在大门口。
examples.trans: The delivery driver set the wooden crate gently at the front gate.

examples.text: 出租车司机很熟悉这条老街。
examples.trans: The taxi driver knows this old street very well.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chī. Everyday verb for eating meals, bread, or snacks.

examples.text: 太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
examples.trans: Wonderful! Now I would like to eat a big breakfast.

examples.text: 先喝杯热茶，吃个肉桂卷坐十分钟吧！
examples.trans: Have a cup of hot tea and a cinnamon roll for ten minutes first!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Used for closing a book/lid (合上) or matching parts together.

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 快合上送上去——等等，那是什么金属响声？
examples.trans: Close it quickly and take it up—wait, what was that metallic clanking sound?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé tong. Measure word (量词): 份 (fèn), e.g. 一份合同 ('a contract').

examples.text: 房产信？让志豪和我看看——我管市政合同，他懂老建筑保护法！
examples.trans: A property letter? Let Zhihao and me see it—I handle municipal contracts, and he knows heritage building law!

examples.text: 等等，志鹏——你还在市政厅合同科工作？！
examples.trans: Wait, Zhipeng—you still work at City Hall's contract office?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé shì. Describes clothes fitting well or an arrangement suiting everyone.

examples.text: 宋老师，您穿着很合适。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, it fits you very well.

examples.text: 弄好了！蓝地毯放在床旁边正合适。
examples.trans: Done! And the blue rug right beside the bed fits just right.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé yè. Measure word (量词): 副 (fù), e.g. 一副合页 ('a set of hinges').

examples.text: 看合页边露出来的折纸图纸——一楼画着一扇暗门！
examples.trans: Look at the folded blueprint sticking out of the hinge—a hidden door is drawn on the ground floor!

examples.text: 给老木门的合页上点油就不响了。
examples.trans: Put a drop of oil on the wooden door's hinges and they stop squeaking.

related.gloss: a set of hinges (measure word 副)

meanings.note: Pinyin: tóng. Combines with 一 + measure word to mean 'the very same' (同一个 'the same one').

examples.text: 真奇怪！我们坐同一班早火车到同一个区。
examples.trans: How strange! We rode the very same morning train to the same district.

examples.text: 二十五年前？就在同一栋房子里？
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago? Right inside that very same house?

meanings.note: Pinyin: tóng shì. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位同事 ('a colleague').

examples.text: 下周我保证把半个市政厅的同事都带来小美这儿喝咖啡。
examples.trans: Next week I promise to bring half my City Hall colleagues to Mei's tables.

examples.text: 我的两位新同事都特别热心。
examples.trans: Both of my new colleagues are wonderfully warm-hearted.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tóng yì. Combines 同 ('same') + 意 ('thought/intent').

examples.text: 周经理立刻同意让宋老师补写那首圆舞曲。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou immediately agreed to let Teacher Song complete that waltz.

examples.text: 大家都同意星期三用扁豆汤做午餐。
examples.trans: Everyone agreed on serving lentil soup for Wednesday's lunch.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tóng shí. Combines 同 ('same') + 时 ('time').

examples.text: 两个人同时伸手去拿最后一块杏仁饼干。
examples.trans: The two of them reached for the last almond biscuit at the same time.

examples.text: 那场大雨弄坏了屋顶，同时还淋湿了钢琴。
examples.trans: That heavy rain damaged the roof and wet the piano at the same time.

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng dān. Measure word (量词): 份 (fèn), e.g. 一份名单 ('a guest list').

examples.text: 下雨的时候，纸不会弄丢房间名单。
examples.trans: When it rains, paper will not lose the room list.

examples.text: 今天的住店客人名单在电脑里。
examples.trans: Today's guest list is on the computer.

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个名字 ('a name').

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 上面有名字或者电话号码吗？
examples.trans: Is there a name or a phone number on it?

后半段.gloss: second half (of a song, road, or event)

meanings.en: second half (of a song, road, or event)
meanings.note: Pinyin: hòu bàn duàn. Combines 后 ('back/latter') + 半 ('half') + 段 ('section/stretch').

examples.text: 这首曲子的后半段比开头更温柔。
examples.trans: The second half of this piece is gentler than the opening.

examples.text: 电影的后半段让大家都看入迷了。
examples.trans: The second half of the film captivated everyone.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hòu lái. Time noun referring exclusively to what happened later in the PAST (unlike 以后, which works for past or future).

examples.text: 起初天还晴着，后来半夜就下起了大雨。
examples.trans: At first the sky was clear, and then later at midnight heavy rain began.

examples.text: 后来客栈住满了客人，那间屋子就一直锁着。
examples.trans: Later the inn filled with guests, and that room stayed locked.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hòu mén. Combines 后 ('back/rear') + 门 ('door').

examples.text: 后门旁边挂着一盏防风的旧灯笼。
examples.trans: An old windproof lantern hangs beside the back door.

examples.text: 从厨房的后门出去就是小院子。
examples.trans: Stepping out through the kitchen's back door leads right into the small courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hòu mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最后面 ('the very back').

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

examples.text: 志豪先生！您一直站在后面吗？！
examples.trans: Mr Zhihao! Were you standing right there behind us?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàng. Preposition or verb complement indicating direction of movement or orientation (歪向一边 'lean toward one side').

examples.text: 向日葵总是朝着太阳的方向生长。
examples.trans: Sunflowers always grow toward the sun.

examples.text: 小晴笑着向窗外的朋友们挥了挥手。
examples.trans: Qing smiled and waved toward her friends outside the window.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàng lái. Emphasizes how something has always been up to now.

examples.text: 这家客栈向来只有八间客房！九号房到底在哪儿？！
examples.trans: This inn has only ever had eight guest rooms! Where on earth is Room Nine?!

examples.text: 他做事向来又仔细又稳重。
examples.trans: He has always been careful and steady in his work.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàng yáng. Literally 'facing the sun'—prized for warm rooms in China.

examples.text: 那间向阳的旧阁楼书房……快跟我来！
examples.trans: That sunny old attic study... follow me, quickly!

examples.text: 快坐在向阳窗户边，宋老师！先别急着上楼！
examples.trans: Sit right down by the sunny window, Teacher Song! No rush to go back upstairs yet!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià. Used when a sudden noise or surprise startles someone.

examples.text: 谢谢你，小美。刚才吓了一跳，手都凉了！
examples.trans: Thank you, Mei. That gave me such a start just now that my hands went cold!

examples.text: 刚才的响声吓了我一跳。
examples.trans: That noise just now gave me a start.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ma. Placed at the end of any statement to turn it into a neutral yes/no question.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ba. At the end of a sentence, softens commands into friendly suggestions ('let's…') or asks for confirmation.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tīng. Focuses on the act of listening; add 见 or 到 (听见, 听到) for actually hearing.

examples.text: 老陈，你听到了吗？有人按了大门门铃！
examples.trans: Chen, did you hear that? Someone rang the front gate bell!

examples.text: 我在院子里老远就听到你们喊黄油了。
examples.trans: All the way out in the courtyard I heard you shouting about butter.

meanings.en: have a listen; listen a bit
meanings.note: Pinyin: tīng ting. Reduplicated verb making an invitation to listen warm and unhurried.

examples.text: 听听他说的！老陈比我们好奇两倍！
examples.trans: Listen to him! Chen is twice as curious as we are!

examples.text: 听听保养大师说的！昨天修热水器，今天修两兄弟！
examples.trans: Listen to the maintenance master! Yesterday fixing the boiler, today fixing two brothers!

meanings.note: Pinyin: tīng jiàn. Result compound: 听 ('listen') + 见 ('perceive') = 'actually hear'.

examples.text: 没错。外面大街很吵，进了院子却只听见树叶和小鸟。
examples.trans: Exactly. Outside on the main road it is noisy, yet inside the courtyard you only hear leaves and birds.

examples.text: 关上木窗就听不见外面的车声了。
examples.trans: Close the wooden window and you cannot hear the street traffic.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tīng shuō. Everyday opener for news heard from someone else.

examples.text: 等周经理听说他为分贝慌了一整夜，表情一定精彩！
examples.trans: Wait until Manager Zhou hears he panicked all night over decibels!

examples.text: 听说街角新开了一家面包店。
examples.trans: I heard a new bakery opened on the street corner.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chǎo. Describes noisy streets or rooms, or arguing aloud.

examples.text: 说真的，我怕一楼吵。我太喜欢这间房了！
examples.trans: Truthfully, I dislike noisy ground-floor rooms. I love this room!

examples.text: 没错。外面大街很吵，进了院子却只听见树叶和小鸟。
examples.trans: Exactly. Outside on the main road it is noisy, yet inside the courtyard you only hear leaves and birds.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cháo xǐng. Result compound: 吵 ('noisy') + 醒 ('awake'); the person woken follows (吵醒客人 'wake the guests').

examples.text: 那么小美的咖啡馆和宋老师的钢琴，不会吵醒楼上的客人吧？
examples.trans: So Mei's café and Teacher Song's piano won't wake the guests upstairs?

examples.text: 对不起，我把你吵醒了吗？
examples.trans: Sorry, did I wake you up?

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuī. Used for wind blowing or blowing on hot tea.

examples.text: 热汤？在冷站台吹了风，喝碗热汤太好了。
examples.trans: Hot soup? After the cold wind on the station platform, hot soup sounds wonderful.

examples.text: 晚上院子里吹着凉风。
examples.trans: A cool breeze blows through the courtyard in the evening.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ya. Gentle exclamation of surprise or realization.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 呀，这就是星期一火车上那只双胞胎箱子吗？
examples.trans: Oh, is this that twin suitcase from Monday's train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: gào su. Takes a person directly followed by the information (告诉我 'tell me').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: ne. After a noun, asks 'what about X?' (你呢？); at the end of a statement, highlights an ongoing situation.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōu. Surname of Manager Zhou (周经理); as a noun/classifier, means 'week'.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōu mò. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个周末 ('a weekend').

examples.text: 是谁啊？又有人订周末的房间吗？
examples.trans: Who is it? Someone else booking a room for the weekend?

examples.text: 周末早上来院子喝咖啡的人最多。
examples.trans: Weekend mornings bring the biggest crowd to the courtyard for coffee.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wèi dào. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种味道 ('a flavor / aroma').

examples.text: 咬一口……志豪，闭上眼睛！跟梧桐巷的味道一模一样！
examples.trans: One bite... Zhihao, close your eyes! It tastes identical to Wutong Lane!

examples.text: 刚泡好的薄荷茶味道真清香。
examples.trans: Freshly brewed mint tea has such a clean aroma.

related.gloss: know (a fact or piece of information)

meanings.note: Pinyin: hū. Imitates letting out a relieved breath.

examples.text: 呼，好在反应快，早餐又有救了！
examples.trans: Phew, quick thinking saves breakfast once again!

examples.text: 呼，终于赶上早班火车了。
examples.trans: Phew, we finally caught the morning train.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hū xī. Pairs with 深 in 深呼吸 ('take a deep breath').

examples.text: 深呼吸，周经理。还没人写任何东西呢。
examples.trans: Take a deep breath, Manager Zhou. Nobody has written anything yet.

examples.text: 雨后院子里的空气呼吸起来特别舒服。
examples.trans: After the rain, the courtyard air feels wonderful to breathe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mìng. Appears in lively colloquial idioms like 救命 ('save someone's life / bail someone out').

examples.text: 夏天喝一杯冰柠檬水真是救了我的命！
examples.trans: A glass of iced lemonade in summer truly saved my life!

examples.text: 多亏你提醒我，不然我就忘带钥匙了，真是救命啊。
examples.trans: Thanks to your reminder I didn't forget my keys—what a lifesaver.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Joins nouns or pronouns ('A and B'), NEVER two whole clauses; also means 'with' (和你一样).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé hǎo. Describes friends or family patching things up after a quarrel.

examples.text: 我的茶杯完好无损，两兄弟和好了，小晴也找到了新家。
examples.trans: My teacup survived unharmed, two brothers made peace, and Qing found a new home.

examples.text: 喝了一壶热茶，两兄弟终于和好了。
examples.trans: Over a pot of hot tea, the two brothers finally made up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kā dā. Onomatopoeia imitating the crisp snap of a light switch, lock, or latch.

examples.text: 咔嗒一声，铜锁终于打开了。
examples.trans: With a crisp click, the brass lock finally opened.

examples.text: 她按下墙上的开关，咔嗒一声灯就亮了。
examples.trans: She pressed the wall switch, and with a click the lamp came on.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kā fēi. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯咖啡 ('a cup of coffee').

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 我还没喝早咖啡呢，千万别说急事！
examples.trans: I have not had my morning coffee yet; please do not say emergency!

related.gloss: a cup of coffee (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Pinyin: kā fēi tīng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间咖啡厅 ('a café').

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 一楼阳光最好的角落是我们的咖啡厅。
examples.trans: The sunniest corner of the ground floor is our café lounge.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kā fēi bēi. Compound 咖啡 ('coffee') + 杯 ('cup').

examples.text: 周经理左手拿着一只热乎乎的咖啡杯。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou is holding a warm coffee cup in his left hand.

examples.text: 小美把洗干净的咖啡杯整齐地摆在架子上。
examples.trans: Mei arranged the washed coffee cups neatly on the shelf.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kā fēi guǎn. Measure word (量词): 家 (jiā), e.g. 一家咖啡馆 ('a café').

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

examples.text: 比现在翻一倍！我们真的要对整条街开放小院咖啡馆吗？
examples.trans: Double what I bake now! Are we really opening the courtyard café to our whole street?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí. Natural spoken interjection when noticing something unexpected.

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

examples.text: 咦，我的钥匙放哪儿了？
examples.trans: Huh, where did I put my keys?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎo. Used for biting into food or mechanical threads gripping tightly.

examples.text: 咬一口……志豪，闭上眼睛！跟梧桐巷的味道一模一样！
examples.trans: One bite... Zhihao, close your eyes! It tastes identical to Wutong Lane!

examples.text: 他咬了一口热乎乎的面包。
examples.trans: He took a bite of the warm bread.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎo hé. Describes gear or pipe threads fitting cleanly together.

examples.text: 一圈，两圈……看新铜螺纹咬合得多干净。
examples.trans: One turn, two turns... look how cleanly the new brass thread fits.

examples.text: 旧钥匙和锁孔依然咬合得很好。
examples.trans: The old key still engages cleanly inside the keyhole.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xián. Describes salted butter or savory dishes.

examples.text: 那是海盐咸黄油！甜果酱面包卷要无盐黄油！
examples.trans: That is sea-salt butter! Sweet jam rolls need unsalted butter!

examples.text: 咸黄油能配甜草莓果酱吗？
examples.trans: Can salted butter go with sweet strawberry jam?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǒng. Used for gently soothing a child or calming someone down.

examples.text: 宋老师，那怎么哄他开心呢？
examples.trans: Teacher Song, how did you coax him into smiling again?

examples.text: 哥哥正在耐心地哄弟弟。
examples.trans: The older brother is patiently soothing his little brother.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dō yīn. Combines solfège 哆 (dō, 'Do / C') + 音 ('musical note').

examples.text: 先按下中央哆音，听听琴弦的声音准不准。
examples.trans: Press middle C first and listen to whether the strings are in tune.

examples.text: 这首练习曲从明亮的哆音开始。
examples.trans: This etude begins on a bright C note.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wā. Expresses admiration or delight.

examples.text: 哇，看这间房！大木头房梁，窗户正对着院子！
examples.trans: Wow, look at this room! Big wooden beams, and a window facing the courtyard!

examples.text: 插上老陈的铜台灯……哇，黄色灯光真暖和！
examples.trans: Plug in Chen's brass lamp... wow, how warm that yellow light is!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hā. Expresses sudden realization or cheerful laughter.

examples.text: 哈！你怕签了名字，倔脾气大哥就不出门了！
examples.trans: Aha! You feared that if you signed your name, stubborn big brother would stay home!

examples.text: 哈，原来钥匙就在口袋里！
examples.trans: Aha, the key was in my pocket all along!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hā hā. Hearty laughter.

examples.text: 哈哈！跟我到院子里来一分钟，给你们看我真正做什么！
examples.trans: Haha! Come out to the courtyard for a minute—let me show you what I really do!

examples.text: 哈哈，我们俩想到一块儿去了！
examples.trans: Haha, the two of us had the exact same thought!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎng. Used for bells, phones, pipes, or alarms ringing or clanking.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎng shēng. Measure word (量词): 阵, e.g. 一阵响声 ('a burst of noise').

examples.text: 快合上送上去——等等，那是什么金属响声？
examples.trans: Close it quickly and take it up—wait, what was that metallic clanking sound?

examples.text: 楼下水管的响声已经完全停了。
examples.trans: The clanking sound in the downstairs pipe has completely stopped.

related.gloss: a burst of noise (measure word 阵)

meanings.note: Pinyin: āi yā. Expresses mild dismay or sudden surprise.

examples.text: 我的眼镜怎么会在……哎呀！在我头上！
examples.trans: Why would my glasses be in... oh dear! They are on my head!

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
examples.trans: Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?

meanings.note: Pinyin: āi yō. Natural spoken exclamation of effort, surprise, or mild pain.

examples.text: 哎哟，这扇旧木窗板卡得真紧呀！
examples.trans: Ugh, this old wooden shutter is stuck so tight!

examples.text: 哎哟，茶杯还很烫，端的时候小心点儿。
examples.trans: Ooh, the teacup is still very hot—be careful carrying it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gē ge. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个哥哥 ('an older brother').

examples.text: 那里住着一位老木匠和两个孙子——哥哥弹钢琴，弟弟最爱小火车！
examples.trans: An old carpenter lived there with two grandsons—the older brother played piano, and the younger loved toy trains!

examples.text: 哥哥性格爽朗声音大，弹音阶总是急匆匆的。
examples.trans: The older brother was bold and loud, always rushing through his scales.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ò. Signals realization or acknowledgment.

examples.text: 哦？我的预订有问题吗？
examples.trans: Oh? Is there a problem with my booking?

examples.text: 我？哦，我只是喜欢准时！七点十四分真美妙！
examples.trans: Me? Oh, I simply love punctuality! Seven fourteen is a lovely minute!

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǎ. Combines with a measure word to ask 'which?' (哪个 'which one?', 哪间 'which room?').

examples.text: 等一下，小晴……你拿了哪一包黄油？
examples.trans: Wait a second, Qing... which packet of butter did you grab?

examples.text: 对！左边有两条小路——我走哪一条？
examples.trans: Yes! There are two small lanes on the left—which one do I take?

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǎr. Spoken northern/standard variant of 哪里 ('where').

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ná lǐ. Everyday question word for place; stays after 在 (在哪里 'where is it?').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 小勺子和餐巾放在哪里？
examples.trans: Where do the small spoons and napkins go?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kū. Everyday verb for crying.

examples.text: 那你告诉我，前台后面那位先生为什么快哭了？
examples.trans: Then tell me why that gentleman behind the front desk looks ready to cry.

examples.text: 小孩子找不到妈妈，急得哭了。
examples.trans: The child could not find his mother and cried anxiously.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hēng. Read 1st-tone hēng when softly humming a tune under one's breath (哼歌 'hum a song').

examples.text: 小美一边揉面团，一边轻轻哼着歌。
examples.trans: Mei softly hummed a tune while kneading bread dough.

examples.text: 宋老师看着旧乐谱，小声哼出了第一句。
examples.trans: Looking at the old score, Teacher Song softly hummed the opening phrase.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shāng yè. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种商业 ('a line of commerce').

examples.text: 产权转让通知：八号小院整栋建筑将作为商业办公楼出售。
examples.trans: Property Transfer Notice: Courtyard Building Eight offered for sale as commercial offices.

examples.text: 商业办公楼出售？！把我们的客栈和厨房变成灰色办公室？！
examples.trans: Commercial office sale?! Turn our inn and kitchen into grey offices?!

related.gloss: a line of commerce (measure word 种)

meanings.note: Pinyin: a. Expresses sudden realization at the start of a line, or softens warmth at the end.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
examples.trans: Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: la. Colloquial fusion of 了 + 啊 adding cheerful energy at the end of a sentence.

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 你们守着，我出门啦！
examples.trans: Hold the fort—I am heading out the door!

meanings.note: Pinyin: pā. Sound word for a sharp crack, a slap, or a blown fuse.

examples.text: 就按一下——啪！……哎呀。
examples.trans: Just one quick click—pop! ... Oh dear.

examples.text: 啪的一声，杯子掉在地上了。
examples.trans: With a snap, the cup fell to the floor.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎn. Used for calling out to someone across a courtyard or street.

examples.text: 我在院子里老远就听到你们喊黄油了。
examples.trans: All the way out in the courtyard I heard you shouting about butter.

examples.text: 有人在大门口喊你的名字。
examples.trans: Someone is calling your name at the front gate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuǎn. Pairs with 气 in 喘口气 ('catch one's breath').

examples.text: 老陈，两个铜阀门给你！喘口气？没空！
examples.trans: Chen, here are both brass valves! Catch my breath? No time!

examples.text: 他跑上三楼，先喘一口气。
examples.trans: He ran up to the third floor and paused to catch his breath.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xǐ huan. Everyday verb for liking food, rooms, or people.

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hē. Used for drinking tea, coffee, water, juice, AND soup in Mandarin (喝汤).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 我还没喝早咖啡呢，千万别说急事！
examples.trans: I have not had my morning coffee yet; please do not say emergency!

meanings.note: Pinyin: pēn quán. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座喷泉 ('a fountain').

examples.text: 听得很清楚。你站在小石头喷泉旁边吗？
examples.trans: Loud and clear. Are you standing beside the little stone fountain?

examples.text: 小广场中间有一座石头喷泉。
examples.trans: There is a stone fountain in the middle of the small plaza.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wēng wēng. Onomatopoeia describing the low hum of an appliance, bee, or transformer.

examples.text: 新冰箱在角落里轻轻地嗡嗡响。
examples.trans: The new fridge hums softly in the corner.

examples.text: 春天花园里的蜜蜂在花朵旁嗡嗡飞。
examples.trans: In spring, bees in the garden buzz around the blossoms.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ma. Sentence-final particle reminding the listener of something natural or obvious.

examples.text: 总得有人照顾院子里的花草嘛。
examples.trans: Somebody has to look after the courtyard plants, after all.

examples.text: 都是老街坊，不用客气嘛。
examples.trans: We are all old neighbors—no need to be so formal.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuǐ yìng. Literally 'mouth hard'—acting stubborn on the outside while caring inside.

examples.text: 志鹏不会走的。他总是嘴硬五秒钟，心马上就软了。
examples.trans: Zhipeng will not leave. He always talked tough for five seconds, then softened right away.

examples.text: 他虽然嘴硬，其实心里很关心弟弟。
examples.trans: Even though he talks tough, deep down he cares deeply about his brother.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zào yīn. Measure word (量词): 阵, e.g. 一阵噪音 ('a burst of noise').

examples.text: 主要设计小图书馆和院子，测量老石墙怎么挡住街上噪音。
examples.trans: Mostly small libraries and courtyards, measuring how old stone walls block street noise.

examples.text: 厚砖墙挡住了大街上的汽车噪音。
examples.trans: The thick brick wall blocks the traffic noise from the avenue.

related.gloss: a burst of noise (measure word 阵)

meanings.note: Pinyin: sì. Cardinal number 4.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房今天到。
examples.trans: Right, eight guest rooms, eight brass keys. Room four arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí. As a verb, 'return' (回家, 回来); as a measure word, 'occasion/time' (这回 'this time').

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

examples.text: 他没要回那个装木头小火车的箱子吗？
examples.trans: Did he not ask back for that case with the wooden train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí shēng. Measure word (量词): 阵, e.g. 一阵回声 ('an echo').

examples.text: 因为湿木头百叶窗会柔化石板路传回来的回声……
examples.trans: Because wet wooden shutters soften the echo bouncing off the flagstones...

examples.text: 空荡荡的大厅里能听见脚步的回声。
examples.trans: In the empty hall you can hear the echo of footsteps.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí tóu. Appears in the friendly farewell 回头见！ ('See you soon!').

examples.text: 我先去送热茶，我们回头聊！
examples.trans: Let me deliver this hot tea first—we will talk soon!

examples.text: 今天辛苦了，回头见！
examples.trans: Great work today—see you soon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí jiā. Verb-object compound 回 ('return') + 家 ('home'); takes no location particle between them.

examples.text: 买完菜以后，我们一起走路回家吧。
examples.trans: After finishing the grocery shopping, let's walk home together.

examples.text: 下班回家的路上，我买了一束鲜花。
examples.trans: On my way home from work, I bought a bunch of fresh flowers.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí xíng zhēn. Measure word (量词): 枚, e.g. 一枚回形针 ('a paperclip').

examples.text: 等等——通知背面回形针还别着第二页折起来的纸……
examples.trans: Wait—clipped to the back of the notice is a folded second page...

examples.text: 两页合同用一枚银色回形针别在一起。
examples.trans: The two contract pages are clipped together with a silver paperclip.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí yì. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 一段回忆 ('a fond memory').

examples.text: 老房子连着旧回忆——那种争吵最伤人。
examples.trans: Old houses are tied to old memories—arguments like that cut deepest.

examples.text: 老钢琴里藏着他们童年最美的回忆。
examples.trans: The old piano holds their fondest childhood memories.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí lái. Directional compound for returning toward the speaker's place.

examples.text: 一点没破！是谁送回来的？
examples.trans: Not cracked at all! Who brought it back?

examples.text: 付了现金！打开工具箱等我，我往桥那边跑回来了！
examples.trans: Paid in cash! Open your toolbox and wait—I am running back across the bridge!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yīn wèi. Introduces a reason; often paired with 所以 ('therefore') in the next clause.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
examples.trans: Because the stairs are narrow, and Manager Zhou put old lamp boxes up there.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wéi. Often followed by 着 (围着桌子 'gathered around the table').

examples.text: 傍晚大家围着木桌一边喝茶一边聊天。
examples.trans: At dusk everyone gathered around the wooden table drinking tea and chatting.

examples.text: 院子四周用青砖围成了一道矮墙。
examples.trans: Blue bricks form a low wall surrounding all four sides of the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tú. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张图 ('a plan').

examples.text: 里面有……一把大门钥匙、一张蓝色的图，还有明信片。
examples.trans: Inside there's... one big door key, a blue plan, and postcards.

examples.text: 老陈在纸上画了一张去五金店的图。
examples.trans: Chen drew a map to the hardware shop on a piece of paper.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tú shū guǎn. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座图书馆 ('a library').

examples.text: 主要设计小图书馆和院子，测量老石墙怎么挡住街上噪音。
examples.trans: Mostly small libraries and courtyards, measuring how old stone walls block street noise.

examples.text: 市图书馆保存着很多老城区的历史图纸。
examples.trans: The city library preserves many historic blueprints of the Old Quarter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tú zhǐ. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张图纸 ('a blueprint').

examples.text: 看合页边露出来的折纸图纸——一楼画着一扇暗门！
examples.trans: Look at the folded blueprint sticking out of the hinge—a hidden door is drawn on the ground floor!

examples.text: 桌子上摊开着一张老房子的建筑图纸。
examples.trans: An architectural blueprint of the old house is spread out on the table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuán. Describes round tables, seals, or shapes.

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

examples.text: 院子中间有一张圆木桌。
examples.trans: There is a round wooden table in the middle of the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuán yuán. Affectionate reduplication of 圆 ('round'), followed by 的 (圆圆的月亮 'round full moon').

examples.text: 盘子里放着四个圆圆的黄柠檬。
examples.trans: Four plump round yellow lemons sit on the plate.

examples.text: 中秋节晚上，圆圆的月亮挂在院子上方。
examples.trans: On Mid-Autumn night, a round full moon hangs above the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuán wǔ qǔ. Compound from 圆 ('circle') + 舞 ('dance') + 曲 ('musical piece'). Measure word: 首 (shǒu).

examples.text: 宋老师在钢琴上弹了一首轻快的圆舞曲。
examples.trans: Teacher Song played a lively waltz on the piano.

examples.text: 这首老圆舞曲让人想起三十年前的晚茶会。
examples.trans: This old waltz brings back memories of evening tea gatherings thirty years ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: quān. Counts full turns of a key, wrench, or lap around a block (一圈 'one full turn').

examples.text: 一圈，两圈……看新铜螺纹咬合得多干净。
examples.trans: One turn, two turns... look how cleanly the new brass thread fits.

examples.text: 我绕着广场走了一圈。
examples.trans: I walked one lap around the square.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Neutral-tone structural particle turning a descriptive phrase into an adverb before a verb (轻轻地放 'set down gently'); distinct from noun di4 ('ground').

examples.text: 小晴整整齐齐地把茶杯排在木架上。
examples.trans: Qing arranged the teacups neatly on the wooden shelf.

examples.text: 老陈仔细地检查了每一根新电线。
examples.trans: Chen carefully checked every single new wire.

meanings.en: on the floor; on the ground
meanings.note: Pinyin: dì shang. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块地上 ('a patch of floor').

examples.text: 墙上也没镜子，地上没铺地毯有点空。
examples.trans: No mirror on the wall either, and the floor feels bare without a rug.

examples.text: 小心，刚拖过的地上还有点湿。
examples.trans: Careful—the freshly mopped floor is still a little damp.

related.gloss: a patch of floor (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì xià shì. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间地下室 ('a cellar').

examples.text: 谢谢您这么体谅！老陈马上去地下室检查。
examples.trans: Thank you for being so understanding! Chen will check the basement right away.

examples.text: 折叠椅整齐地收在干燥的地下室里。
examples.trans: The folding chairs are stored neatly in the dry cellar.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì zhǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个地址 ('an address').

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 请把客栈的地址发到我手机上。
examples.trans: Please send the inn's address to my phone.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì fang. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个地方 ('a place').

examples.text: 等等——三楼楼梯上面是什么地方？
examples.trans: Wait—what is above the stairs on the third floor?

examples.text: 谢谢你们实话实说，没让我冒雨再找地方。
examples.trans: Thank you both for speaking honestly instead of sending me back into the rain.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì bǎn. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块地板 ('a floorboard').

examples.text: 晚上好。不好意思，把干净地板弄湿了。
examples.trans: Good evening. Sorry for getting your clean floor wet.

examples.text: 快去跟他聊聊，小晴，不然木地板都要踩破了！
examples.trans: Go talk to him quickly, Qing, or he will wear right through the wooden floorboards!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì tǎn. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块地毯 ('a rug').

examples.text: 墙上也没镜子，地上没铺地毯有点空。
examples.trans: No mirror on the wall either, and the floor feels bare without a rug.

examples.text: 储藏室里有两个软枕头和一块蓝地毯！
examples.trans: In the storeroom there are two soft pillows and a blue rug!

场.gloss: measure word for rainstorms, shows, events

meanings.en: measure word for rainstorms, shows, events
meanings.note: Pinyin: chǎng. Counts bouts of rain or performances (一场大雨 'a heavy rainstorm').

examples.text: 我在做梦吗？！志豪，这场重逢是你安排的吗？
examples.trans: Am I dreaming?! Zhihao, did you plan this whole reunion?

examples.text: 昨晚下了一场大雨。
examples.trans: There was a heavy rainstorm last night.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huài. Describes a broken pipe, lock, or appliance (坏了 'broke down').

examples.text: 送牛奶的车在城外坏了。你们看冰箱！
examples.trans: The milk delivery van broke down outside town. Look at the fridge!

examples.text: 坏消息。老热水器上的铜压力阀门裂了。
examples.trans: Bad news. The brass pressure valve on the old water heater cracked.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuò. Means both 'sit down' (请坐) and 'ride inside a vehicle' (坐火车 'take the train').

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 您先坐下，别着急，我们马上看行李牌。
examples.trans: Please sit down first and do not worry; we will check the luggage tag right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kēng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个水坑 ('a puddle / pit').

examples.text: 早跟你说过，那个平板是个坑。
examples.trans: Told you before, that tablet is a trap.

examples.text: 下雨以后，路边有个小水坑。
examples.trans: After the rain, there is a small puddle by the roadside.

块.gloss: measure word for pieces and yuan

meanings.en: measure word for pieces and yuan
meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. Counts chunks/pieces (一块蛋糕 'a piece of cake') and spoken yuan of money (五块钱 'five yuan').

examples.text: 钱箱里拿五十块，记得要收据！
examples.trans: Here is fifty yuan from the cash box; remember to get a receipt!

examples.text: 在这儿！一共三十八块，找回十二块零钱。
examples.trans: Right here! Thirty-eight yuan in total, with twelve yuan back in change.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lā jī tǒng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个垃圾桶 ('a trash bin').

examples.text: 看，已经十二点零四分了。也许他把明信片扔进垃圾桶了。
examples.trans: Look, it is twelve-oh-four already. Maybe he tossed the postcard into the bin.

examples.text: 院子角落有一个分类放纸盒的垃圾桶。
examples.trans: In the courtyard corner stands a bin for sorting paper cartons.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chéng qū. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个城区 ('a city quarter').

examples.text: 成都老城区保护条例第十四条——窗外我哥哥刚点头了！
examples.trans: Clause fourteen of the Chengdu Old Quarter Act—and my brother outside just nodded!

examples.text: 成都市中心的老城区有很多小巷子。
examples.trans: Chengdu's historic urban quarter has many small lanes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chéng wài. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 一片城外 ('an area outside town').

examples.text: 送牛奶的车在城外坏了。你们看冰箱！
examples.trans: The milk delivery van broke down outside town. Look at the fridge!

examples.text: 周末我们打算去城外看风景。
examples.trans: This weekend we plan to head outside town to enjoy the scenery.

related.gloss: an area outside town (measure word 片)

meanings.note: Pinyin: chéng shì. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座城市 ('a city').

examples.text: 脑子转得快，小晴。志豪每星期都读城市建筑规定。
examples.trans: Quick thinking, Qing. Hao reads city building rules every single week.

examples.text: 成都是一座既热闹又悠闲的城市。
examples.trans: Chengdu is a city that is both lively and relaxed.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chéng lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 城里地方 ('a spot in town').

examples.text: 再等几分钟，志豪先生。中午城里堵车总是很慢。
examples.trans: Give it a few more minutes, Mr Zhihao. Midday city traffic is always slow.

examples.text: 他一早就坐车去城里办事了。
examples.trans: Early in the morning he rode into town on business.

related.gloss: a spot in town (measure word 个)

meanings.en: clog; block; measure word for walls
meanings.note: Pinyin: dǔ. As a measure word, counts walls (一堵砖墙 'a brick wall'); as a verb, 'block/jam'.

examples.text: 椅子找到了——在一堵旧砖墙后面，我还发现了这个。
examples.trans: Found the chairs—and behind an old brick partition wall, I also uncovered this.

examples.text: 这堵老石墙非常结实。
examples.trans: This old stone wall is very sturdy.

related.gloss: be stuck in a traffic jam

堵车.gloss: be stuck in a traffic jam

meanings.en: be stuck in a traffic jam
meanings.note: Pinyin: dǔ chē. Separable verb-object compound ('traffic is backed up').

examples.text: 再等几分钟，志豪先生。中午城里堵车总是很慢。
examples.trans: Give it a few more minutes, Mr Zhihao. Midday city traffic is always slow.

examples.text: 早高峰容易堵车，坐地铁更快。
examples.trans: Morning rush hour often jams up, so taking the subway is faster.

related.gloss: on the train / in the car

meanings.note: Pinyin: sāi. Used for slipping a note into an envelope or plugging a gap.

examples.text: 小晴，把床单角塞紧！放上两个软枕头。
examples.trans: Qing, tuck the sheet corner tight! On go the two soft pillows.

examples.text: 快把那张纸折起来，塞进口袋里。
examples.trans: Fold up that sheet of paper right now and tuck it into your pocket.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiáng. Measure word (量词): 堵 (dǔ), e.g. 一堵墙 ('a wall').

examples.text: 拐弯小心点，别碰到墙！
examples.trans: Careful on the turn—do not bump the wall!

examples.text: 当然记得！每到星期五弹错一个音，他就对着墙皱眉头。
examples.trans: Of course I remember! Every Friday when he missed a note, he frowned at the wall.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiáng shang. Measure word (量词): 面 (miàn), e.g. 一面墙上 ('on a wall surface').

examples.text: 墙上也没镜子，地上没铺地毯有点空。
examples.trans: No mirror on the wall either, and the floor feels bare without a rug.

examples.text: 墙上挂着一幅成都老街的画。
examples.trans: A picture of an old Chengdu lane hangs on the wall.

related.gloss: on a wall surface (measure word 面)

墙边.gloss: beside the wall; against the wall

meanings.en: beside the wall; against the wall
meanings.note: Pinyin: qiáng biān. Combines 墙 ('wall') + locality suffix 边 ('side/edge').

examples.text: 打磨好的四扇窗板正靠在院子墙边。
examples.trans: The four sanded shutters are leaning beside the courtyard wall.

examples.text: 墙边种着一排翠绿的常春藤。
examples.trans: A row of emerald-green ivy is planted along the wall.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mò shuǐ. Liquid writing ink for fountain pens. Measure word: 瓶 (píng, 'bottle').

examples.text: 这页旧信是用深蓝色墨水写的。
examples.trans: This old letter page was written in dark blue ink.

examples.text: 桌上的钢笔没墨水了，我得去加一点。
examples.trans: The fountain pen on the desk is out of ink; I need to refill it.

meanings.en: sound; voice; measure word for sounds
meanings.note: Pinyin: shēng. Counts cries, knocks, or chimes (一声 'one sound').

examples.text: 来不及了！他说了声谢谢就挂断了！
examples.trans: Too late! He said thank you and hung up!

examples.text: 非常安静！不过刚才你听到奇怪的金属敲击声了吗？
examples.trans: Very quiet! Though did you hear a strange metallic knocking sound just now?

meanings.note: Pinyin: shēng xué. Measure word (量词): 门 (mén), e.g. 一门声学 ('the field of acoustics').

examples.text: 你的服务值得十分！其实我是声学建筑师。
examples.trans: Your service deserves ten points! Actually, I am an acoustic architect.

examples.text: 声学建筑师！您设计音乐厅吗？
examples.trans: An acoustic architect! Do you design concert halls?

related.gloss: the field of acoustics (measure word 门)

meanings.note: Pinyin: shēng yīn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个声音 ('a voice / sound').

examples.text: 声音客气吗？年轻人还是老人？
examples.trans: Was the voice polite? A young person or an older person?

examples.text: 声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
examples.trans: Soft-spoken, very polite, around thirty-something, and a bit nervous.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hú. Spouted vessel for tea, milk, or water (茶壶 'teapot', 牛奶壶 'milk jug'); also used as a measure word ('a pot of').

examples.text: 白色茶壶旁边放着一个小牛奶壶。
examples.trans: Beside the white teapot sits a small milk jug.

examples.text: 客人刚坐下，小晴就泡了一壶热花茶。
examples.trans: As soon as the guests sat down, Qing brewed a pot of hot flower tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hú zuǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个壶嘴 ('a teapot spout').

examples.text: 小心，周经理，壶嘴很宽！
examples.trans: Careful, Manager Zhou, the pitcher spout is wide!

examples.text: 倒茶的时候留神壶嘴里的热气。
examples.trans: Mind the steam from the spout when pouring tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bèi zhù. Combines 备 ('for reference') + 注 ('note/annotation') in ledgers, forms, or margins.

examples.text: 姑姑在登记本下面写了一行清楚的备注。
examples.trans: My aunt wrote a clear note at the bottom of the guest book.

examples.text: 请在订单备注里写明不要放糖。
examples.trans: Please write 'no sugar' in the order notes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bèi yòng. Describes a spare key, spare bulb, or backup plan.

examples.text: 工具箱里有备用的铜阀门吗？
examples.trans: Is there a spare brass valve in your toolbox?

examples.text: 两个都买下！留一个备用明年冬天也省心。
examples.trans: Buy both! Keeping a spare saves worry next winter too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个夏天 ('a summer').

examples.text: 房东律师寄来的？奇怪——我们房租一直交到明年夏天了。
examples.trans: Sent by the landlord's lawyer? Strange—our rent is paid right through next summer.

examples.text: 夏天坐在大树底下乘凉最舒服。
examples.trans: Sitting in the shade beneath the big tree in summer is bliss.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wài. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个外面 ('an outside area').

examples.text: 等等——现在十米外的院子里坐着谁？
examples.trans: Wait—who is sitting ten metres away in our courtyard right now?

examples.text: 门外站着一位拿箱子的客人。
examples.trans: A guest holding a suitcase is standing outside the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wài tou. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 外头院子 ('the space outside').

examples.text: 您好？晚上好！院子外头没人啊！
examples.trans: Hello? Good evening! Nobody is outside the courtyard!

examples.text: 周经理，看院子窗户外头——有人跑进大门了！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, look out the courtyard window—someone just ran in the gate!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wài tào. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件外套 ('a coat').

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
examples.trans: It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wài pí. Measure word (量词): 层 (céng), e.g. 一层外皮 ('an outer crust').

examples.text: 正在架子上放凉呢——金黄外皮配甜柠檬糖霜！
examples.trans: Cooling on the rack right now—golden crust with sweet lemon glaze!

examples.text: 法式面包烤得外皮金黄香脆。
examples.trans: The bread baked up with a golden, crisp crust.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wài mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 外面世界 ('the outside').

examples.text: 外面一模一样，可是你看里面！
examples.trans: The outside is identical, yet look inside!

examples.text: 外面下着大雨，街上酒店全满了！我们怎么办？
examples.trans: It is pouring rain outside and every hotel on the street is full! What do we do?

meanings.note: Pinyin: duō. Means 'many' as an adjective, 'how…?' before adjectives (多大), or 'more than' after round numbers (三十多).

examples.text: 声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
examples.trans: Soft-spoken, very polite, around thirty-something, and a bit nervous.

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duō kuī. Gives warm credit for avoiding trouble.

examples.text: 这一周的街道记录全在里面，多亏了你。
examples.trans: All my street notes from this week are inside—thanks to you.

examples.text: 多亏你提醒我，差点忘了拿钥匙。
examples.trans: Thanks to your reminder, I nearly forgot to grab my keys.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duō bàn. Expresses an educated guess ('more than half likely').

examples.text: 多半是粉刷街边木窗那种无聊通知吧。
examples.trans: Probably some boring notice about painting the street shutters.

examples.text: 看天上的云，下午多半要下雨。
examples.trans: Judging by those clouds, it will probably rain this afternoon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duō shao. Asks about larger numbers, prices, or room/phone numbers (多少钱 'how much money?').

examples.text: 等等，换房间我们给他打多少折？
examples.trans: Wait—what discount do we offer him for changing rooms?

examples.text: 小美，你的烤箱每天早上最多能烤多少肉桂卷和柠檬蛋糕？
examples.trans: Mei, how many cinnamon rolls and lemon cakes can your oven bake each morning?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yè. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个夜晚 ('a night').

examples.text: 等周经理听说他为分贝慌了一整夜，表情一定精彩！
examples.trans: Wait until Manager Zhou hears he panicked all night over decibels!

examples.text: 雨夜里，客栈的灯光很温暖。
examples.trans: On a rainy night, the inn's lamplight feels warm.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yè kōng. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 一片夜空 ('an expanse of night sky').

examples.text: 抬头看夜空下那些金色灯笼——真宁静啊！
examples.trans: Look up at those golden lanterns against the night sky—how peaceful!

examples.text: 雨停以后，夜空格外干净。
examples.trans: After the rain stopped, the night sky looked remarkably clear.

related.gloss: an expanse of night sky (measure word 片)

meanings.note: Pinyin: gòu dào. Resultative compound 够 ('stretch/reach') + 到 ('attain').

examples.text: 站在木梯子上就能轻松够到顶上的拱窗。
examples.trans: Standing on the wooden ladder, you can easily reach the top arched window.

examples.text: 书架最高那一层太高了，我够不到。
examples.trans: The top shelf of the bookcase is too high; I cannot reach it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà. Everyday adjective for size, age, and strong wind or rain.

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà tīng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个大厅 ('a lobby').

examples.text: 大厅的灯黑了！我把厨房的烤箱也弄坏了吗？
examples.trans: The lobby lamp went dark! Did I break the kitchen oven too?

examples.text: 客人在大厅里等您。
examples.trans: A guest is waiting for you in the lobby.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà gē. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位大哥 ('an older brother').

examples.text: 哈！你怕签了名字，倔脾气大哥就不出门了！
examples.trans: Aha! You feared that if you signed your name, stubborn big brother would stay home!

examples.text: 而且大哥想装作镇定的时候，绝对不会早到。
examples.trans: Besides, when older brothers want to act calm, they never arrive early.

meanings.en: lobby; main hall (of an inn or hotel)
meanings.note: Pinyin: dà táng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个大堂 ('a lobby').

examples.text: 满分十分给了九分？！谁会测量大堂，除非……
examples.trans: Nine out of ten?! Who measures lobbies unless...

examples.text: 您尽管看，宋老师。星期一下午大堂暗。
examples.trans: Go right ahead, Teacher Song. Monday afternoon the lobby was dim.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà jiā. Warm collective pronoun including everyone in the group.

examples.text: 大家早上好！欢迎你，小晴。都准备好了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning, everyone! Welcome, Qing. Is everything ready?

examples.text: 有进步！今天小院迎接兄弟重逢——大家保持安静端庄！
examples.trans: Progress! Today our courtyard hosts a brotherly reunion—quiet dignity from everyone!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà shān. Combines 大 ('big/great') + 山 ('mountain'); takes measure word 座.

examples.text: 清晨的薄雾笼罩着远处的座座大山。
examples.trans: Morning mist drapes the distant mountains.

examples.text: 把大难题拆开，大山也会变成小山丘。
examples.trans: Break a big problem apart and even a big mountain turns into small hills.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà shī. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位大师 ('a master').

examples.text: 听听保养大师说的！昨天修热水器，今天修两兄弟！
examples.trans: Listen to the maintenance master! Yesterday fixing the boiler, today fixing two brothers!

examples.text: 那位木匠真是一位修老家具的大师。
examples.trans: That carpenter is truly a master at restoring old furniture.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà fang. Praises generous hospitality or natural poise.

examples.text: 真大方！你们听到楼下大门门铃了吗？
examples.trans: How generous! Did you hear the front gate bell downstairs?

examples.text: 小姑娘说话做事都很大方。
examples.trans: The young woman speaks and carries herself with natural poise.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà gài. Estimates quantities or likelihood.

examples.text: 声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
examples.trans: Soft-spoken, very polite, around thirty-something, and a bit nervous.

examples.text: 从这儿走到药店大概只要五分钟。
examples.trans: Walking from here to the pharmacy takes roughly five minutes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà bái huà. Measure word (量词): 句 (jù), e.g. 一句大白话 ('plain talk').

examples.text: 请用大白话说！第十四条写了什么？
examples.trans: In plain words, please! What does Clause fourteen say?

examples.text: 律师用最简单的大白话解释了那条法规。
examples.trans: The lawyer explained that legal clause in plain everyday language.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà jiē. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条大街 ('a main street').

examples.text: 没错。外面大街很吵，进了院子却只听见树叶和小鸟。
examples.trans: Exactly. Outside on the main road it is noisy, yet inside the courtyard you only hear leaves and birds.

examples.text: 出了小巷子就是热闹的大街。
examples.trans: Step out of the small lane and you are on the bustling main street.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà mén. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇大门 ('a front gate').

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

examples.text: 老陈，你听到了吗？有人按了大门门铃！
examples.trans: Chen, did you hear that? Someone rang the front gate bell!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà mén kǒu. Location noun built from 大门 ('main gate') + 口 ('entranceway').

examples.text: 送货车停在客栈大门口等我们签字。
examples.trans: The delivery van parked at the inn's front gate waiting for us to sign.

examples.text: 大门口的两盆绿植物刚浇过水。
examples.trans: The two pots of green plants by the main gate were just watered.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà yǔ. Measure word (量词): 场 (chǎng), e.g. 一场大雨 ('a heavy rainstorm').

examples.text: 外面下着大雨，街上酒店全满了！我们怎么办？
examples.trans: It is pouring rain outside and every hotel on the street is full! What do we do?

examples.text: 外面的大雨下了整整一个晚上。
examples.trans: The heavy downpour outside lasted the entire night.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà yǔ qīng pén. Four-character set phrase: 大雨 ('heavy rain') + 倾盆 ('upturning a basin').

examples.text: 半夜突然大雨倾盆，幸好我们关好了窗户。
examples.trans: At midnight rain suddenly poured down in torrents; luckily we had shut the windows.

examples.text: 刚跑进走廊，外面就大雨倾盆了。
examples.trans: Just as we ran into the hallway, the sky opened up in a downpour outside.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一整天 ('a whole day').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第二天上班，干得不错，新手。
examples.trans: For day two on the job, nicely done, rookie.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiān liàng. Subject-predicate compound meaning 'daybreak arrives'.

examples.text: 老砖墙保暖，房间到天亮都暖和，放心。
examples.trans: Old brick walls hold heat, so the rooms stay warm until daybreak—don't worry.

examples.text: 雨在天亮以前终于停了。
examples.trans: The rain finally stopped before daybreak.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiān na. Natural exclamation of surprise.

examples.text: 天哪！桌子上一滴没洒……全洒在我领带上了！
examples.trans: Good heavens! Not a drop spilled on the table... it all spilled on my tie!

examples.text: 天哪……看这双眼睛！第三级台阶上的小志豪？！
examples.trans: Good heavens... look at those eyes! Little Zhihao from the third step?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiān qì. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种好天气 ('pleasant weather').

examples.text: 我在看天气，小美！铃铛旁边这封厚信是谁放的？
examples.trans: I am checking the weather, Mei! Who put this thick letter beside the bell?

examples.text: 今天天气晴朗，最适合晒被子。
examples.trans: Today's weather is bright and sunny—ideal for airing quilts.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiān qì yù bào. Combines 天气 ('weather') + 预报 ('advance report / forecast').

examples.text: 天气预报说星期一整天都会下大雨。
examples.trans: The weather forecast says it will rain heavily all day Monday.

examples.text: 出门刷漆以前，老陈总会先看一眼天气预报。
examples.trans: Before heading out to paint, Chen always checks the weather forecast first.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiān shēng. Describes an inborn gift or temperament.

examples.text: 小晴，你真是天生的店长！我的血压保住了！
examples.trans: Qing, you are a born innkeeper! My blood pressure is saved!

examples.text: 她有一副天生的好嗓子。
examples.trans: She has a naturally lovely voice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiān kōng. Disyllabic noun 天 ('sky/heaven') + 空 ('expanse/air').

examples.text: 擦干净玻璃以后，外面的蓝色天空清楚极了。
examples.trans: After wiping the glass clean, the blue sky outside looked crystal clear.

examples.text: 雨停以后，天空出现了一道彩虹。
examples.trans: After the rain stopped, a rainbow appeared in the sky.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiān huā bǎn. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块天花板 ('a ceiling panel').

examples.text: 四米宽，六米长，左边是砖墙，上面是木头天花板。
examples.trans: Four metres wide, six metres long, a brick wall on the left, a wooden ceiling above.

examples.text: 太好了！我们去阳光房试试天花板上的灯！
examples.trans: Wonderful! Let's go test the ceiling lamp in the sunroom!

meanings.note: Pinyin: tài. Often frames 太 + adj + 了 for warm exclamations (太好了！ 'Wonderful!').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

meanings.note: Pinyin: tài yáng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个太阳 ('a sun').

examples.text: 热面包，热茶，早上的太阳，一点冷风也没有！
examples.trans: Warm bread, hot tea, morning sun, and not a bit of cold wind!

examples.text: 今天太阳很好，我们去院子里坐坐吧。
examples.trans: The sun is lovely today; let's go and sit in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fū qī. Measure word (量词): 对 (duì), e.g. 一对夫妻 ('a married couple').

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

examples.text: 那对老夫妻每年春天都来住一周。
examples.trans: That elderly couple comes to stay for a week every spring.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shī wù chù. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个失物处 ('a lost-and-found desk').

examples.text: 小晴，马上给火车站失物处打电话。
examples.trans: Qing, call the train station lost-and-found office right away.

examples.text: 火车站失物处每天都会登记客人落下的行李。
examples.trans: The station lost-and-found logs luggage left behind by passengers daily.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shī wù. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个失误 ('an oversight').

examples.text: 因为我们的失误，今晚半价，还送早餐。
examples.trans: Because of our mistake, tonight is half price, with complimentary breakfast.

examples.text: 这是我们工作上的小失误，请您原谅。
examples.trans: That was a small oversight on our part; please forgive us.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shī péi. Polite phrase when stepping away briefly (失陪一下 'please excuse me a moment').

examples.text: 失陪一下，宋老师，我先回办公室整理一下！
examples.trans: Excuse me a moment, Teacher Song; I shall step back to my office to tidy up!

examples.text: 得救了！失陪一分钟，宋老师，您慢喝热茶！
examples.trans: Saved! Excuse me one minute, Teacher Song—enjoy your hot tea!

meanings.note: Pinyin: tóu shang. Measure word (量词): 顶, e.g. 头上帽子 ('on the head').

examples.text: 我的眼镜怎么会在……哎呀！在我头上！
examples.trans: Why would my glasses be in... oh dear! They are on my head!

examples.text: 老奶奶头上戴着一顶暖和的羊毛帽。
examples.trans: Grandmother is wearing a warm wool hat on her head.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tóu téng. Means a literal headache or something causing a headache.

examples.text: 法律条文我戴两副眼镜看都头疼！
