examples.trans: Legal clauses give me a headache even with two pairs of glasses!

examples.text: 复杂的数字总是让他觉得头疼。
examples.trans: Complicated numbers always give him a headache.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuā kua. Reduplicated form of 夸 ('praise warmly').

examples.text: 小晴，炒蛋真好吃，替我夸夸小美！
examples.trans: Qing, the scrambled eggs are delicious—praise Mei for me!

examples.text: 今天早餐做得这么棒，真该好好夸夸你！
examples.trans: Breakfast turned out so well today that you deserve warm praise!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiā. First-tone jiā: hold something pinched between two surfaces, such as under one's arm (夹在胳膊底下) or inside book pages.

examples.text: 周经理把绿色登记本夹在胳膊底下走来走去。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou paced back and forth with the green guest book tucked under his arm.

examples.text: 她在旧书里夹了一片干树叶做书签。
examples.trans: She tucked a dried leaf inside the old book as a bookmark.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qí guài. Everyday adjective for anything unusual.

examples.text: 真奇怪！我们坐同一班早火车到同一个区。
examples.trans: How strange! We rode the very same morning train to the same district.

examples.text: 非常安静！不过刚才你听到奇怪的金属敲击声了吗？
examples.trans: Very quiet! Though did you hear a strange metallic knocking sound just now?

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǚ shì. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位女士 ('a lady').

examples.text: 打扰了，女士……等等，这个声音！教钢琴的宋老师？！
examples.trans: Excuse me, ma'am... wait, that voice! Teacher Song, my piano teacher?!

examples.text: 前台有位姓宋的女士在等您。
examples.trans: A Ms. Song is waiting for you at reception.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǎi bái sè. Warm off-white shade literally meaning 'milk-white colour'.

examples.text: 这种奶白色的粗陶茶杯摸起来很温润。
examples.trans: These cream-white stoneware teacups feel smooth and warm to the touch.

examples.text: 阳光房的窗帘是柔和的奶白色。
examples.trans: The curtains in the sunroom are a soft cream-white.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǎi lào. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 一片奶酪 ('a slice of cheese').

examples.text: 三瓶牛奶、二十个鸡蛋、黄油、奶酪和红苹果！
examples.trans: Three bottles of milk, twenty eggs, butter, cheese, and red apples!

examples.text: 热面包夹一片奶酪特别香。
examples.trans: Warm bread with a slice of cheese smells wonderful.

related.gloss: a slice of cheese (measure word 片)

meanings.note: Pinyin: tā. Third-person singular feminine pronoun; written with the woman radical 女.

examples.text: 看拉链旁边……对，有她的名字缩写！
examples.trans: Check beside the zipper... yes, her name initials are here!

examples.text: 等等——星期一你们坐同一班火车，您拿错了她的箱子？
examples.trans: Wait—you rode the same train on Monday, and you took her suitcase by mistake?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo. Main adjective 'good'; as a result complement after a verb, means 'ready/completed properly' (修好, 准备好).

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo xiàng. Softens an observation ('it seems like…').

examples.text: 听到了！好像是隔壁洗手间的热水管响了。
examples.trans: I heard it! It sounded like the hot-water pipe in the bathroom next door.

examples.text: 门外好像有人在按门铃。
examples.trans: Someone seems to be ringing the doorbell outside.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo chī. Literally 'good to eat'; contrast 好喝 for drinks.

examples.text: 小晴，炒蛋真好吃，替我夸夸小美！
examples.trans: Qing, the scrambled eggs are delicious—praise Mei for me!

examples.text: 小美烤的肉桂卷真好吃！
examples.trans: The cinnamon rolls Mei bakes are delicious!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo tīng. Built from 好 ('good') + 听 ('listen'); compare 好看 ('good-looking') and 好吃 ('tasty').

examples.text: 一点回声也没有！木头和玻璃让音乐更好听。
examples.trans: No echo at all! Wood and glass make music sound even better.

examples.text: 你的声音真好听。
examples.trans: Your voice sounds really lovely.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo hē. Combines 好 ('good/pleasant to') + 喝 ('drink'), parallel to 好吃 ('tasty to eat').

examples.text: 加了柠檬汁的金黄扁豆汤特别好喝。
examples.trans: The golden lentil soup with lemon juice added is especially delicious.

examples.text: 小美泡的热薄荷茶清香好喝。
examples.trans: The hot mint tea Mei steeped is fragrant and delicious.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo zài. Relieved adverb introducing a saving grace.

examples.text: 呼，好在反应快，早餐又有救了！
examples.trans: Phew, quick thinking saves breakfast once again!

examples.text: 好在我们备了两把新钥匙。
examples.trans: Thankfully we kept two spare keys ready.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hào qí. Note fourth tone hào when meaning 'curious'.

examples.text: 真好奇！那张行李牌上的字看着很眼熟。
examples.trans: How curious! The handwriting on that tag looked very familiar.

examples.text: 听听他说的！老陈比我们好奇两倍！
examples.trans: Listen to him! Chen is twice as curious as we are!

meanings.note: Pinyin: háo hǎo. Placed before a verb to urge doing it well (好好看看, 好好休息).

examples.text: 您好好休息，有事随时按铃。
examples.trans: Rest well, ma'am; ring the bell anytime if you need anything.

examples.text: 把电话给我，我来好好问他！
examples.trans: Hand me the phone; let me ask him properly!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo kàn. Literally 'good to look at'.

examples.text: 真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
examples.trans: Is that really alright? It looks both lovely and warm!

examples.text: 院子里新挂的纸灯笼真好看。
examples.trans: The paper lanterns newly hung in the courtyard look lovely.

好让.gloss: so that; in order to let

meanings.en: so that; in order to let
meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo ràng. Purpose conjunction introducing the desired result in the second clause.

examples.text: 把窗户打开吧，好让新鲜空气吹进来。
examples.trans: Open the window so that fresh air can blow in.

examples.text: 希望明天出太阳，好让木板上的新油漆快点干透。
examples.trans: Let's hope the sun comes out tomorrow so that the fresh paint on the boards dries quickly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo yùn. Compound 好 ('good') + 运 ('luck/fortune'), common in wishes like 祝你好运 ('wish you good luck').

examples.text: 明天就是正式检查了，祝大家好运！
examples.trans: Tomorrow is the official inspection—good luck, everyone!

examples.text: 在集市淘到了最后一套白茶杯，真是好运！
examples.trans: Finding the last set of white teacups at the market was real good luck!

meanings.note: Pinyin: rú guǒ. Standard conditional conjunction ('if'), often paired with 就 in the main clause.

examples.text: 如果你同意，我想把这首曲子补写完整。
examples.trans: If you agree, I would like to finish writing this piece of music.

examples.text: 如果明天不下雨，我们就把桌子搬到院子里。
examples.trans: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we will move the tables out into the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mā ma. Everyday warm word for mother (second syllable neutral tone).

examples.text: 我妈妈做的柠檬果酱一点也不腻。
examples.trans: The lemon jam my mum makes is not cloying at all.

examples.text: 周末回家，我给妈妈带了一罐百花蜂蜜。
examples.trans: Going home for the weekend, I brought Mum a jar of wildflower honey.

meanings.note: Pinyin: miào. Describes a clever idea or delightful moment.

examples.text: 生活安排的二重奏比我们自己写得更妙，孩子们。
examples.trans: Life arranges finer duets than we write ourselves, boys.

examples.text: 这个主意真是太妙了！
examples.trans: That idea is truly wonderful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: gū gu. Specifically father's sister (second syllable neutral tone); distinct from 阿姨 / 姨妈 (mother's sister).

examples.text: 周经理的姑姑以前也住在这座老院子里。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou's paternal aunt used to live in this old courtyard too.

examples.text: 我姑姑年轻的时候最喜欢弹钢琴。
examples.trans: When my aunt was young, she loved playing the piano most of all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gū niang. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个姑娘 ('a young woman').

examples.text: 早上好，小姑娘。我订了房间，我姓宋。
examples.trans: Good morning, young lady. I booked a room; my surname is Song.

examples.text: 多烤几块边角，好姑娘！
examples.trans: Bake plenty of corner pieces, dear girl!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xìng. Takes the family name directly as object (我姓宋 'My surname is Song').

examples.text: 早上好，小姑娘。我订了房间，我姓宋。
examples.trans: Good morning, young lady. I booked a room; my surname is Song.

examples.text: 请问您贵姓？我姓陈。
examples.trans: May I ask your surname? My surname is Chen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nèn. Describes tender scrambled eggs or fresh young tea leaves.

examples.text: 小晴买了海盐黄油，今天我们做嫩炒蛋！
examples.trans: Qing bought sea-salt butter, so today we are making soft scrambled eggs!

examples.text: 今天的炒蛋又香又嫩。
examples.trans: Today's scrambled eggs are fragrant and tender.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zì. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个字 ('a written character').

examples.text: 真好奇！那张行李牌上的字看着很眼熟。
examples.trans: How curious! The handwriting on that tag looked very familiar.

examples.text: 先别对外面透露一个字！让两兄弟先过完这个星期五下午！
examples.trans: Not a single word to anyone outside yet! Let the two brothers have their Friday afternoon first!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zì mǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个字母 ('an alphabet letter').

examples.text: 可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
examples.trans: Unfortunately there is no phone number, only two letters and an old street name.

examples.text: 行李牌背面写着两个英文字母。
examples.trans: Two English letters are written on the back of the luggage tag.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zì jì. Literally 'character traces' (字 + 迹): a person's recognizable script on paper.

examples.text: 虽然过了三十年，墨水字迹还是很清楚。
examples.trans: Even after thirty years, the ink handwriting is still crystal clear.

examples.text: 我一眼就认出了爷爷本子上的字迹。
examples.trans: I recognized the handwriting in my grandfather's notebook at first glance.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sūn zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个孙子 ('a grandson').

examples.text: 那里住着一位老木匠和两个孙子——哥哥弹钢琴，弟弟最爱小火车！
examples.trans: An old carpenter lived there with two grandsons—the older brother played piano, and the younger loved toy trains!

examples.text: 老爷爷周末常带小孙子来买面包。
examples.trans: The grandfather often brings his grandson to buy bread on weekends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xué xiào. Measure word (量词): 所, e.g. 一所学校 ('a school').

examples.text: 热茶和柠檬蛋糕！小晴，你该给紧张的弟弟开个学校。
examples.trans: Hot tea and lemon cake! Qing, you ought to open a school for nervous brothers.

examples.text: 附近有一所安静的音乐学校。
examples.trans: There is a quiet music school nearby.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个孩子 ('a child').

examples.text: 而你们两个孩子把十二号最珍贵的部分留在这儿了。
examples.trans: And you two boys kept the most precious part of Number twelve right here.

examples.text: 生活安排的二重奏比我们自己写得更妙，孩子们。
examples.trans: Life arranges finer duets than we write ourselves, boys.

meanings.note: Pinyin: níng jìng. Warm, poetic cousin of 安静.

examples.text: 抬头看夜空下那些金色灯笼——真宁静啊！
examples.trans: Look up at those golden lanterns against the night sky—how peaceful!

examples.text: 清晨的小院有一份难得的宁静。
examples.trans: The early-morning courtyard holds a rare tranquility.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tā. Third-person singular pronoun for objects, animals, and places.

examples.text: 是啊，宋老师，还在等它的主人呢。
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, still waiting for its owner.

examples.text: 别念叨它，宋老师！我现在差不多喜欢上那两声响了。
examples.trans: Don't tempt it, Teacher Song! I have almost grown fond of those two rings now.

它们.gloss: they; them (for things, plants, or animals)

meanings.en: they; them (for things, plants, or animals)
meanings.note: Pinyin: tā men. Non-human plural pronoun 它 ('it') + plural suffix 们.

examples.text: 这几扇旧窗板都是灰色的，我以前都没注意过它们。
examples.trans: These old shutters are all grey; I never even noticed them before.

examples.text: 把工具擦干净以后，请把它们放回木箱里。
examples.trans: After wiping the tools clean, please put them back in the wooden chest.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shǒu. Used for minding the front desk or keeping watch over a shop.

examples.text: 你们守着，我出门啦！
examples.trans: Hold the fort—I am heading out the door!

examples.text: 一家雨夜修阁楼台灯、还替陌生人守箱子的客栈。
examples.trans: One that fixes attic lamps on a rainy night and guards a stranger's bag.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ān quán. Describes safe storage or safe travel.

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 现在他的箱子还安全锁着呢。
examples.trans: For now, his suitcase stays safely locked up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ān pái. Used as both verb ('arrange a room') and noun ('an arrangement').

examples.text: 我在做梦吗？！志豪，这场重逢是你安排的吗？
examples.trans: Am I dreaming?! Zhihao, did you plan this whole reunion?

examples.text: 生活安排的二重奏比我们自己写得更妙，孩子们。
examples.trans: Life arranges finer duets than we write ourselves, boys.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ān jìng. Core A1 adjective for quiet courtyards and rooms.

examples.text: 很安静，谢谢，不过这个行李箱今天特别重。
examples.trans: Very quiet, thank you, though this suitcase feels especially heavy today.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sòng. Family name of Teacher Song (宋老师).

examples.text: 早上好，小姑娘。我订了房间，我姓宋。
examples.trans: Good morning, young lady. I booked a room; my surname is Song.

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

meanings.note: Pinyin: wán. Most often follows an action verb as a result complement meaning 'finish doing' (读完, 弹完).

examples.text: 每次弹完琴，他都问为什么下雨天钢琴声音更暖。
examples.trans: Whenever I finished playing, he asked why the piano sounded warmer on rainy days.

examples.text: 十二下敲完了……大门外面街上空荡荡的。
examples.trans: Twelve chimes have finished... and the street outside the gate is completely empty.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wán le. Colloquial exclamation when something goes wrong; after a task, means 'finished'.

examples.text: 完了！昨天我没戴眼镜，在平板上接了电话预订！
examples.trans: Disaster! Yesterday without my glasses I took a phone booking on the tablet!

examples.text: 志豪先生，看第一页：下个月改建商业办公室。我们完了！
examples.trans: Mr Zhihao, look at page one: commercial office conversion next month. We are finished!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wán quán. Emphasizes 100% agreement or completeness (完全正确 'completely right').

examples.text: 完全是意外！到表哥家打开一看，里面是乐谱和红丝带。
examples.trans: Completely by accident! At my cousin's home I opened it and saw sheet music and a red ribbon.

examples.text: 完全正确！目前你们四张桌子只接待住店客人。
examples.trans: Exactly right! Right now your four tables only serve overnight inn guests.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wán hǎo. Describes fragile items surviving a trip unbroken.

examples.text: 里面的茶杯呢？还完好吗？
examples.trans: And the teacup inside? Is it still intact?

examples.text: 包裹里的瓷茶杯依然完好。
examples.trans: The porcelain teacup inside the parcel is still intact.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wán hǎo wú sǔn. Four-character idiom praising fragile items kept safe.

examples.text: 我的茶杯完好无损，两兄弟和好了，小晴也找到了新家。
examples.trans: My teacup survived unharmed, two brothers made peace, and Qing found a new home.

examples.text: 寄了上千公里，箱子里的老瓷杯依然完好无损。
examples.trans: Shipped over a thousand kilometers, the porcelain cup arrived completely intact.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wán zhěng. Describes something with no part missing or broken (又干净又完整 'clean and whole').

examples.text: 小晴，你看这些白琴键，又干净又完整。
examples.trans: Qing, look at these white keys—clean and whole.

examples.text: 这张老地图还很完整。
examples.trans: This old map is still complete.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wán měi. Praises a flawless result.

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 热红茶配柠檬蛋糕真是完美！
examples.trans: Hot black tea with lemon cake is simply perfect!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dìng. Used for setting a time or booking an appointment (定好 'settle/fix').

examples.text: 定好闹钟吧，老陈。明早我们跑赢冷水！
examples.trans: Set your alarm, Chen. Tomorrow morning we outrun the cold water!

examples.text: 我们已经定好了明天见面的时间。
examples.trans: We have already set the time to meet tomorrow.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dìng hǎo. Resultative compound 定 ('decide/fix') + 好 ('settled/complete').

examples.text: 星期三咖啡角的菜单已经全部定好了。
examples.trans: Wednesday's menu for the café corner is now completely set.

examples.text: 我们定好了明天早上八点一起刷窗板。
examples.trans: We set eight o'clock tomorrow morning to paint the shutters together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí zài. Describes sturdy materials, unpretentious food, or dependable people.

examples.text: 钢琴里面全是实在的木头、毛毡和钢丝。
examples.trans: Inside a piano it is all solid wood, felt, and steel wire.

examples.text: 这碗热扁豆汤用料实在，喝一碗就饱了。
examples.trans: This bowl of hot lentil soup is made with hearty ingredients; one bowl fills you right up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí qíng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个实情 ('the real situation').

examples.text: 对，小晴。那个蓝行李箱是我的——我把实情全告诉你们。
examples.trans: Yes, Qing. That blue suitcase is mine—and I will tell you both the whole truth.

examples.text: 他决定把实情一五一十告诉大家。
examples.trans: He decided to tell everyone the plain truth.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí huà. Measure word (量词): 句 (jù), e.g. 一句实话 ('an honest word').

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

examples.text: 说实话，今晚我自己都想住这儿了！
examples.trans: Honestly, I almost want to sleep up here myself tonight!

meanings.en: to tell the plain truth; speak frankly
meanings.note: Pinyin: shí huà shí shuō. Four-character idiom ('speak honest words honestly').

examples.text: 谢谢你们实话实说，没让我冒雨再找地方。
examples.trans: Thank you both for speaking honestly instead of sending me back into the rain.

examples.text: 遇到问题别瞒着，实话实说客人最能体谅。
examples.trans: When an issue comes up, speak frankly—guests appreciate honesty most.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kè rén. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位客人 ('a guest').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kè fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间客房 ('a guest room').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房今天到。
examples.trans: Right, eight guest rooms, eight brass keys. Room four arrives today.

examples.text: 星期一你打开了卡住的门；这一周你救了客房、水管、早餐和租约。
examples.trans: On Monday you opened our sticking door; this week you saved rooms, pipes, breakfast, and our lease.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kè zhàn. Measure word (量词): 家 (jiā), e.g. 一家客栈 ('an inn').

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 我们客栈都是五星级服务……哎呀！
examples.trans: At our inn, everything is five-star service... whoops!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kè qi. Famous in 不用客气 / 别客气 ('you're welcome / don't stand on ceremony').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 太客气了，周经理。半杯就好。
examples.trans: How polite of you, Manager Zhou. Half a glass is fine.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiā. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个家 ('a home').

examples.text: 上面怎么用铅笔整齐画了这条街三家客栈？
examples.trans: Why are three inns on this street neatly sketched in pencil on it?

examples.text: 看我们这家旁边写着：院子宽度、街道声音、安静九分！
examples.trans: Look beside ours: Courtyard width, street noise, quiet score nine points!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiā rén. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位家人 ('a family member').

examples.text: 因为房子只是砖头和木头，志鹏，家人才是留住的东西。
examples.trans: Because a house is only brick and timber, Zhipeng—family is what we keep.

examples.text: 周末能跟家人坐在一起吃饭最幸福。
examples.trans: Sitting down to a meal with family on the weekend is pure happiness.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiā jù. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件家具 ('a piece of furniture').

examples.text: 这张老照片我真喜欢，可是新的家具太贵了！
examples.trans: I truly love this old photo, but new furniture costs a fortune!

examples.text: 周经理，谁说要买很贵的新家具了？
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, who said anything about buying expensive new furniture?

related.gloss: a piece of furniture (measure word 件)

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiā lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 家里地方 ('home').

examples.text: 说实话，我选这一带，也是为了一桩家里的旧事。
examples.trans: Honestly, I also chose this neighbourhood for an old family matter.

examples.text: 哦？您家里人以前住在这附近吗？
examples.trans: Oh? Did your family live near here once?

meanings.note: Pinyin: róng yì. Stative adjective ('easy to do'); before a verb, 很容易 / 不容易 means 'easily / not prone to'.

examples.text: 厚陶瓷杯很结实，不容易摔破。
examples.trans: Thick ceramic cups are sturdy and don't break easily.

examples.text: 有老陈带路，找五金摊就容易多了。
examples.trans: With Chen leading the way, finding the hardware stall is much easier.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuān. Describes wide streets, courtyards, or rooms.

examples.text: 小心，周经理，壶嘴很宽！
examples.trans: Careful, Manager Zhou, the pitcher spout is wide!

examples.text: 一点也不介意！窗下这张宽书桌正适合我工作。
examples.trans: Not at all! And this wide desk beneath the window suits my work ideally.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuān dù. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个宽度 ('a width').

examples.text: 看我们这家旁边写着：院子宽度、街道声音、安静九分！
examples.trans: Look beside ours: Courtyard width, street noise, quiet score nine points!

examples.text: 他用尺子量了一下木门的宽度。
examples.trans: He measured the width of the wooden door with a ruler.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jì. Used for mailing letters, postcards, or parcels.

examples.text: 从那个星期天起我们再也没说话。上周我给他寄了一张明信片。
examples.trans: Since that Sunday we have not spoken again. Last week I mailed him a postcard.

examples.text: 房东律师寄来的？奇怪——我们房租一直交到明年夏天了。
examples.trans: Sent by the landlord's lawyer? Strange—our rent is paid right through next summer.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duì. Means 'correct!' on its own, 'right' as a result complement (拿对), or 'to/toward' before a noun.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房今天到。
examples.trans: Right, eight guest rooms, eight brass keys. Room four arrives today.

examples.text: 看拉链旁边……对，有她的名字缩写！
examples.trans: Check beside the zipper... yes, her name initials are here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: duì bu qǐ. Sincere apology; typically answered with 没关系 ('it's alright').

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

examples.text: 我念念：对不起拿错了，请帮我保管到星期五。
examples.trans: Let me read it: Sorry for taking the wrong one; please keep mine until Friday.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duì miàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 街对面 ('across the street').

examples.text: 等等——您本来打算把箱子交给店员，自己躲在街对面看？！
examples.trans: Wait—you originally planned to leave the bag with the clerk and hide across the street watching?!

examples.text: 客栈正对面是一家安静的花店。
examples.trans: Directly across from the inn is a quiet flower shop.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēng. Counts sealed letters and mail items (一封信 'a letter').

examples.text: 我在看天气，小美！铃铛旁边这封厚信是谁放的？
examples.trans: I am checking the weather, Mei! Who put this thick letter beside the bell?

examples.text: 太好了……趁着等他们，我扫一眼这封房东来信。
examples.trans: Wonderful... while we wait, let me glance at this letter from the landlord.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiāng. Formal future marker seen in official notices and legal documents.

examples.text: 产权转让通知：八号小院整栋建筑将作为商业办公楼出售。
examples.trans: Property Transfer Notice: Courtyard Building Eight offered for sale as commercial offices.

examples.text: 咖啡馆将于明早八点开放。
examples.trans: The café will open tomorrow morning at eight.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo. Everyday adjective for small size; also prefixes younger colleagues' names warmly (小晴, 小美).

examples.text: 早上好，小姑娘。我订了房间，我姓宋。
examples.trans: Good morning, young lady. I booked a room; my surname is Song.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo xīn. Literally 'small heart'—pay close attention.

examples.text: 小心，周经理，壶嘴很宽！
examples.trans: Careful, Manager Zhou, the pitcher spout is wide!

examples.text: 拐弯小心点，别碰到墙！
examples.trans: Careful on the turn—do not bump the wall!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo shí. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个小时 ('an hour').

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

examples.text: 七点整——比早餐早半个小时。
examples.trans: Seven sharp—half an hour earlier than breakfast.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo shí hou. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 小时候时光 ('childhood days').

examples.text: 小时候就住隔两条街。星期五对我来说……是重要日子。
examples.trans: Two streets over, when I was little. Friday for me... is an important day.

examples.text: 等一下……梧桐巷十二号，角上还刻着两个小时候的缩写！
examples.trans: Wait a moment... Number twelve, Wutong Lane, with two childhood initials carved on the corner!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo qíng. Friendly name of Courtyard Inn's new receptionist.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiáo měi. Friendly name of Courtyard Inn's baker and barista.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
examples.trans: Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo jié. In music notation, counts bars/measures between vertical barlines (二十四小节 'twenty-four bars').

examples.text: 这首圆舞曲的前八个小节特别轻快。
examples.trans: The opening eight bars of this waltz are especially light and lively.

examples.text: 宋老师用铅笔在第四小节旁边做了记号。
examples.trans: Teacher Song made a pencil mark beside the fourth bar.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo lù. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条小路 ('a small lane').

examples.text: 对！左边有两条小路——我走哪一条？
examples.trans: Yes! There are two small lanes on the left—which one do I take?

examples.text: 院子后面有一条通往河边的小路。
examples.trans: Behind the courtyard runs a footpath down to the river.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo yuàn. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座小院 ('a small courtyard').

examples.text: 有进步！今天小院迎接兄弟重逢——大家保持安静端庄！
examples.trans: Progress! Today our courtyard hosts a brotherly reunion—quiet dignity from everyone!

examples.text: 产权转让通知：八号小院整栋建筑将作为商业办公楼出售。
examples.trans: Property Transfer Notice: Courtyard Building Eight offered for sale as commercial offices.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo yuàn kè zhàn. Eight-room boutique courtyard inn on Wutong Lane in Chengdu.

examples.text: 欢迎来到小院客栈，小晴。明天不会无聊了。
examples.trans: Welcome to Courtyard Inn, Qing. Tomorrow will not be boring.

examples.text: 小院客栈，早上好！我是小晴。
examples.trans: Courtyard Inn, good morning! This is Qing speaking.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiáo niǎo. Measure word (量词): 只 (zhǐ), e.g. 一只小鸟 ('a little bird').

examples.text: 没错。外面大街很吵，进了院子却只听见树叶和小鸟。
examples.trans: Exactly. Outside on the main road it is noisy, yet inside the courtyard you only hear leaves and birds.

examples.text: 早上树上有两只小鸟在唱歌。
examples.trans: Two little birds are singing in the tree this morning.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cháng. Specifically tasting food or drink (尝一尝 / 尝一下); contrast 试 ('try out' objects or clothes).

examples.text: 快来尝一口刚出炉的热面包！
examples.trans: Come taste a bite of warm bread fresh from the oven!

examples.text: 卖蜂蜜的大姐请我们尝了一小勺山蜂蜜。
examples.trans: The honey vendor invited us to taste a little spoonful of mountain honey.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cháng chang. Softened reduplication of 尝 ('taste'), standard when inviting someone to sample food.

examples.text: 快来尝尝我刚烤出来的杏仁柠檬挞！
examples.trans: Come have a taste of the almond lemon tart I just baked!

examples.text: 你先尝尝这碗番茄汤咸淡合适不合适。
examples.trans: Have a taste of this tomato soup first to see if the seasoning is right.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Highlights immediacy, exact location (就在这里), or smooth consequence ('then').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù xiàng. Introduces a vivid comparison.

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

examples.text: 住在这里就像回到自己家一样舒服。
examples.trans: Staying here feels just as cozy as coming home.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù shì. Adds emphatic certainty before a noun ('is the very one').

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 没关系！您就是志豪先生吧？
examples.trans: No problem at all! You must be Mr Zhihao, right?

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù suàn. Pairs with 也 in the next clause: 就算…也… ('even if…, still…').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 留下来，小美。就算他转身走出大门，我也认了。
examples.trans: I am staying, Mei. Even if he turns around and walks straight out the gate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chǐ cun. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个尺寸 ('a size / measurement').

examples.text: 冬天用掉最后一个了。只有桥那边的老五金店有这个尺寸。
examples.trans: Used the last one in winter. Only the old hardware shop past the bridge carries this size.

examples.text: 这两个铜阀门的尺寸完全一样。
examples.trans: The dimensions of these two brass valves are identical.

meanings.en: feel free to; go right ahead
meanings.note: Pinyin: jín guǎn. Warm host adverb inviting someone not to hesitate (尽管说 'feel free to ask').

examples.text: 您尽管看，宋老师。星期一下午大堂暗。
examples.trans: Go right ahead, Teacher Song. Monday afternoon the lobby was dim.

examples.text: 不够喝的话，请尽管叫我添热茶。
examples.trans: If you want a refill, feel free to ask me for more hot tea.

层.gloss: measure word for floors and layers

meanings.en: measure word for floors and layers
meanings.note: Pinyin: céng. Counts building stories (三层 'third floor') and coatings/layers (一层糖粉 'a layer of powdered sugar').

examples.text: 他爷爷会切热柠檬蛋糕，上面撒一层白糖粉！
examples.trans: His grandfather sliced warm lemon cake with a dusting of powdered sugar on top!

examples.text: 面包上面撒了一层白糖粉。
examples.trans: A thin layer of powdered sugar is dusted over the bread.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wū zi. Warm colloquial word for an indoor room (second syllable neutral tone). Measure word: 间 (jiān).

examples.text: 灯一开，整间屋子都亮堂起来了。
examples.trans: As soon as the lamp came on, the whole room brightened up.

examples.text: 窗户打开以后，屋子里满是桂花香。
examples.trans: Once the window was opened, the room filled with sweet osmanthus fragrance.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wū lǐ. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 屋里空间 ('space inside the room').

examples.text: 从明天早上八点开始！屋里四张桌，树下三张桌！
examples.trans: Starting tomorrow morning at eight! Four tables indoors, three tables under the tree!

examples.text: 开了暖气，屋里一下子暖和起来了。
examples.trans: With the heat on, the inside of the room warmed right up.

related.gloss: space inside the room (measure word 间)

meanings.note: Pinyin: wū dǐng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个屋顶 ('a roof').

examples.text: 听屋顶上的雨声，这儿真温馨！
examples.trans: Listen to the rain on the roof—it feels so cosy up here!

examples.text: 哇……你们看这木头屋顶的比例！
examples.trans: Wow... look at the proportions of this timber roof!

meanings.note: Pinyin: píng mù. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块屏幕 ('a screen').

examples.text: 等等，让我把平板屏幕和纸本子放一起看。
examples.trans: Wait—let me look at the tablet screen and the paper ledger side by side.

examples.text: 电脑屏幕上显示着今天的预订信息。
examples.trans: Today's reservation details are showing on the computer screen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shān. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座山 ('a mountain').

examples.text: 这种深色蜂蜜是山里的蜂农送来的。
examples.trans: This dark honey was brought in by beekeepers from the mountains.

examples.text: 雨停以后，远处的青山看得特别清楚。
examples.trans: After the rain stopped, the green hills in the distance looked crystal clear.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shān qiū. Combines 山 ('mountain/hill') + 丘 ('mound/knoll').

examples.text: 把一座大山分成三座小山丘就不觉得难了。
examples.trans: Once you divide a big mountain into three small hills, it no longer feels hard.

examples.text: 村子后面有一片长满绿草的小山丘。
examples.trans: Behind the village lies a stretch of small green hills.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shān máo jǔ mù. Fine-grained hardwood (山毛榉 'beech tree' + 木 'wood') traditionally used in piano actions and hammer shanks.

examples.text: 钢琴里面的许多小零件都是用坚硬的山毛榉木做的。
examples.trans: Many small parts inside a piano are made of hard beechwood.

examples.text: 修山毛榉木的时候动作一定要轻，免得弄裂。
examples.trans: When repairing beechwood you must work gently so as not to split it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: suì. Measure word for age; follows numbers directly without 个 (八十岁 'eighty years old').

examples.text: 声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
examples.trans: Soft-spoken, very polite, around thirty-something, and a bit nervous.

examples.text: 这位老木匠今年七十岁了。
examples.trans: This veteran carpenter is seventy years old this year.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gōng zuò. Measure word (量词): 份 (fèn), e.g. 一份工作 ('a job').

examples.text: 我只是检查安全。这是我的工作。
examples.trans: I am simply checking security. That is my job.

examples.text: 一点也不介意！窗下这张宽书桌正适合我工作。
examples.trans: Not at all! And this wide desk beneath the window suits my work ideally.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gōng zuò shì. Combines 工作 ('work') + 室 ('room/studio'), used for architecture, design, art, or craft studios.

examples.text: 志豪给建筑工作室的搭档打了个电话。
examples.trans: Hao called his partner at the architecture studio.

examples.text: 她的音乐工作室里摆着一架老立式钢琴。
examples.trans: An old upright piano stands in her music studio.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gōng jù fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间工具房 ('a tool room').

examples.text: 楼下我的工具房里有一盏铜台灯。
examples.trans: Downstairs in my workshop there is a brass desk lamp.

examples.text: 扳手和螺丝刀都挂在后院的工具房墙上。
examples.trans: Wrenches and screwdrivers hang on the wall of the back-courtyard tool room.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gōng jù xiāng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个工具箱 ('a toolbox').

examples.text: 工具箱里有备用的铜阀门吗？
examples.trans: Is there a spare brass valve in your toolbox?

examples.text: 付了现金！打开工具箱等我，我往桥那边跑回来了！
examples.trans: Paid in cash! Open your toolbox and wait—I am running back across the bridge!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuǒ. Measure word (量词): 边 (biān), e.g. 左边 ('the left side').

examples.text: 上楼梯，平台往左拐，最上面最后一扇门。
examples.trans: Up the stairs, turn left at the landing, last door at the very top.

examples.text: 出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
examples.trans: Go out the front gate, turn left, and walk straight to the stone bridge.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuǒ tóu. Colloquial locality compound 左 ('left') + 头 ('end of a long object').

examples.text: 我抓住木窗板的左头，你扶着右头。
examples.trans: I'll grab the left end of the wooden shutter while you hold the right end.

examples.text: 长木桌的左头放着一篮新鲜柠檬。
examples.trans: A basket of fresh lemons sits at the left end of the long wooden table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuǒ shǒu. Combines 左 ('left') + 手 ('hand').

examples.text: 你的咖啡杯就在你左手里拿着呢！
examples.trans: Your coffee cup is right there in your left hand!

examples.text: 弹圆舞曲的时候，左手负责稳定的三拍子节奏。
examples.trans: When playing a waltz, the left hand keeps the steady three-beat rhythm.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuǒ bian. Measure word (量词): 边 (biān), e.g. 左边 ('the left side').

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

examples.text: 对！左边有两条小路——我走哪一条？
examples.trans: Yes! There are two small lanes on the left—which one do I take?

meanings.note: Pinyin: chà. Tells minutes 'to' the hour (差五分十二点 'five to twelve') or 'not short a cent' (一分不差).

examples.text: 十、十一、十二。一分不差，谢谢！
examples.trans: Ten, eleven, twelve. Exact to the last cent—thank you!

examples.text: 十二点以后再拆吧，老板！看钟：差五分十二点！
examples.trans: Open it after twelve, boss! Look at the clock: five minutes to twelve!

meanings.en: almost the same; nearly; just about
meanings.note: Pinyin: chà bu duō. Literally 'differ by not much'.

examples.text: 别念叨它，宋老师！我现在差不多喜欢上那两声响了。
examples.trans: Don't tempt it, Teacher Song! I have almost grown fond of those two rings now.

examples.text: 这两个铜阀门的大小看着差不多。
examples.trans: These two brass valves look just about the same size.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chà píng. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条差评 ('a negative review').

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

examples.text: 客栈开业三年，从来没收到过差评。
examples.trans: In three years open, the inn has never received a bad review.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐ jīng. Often pairs with sentence-final 了 (已经到了 'has already arrived').

examples.text: 没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
examples.trans: Exactly! You already fit right in here.

examples.text: 还好烤箱里的面团已经准备好了。
examples.trans: Thankfully the bread dough in the oven is already ready.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàng zi. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条巷子 ('a lane').

examples.text: 走花摊旁边第二条路，别进窄巷子。
examples.trans: Take the second lane beside the flower stall; do not enter the narrow alley.

examples.text: 梧桐巷是一条种满老树的安静巷子。
examples.trans: Wutong Lane is a quiet alley lined with old trees.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Used in city names (成都市) and phrases like 市里 ('downtown / municipal authorities').

examples.text: 市里的工作人员明天上午来院子参观。
examples.trans: Staff from the city office are coming to visit the courtyard tomorrow morning.

examples.text: 星期六一早，城南的花鸟市就热闹起来了。
examples.trans: Early Saturday morning, the flower-and-bird market in the south of the city comes alive.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì chǎng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个市场 ('a market').

examples.text: 给我袋子和现金！路口市场七点开门。
examples.trans: Give me a bag and cash! The corner market opens at seven.

examples.text: 我梦想中的咖啡馆——就在自家院子里！等我去告诉市场老板们！
examples.trans: My dream café—right in our own courtyard! Wait until I tell the market stall owners!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì zhèng. Measure word (量词): 项, e.g. 一项市政 ('municipal service').

examples.text: 房产信？让志豪和我看看——我管市政合同，他懂老建筑保护法！
examples.trans: A property letter? Let Zhihao and me see it—I handle municipal contracts, and he knows heritage building law!

examples.text: 市政工人正在修路边的石板。
examples.trans: Municipal workers are repairing the flagstones along the road.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì zhèng tīng. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座市政厅 ('a city hall').

examples.text: 等等，志鹏——你还在市政厅合同科工作？！
examples.trans: Wait, Zhipeng—you still work at City Hall's contract office?!

examples.text: 下周我保证把半个市政厅的同事都带来小美这儿喝咖啡。
examples.trans: Next week I promise to bring half my City Hall colleagues to Mei's tables.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 市里部门 ('city office').

examples.text: 那你们的客栈租约就受市里法律再保护十年！
examples.trans: Then your inn lease is protected by city law for another ten years!

examples.text: 这份保护条例是市里去年通过的。
examples.trans: This preservation regulation was passed by the city last year.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块布 ('a piece of cloth').

examples.text: 周经理，给您干净布和冷水。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, here is a clean cloth and cold water for you.

examples.text: 请拿一块干净的布擦桌子。
examples.trans: Please take a clean cloth to wipe the table.

related.gloss: a piece of cloth (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: xī wàng. Works as both verb ('hope that…') and noun ('hope').

examples.text: 周经理的意思是……希望每位客人都觉得有十分满意！
examples.trans: What Manager Zhou means is... we hope every guest feels ten-out-of-ten satisfied!

examples.text: 希望您今晚在我们客栈睡个好觉。
examples.trans: We hope you sleep soundly at our inn tonight.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dài. Used for carrying keys, tools, or luggage with you.

examples.text: 这么快就修好了？老陈你随身带着螺丝刀啊！
examples.trans: Fixed that fast? Chen, you carry a screwdriver everywhere on you!

examples.text: 说实话，我选这一带，也是为了一桩家里的旧事。
examples.trans: Honestly, I also chose this neighbourhood for an old family matter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dài lù. Separable verb-object compound 带 ('lead') + 路 ('way/road').

examples.text: 志鹏熟悉这片老街，让他在前面带路吧。
examples.trans: Peng knows these old streets well—let him lead the way in front.

examples.text: 谢谢你带路，不然我们肯定找不到这家小店。
examples.trans: Thank you for leading the way, or we never would have found this little shop.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bāng. Everyday verb for helping someone (帮我一下 'give me a hand').

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
examples.trans: Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bāng máng. Separable verb-object compound (帮个忙 'do a favor').

examples.text: 我们替他看管了一周蓝箱子，他一定愿意帮忙！
examples.trans: After we guarded his blue suitcase all week, he will gladly help!

examples.text: 行李箱太重了，让我来帮忙吧。
examples.trans: That suitcase is heavy—let me give you a hand.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cháng chūn téng. Literally 常 ('ever') + 春 ('spring/green') + 藤 ('climbing vine'): evergreen ivy.

examples.text: 院子石墙上的常春藤一直爬到了窗板旁边。
examples.trans: The ivy on the courtyard stone wall climbed right up beside the shutters.

examples.text: 老陈轻轻把常春藤挪到木花架上，一片叶子也没伤着。
examples.trans: Chen gently lifted the ivy onto the wooden trellis without harming a single leaf.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gàn. Read gàn when meaning 'do work / get a job done' (干得不错 'nicely done!').

examples.text: 第二天上班，干得不错，新手。
examples.trans: For day two on the job, nicely done, rookie.

examples.text: 不许盯着客人看。把箱子交还，干自己的活。
examples.trans: No staring at guests. Hand back the bag and do our own work.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gān jìng. Note first tone gān ('dry/clean'), never fourth tone.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gān mù tou. Combines 干 (gān, 'dry') + 木头 ('wood').

examples.text: 刚打磨好的干木头千万不能淋雨。
examples.trans: Freshly sanded dry wood must never get rained on.

examples.text: 炉子里添了两块干木头，火苗一下就旺了。
examples.trans: Two pieces of dry wood were added to the stove and the flames sprang right up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gān bēi. Festive toast raised with tea, juice, or wine.

examples.text: 为小院客栈干杯——成都最热闹的安静角落！
examples.trans: Cheers to Courtyard Inn—the liveliest quiet corner in Chengdu!

examples.text: 来，为我们大家的友谊干杯！
examples.trans: Come on, let's raise a glass to our friendship!

meanings.note: Pinyin: gān zào. Praises dry storage or a dry attic room.

examples.text: 干燥、暖和、安静。快说还缺什么。
examples.trans: Dry, warm, and quiet. Tell me quickly what is still missing.

examples.text: 三楼向阳，冬天屋里也很干燥。
examples.trans: Because the third floor faces south, it stays dry even in winter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gān shuǎng. Combines 干 (gān, 'dry') + 爽 ('crisp/refreshing'): pleasantly dry without a trace of dampness.

examples.text: 幸好搬得及时，四扇木窗板都干爽得很。
examples.trans: Luckily we moved them in time; all four wooden shutters are bone-dry.

examples.text: 秋天的空气干爽舒适，最适合晒被子。
examples.trans: Autumn air is crisp and dry, ideal for airing quilts.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gān cuì. Suggests cutting straight to a clean solution.

examples.text: 大门门铃响了。干脆有力的一下。
examples.trans: There goes the gate bell. One firm, decisive ring.

examples.text: 既然雨这么大，干脆留下来吃晚饭吧。
examples.trans: Since it is raining this hard, you might as well stay for dinner.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gān tòu. Resultative compound 干 (gān, 'dry') + 透 ('thoroughly / all the way through').

examples.text: 要等第一层绿油漆完全干透，才能刷第二层。
examples.trans: You have to wait until the first coat of green paint dries completely before brushing on the second.

examples.text: 姑姑把九号房锁上，想等屋顶先干透。
examples.trans: My aunt locked Room Nine, wanting to wait until the roof dried completely.

meanings.note: Pinyin: píng. Used as a stative adjective ('flat/level') or resultative complement after verbs (收平 'fold flat', 铺平 'smooth flat').

examples.text: 把折叠椅收平以后，就能靠墙放好了。
examples.trans: Once you fold the chair flat, you can lean it neatly against the wall.

examples.text: 院子中间的石板路铺得很平。
examples.trans: The flagstone path in the middle of the courtyard is laid very flat.

meanings.note: Pinyin: píng tái. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个平台 ('a landing / platform').

examples.text: 上楼梯，平台往左拐，最上面最后一扇门。
examples.trans: Up the stairs, turn left at the landing, last door at the very top.

examples.text: 二楼楼梯平台放着一盆绿植。
examples.trans: A potted plant sits on the second-floor stair landing.

meanings.note: Pinyin: píng shí. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 平时日子 ('ordinary days').

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 那我们平时为什么不租给客人呢？
examples.trans: Then why do we never rent it out to guests?

meanings.note: Pinyin: píng bǎn. Measure word (量词): 台, e.g. 一台平板 ('a tablet').

examples.text: 完了！昨天我没戴眼镜，在平板上接了电话预订！
examples.trans: Disaster! Yesterday without my glasses I took a phone booking on the tablet!

examples.text: 等等，让我把平板屏幕和纸本子放一起看。
examples.trans: Wait—let me look at the tablet screen and the paper ledger side by side.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nián. Time classifier taking no 个 directly after numbers (六年 'six years', 今年 'this year').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nián qīng rén. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个年轻人 ('a young person').

examples.text: 声音客气吗？年轻人还是老人？
examples.trans: Was the voice polite? A young person or an older person?

examples.text: 巷子里来了不少喜欢老建筑的年轻人。
examples.trans: Many young people fond of historic architecture visit the lane.

related.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

meanings.note: Pinyin: guáng chǎng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个广场 ('a public square').

examples.text: 再往左拐进小广场，找一扇蓝木门。
examples.trans: Then turn left into the small square and look for a blue wooden door.

examples.text: 早上有不少老人在小广场散步。
examples.trans: Plenty of seniors stroll around the small square in the morning.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuáng. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张床 ('a bed').

examples.text: 阁楼里真的有像样的床吗？
examples.trans: Does the attic really have a proper bed?

examples.text: 有，结实的木床、干净书桌，风景全院最好。
examples.trans: Yes, a solid wooden bed, a clean desk, and the best view in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuáng dān. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张床单 ('a bedsheet').

examples.text: 我去柜子拿干净的白床单！
examples.trans: I will fetch clean white bedsheets from the cupboard!

examples.text: 小晴，把床单角塞紧！放上两个软枕头。
examples.trans: Qing, tuck the sheet corner tight! On go the two soft pillows.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuáng tóu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个床头 ('the head of a bed').

examples.text: 好：有床、桌子和椅子，可是没有床头台灯。
examples.trans: Okay: there is a bed, a table, and a chair, yet no bedside lamp.

examples.text: 床头小桌上放着一盏暖光台灯。
examples.trans: A warm bedside lamp sits on the nightstand.

related.gloss: the head of a bed (measure word 个)

meanings.note: Pinyin: yìng jí. Verb-object compound 应 ('respond to') + 急 ('urgent need'); often modifies nouns (应急灯 'emergency light').

examples.text: 前台抽屉里一直放着一把手电筒应急。
examples.trans: There is always a flashlight kept in the front-desk drawer for emergencies.

examples.text: 多准备四把椅子，客人多的时候可以应急。
examples.trans: Keep four extra chairs ready in case we need them for a sudden crowd of guests.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yīng gāi. Expresses obligation or confident expectation.

examples.text: 今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
examples.trans: Tonight I should be able to sleep well after all.

examples.text: 八点半了，邮递员应该快到了。
examples.trans: It is eight thirty; the mail carrier should be here soon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǐ xia. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最底下 ('the bottom').

examples.text: 看车轮底下——铅笔写的你和我的名字还在那儿。
examples.trans: Look underneath the wheels—your name and mine in pencil are still right there.

examples.text: 前面锁扣有个小锁孔，再看底下贴着：一把旧铜钥匙！
examples.trans: There is a tiny keyhole on the front latch, and taped underneath: an old brass key!

meanings.note: Pinyin: diàn. Measure word (量词): 家 (jiā), e.g. 一家店 ('a shop / inn').

examples.text: 完全正确！目前你们四张桌子只接待住店客人。
examples.trans: Exactly right! Right now your four tables only serve overnight inn guests.

examples.text: 这条街上有好几家小店。
examples.trans: There are several small shops along this street.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diàn zhǔ. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位店主 ('a shopkeeper').

examples.text: 速度真快！店主给你收据了吗？
examples.trans: Impressive speed! Did the shopkeeper give you a receipt?

examples.text: 隔壁花店的店主每天早上送鲜花来。
examples.trans: The flower-shop owner next door delivers fresh blooms every morning.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diàn yuán. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位店员 ('a shop clerk').

examples.text: 门上方只画着一把金色钥匙。拿旧阀门给店员看。
examples.trans: Only a golden key painted above the door. Show the clerk the old valve.

examples.text: 等等——您本来打算把箱子交给店员，自己躲在街对面看？！
examples.trans: Wait—you originally planned to leave the bag with the clerk and hide across the street watching?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: diàn zhǎng. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位店长 ('a store manager').

examples.text: 小晴，你真是天生的店长！我的血压保住了！
examples.trans: Qing, you are a born innkeeper! My blood pressure is saved!

examples.text: 面包店的店长请大家尝新烤的蛋糕。
examples.trans: The bakery manager invited everyone to taste the freshly baked cake.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diàn mén. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇店门 ('a shop door').

examples.text: 店门外面有大招牌吗？
examples.trans: Is there a big shop sign outside the door?

examples.text: 早上七点半，咖啡馆准时打开店门。
examples.trans: At seven thirty sharp, the café opens its shop doors.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dù. Marks degrees of temperature, angles, or measured levels.

examples.text: 仔细看这一页——记的是分贝和安静度，不是酒店星级！
examples.trans: Look closely at this page—it records decibels and quietness, not hotel stars!

examples.text: 今天下午的气温是二十度。
examples.trans: The temperature this afternoon is twenty degrees.

座.gloss: measure word for bridges, buildings, mountains

meanings.en: measure word for bridges, buildings, mountains
meanings.note: Pinyin: zuò. Counts large, fixed structures on a base (一座石桥 'a stone bridge', 一座钟楼 'a clock tower').

examples.text: 何止认识！整整六年，每个星期五我都爬那座木楼梯教钢琴！
examples.trans: More than know it! Every Friday for six whole years I climbed those wooden stairs to teach piano!

examples.text: 前面有一座古老的石桥。
examples.trans: There is an old stone bridge ahead.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuò bǎn. Compound 座 ('seat') + 板 ('wooden board'): the hinged wooden seat panel of a folding chair.

examples.text: 把木头座板往上轻轻一提，椅子就合上了。
examples.trans: Lift the wooden seat board slightly upward and the chair folds shut.

examples.text: 老陈用砂纸把椅子座板打磨得很光滑。
examples.trans: Chen sanded the chair seat board completely smooth with sandpaper.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn zhù. Measure word (量词): 栋 (dòng), e.g. 一栋建筑 ('a building').

examples.text: 产权转让通知：八号小院整栋建筑将作为商业办公楼出售。
examples.trans: Property Transfer Notice: Courtyard Building Eight offered for sale as commercial offices.

examples.text: 一位研究成都历史小院建筑的建筑师啊！
examples.trans: An architect who studies historic courtyard buildings in Chengdu!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn zhù shī. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位建筑师 ('an architect').

examples.text: 你的服务值得十分！其实我是声学建筑师。
examples.trans: Your service deserves ten points! Actually, I am an acoustic architect.

examples.text: 声学建筑师！您设计音乐厅吗？
examples.trans: An acoustic architect! Do you design concert halls?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi. Versatile verb for opening doors, starting business, turning on taps/lights, or water boiling.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi guān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个开关 ('a switch').

examples.text: 周经理，等一分钟，先别碰那个铜开关。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, wait a minute—don't touch that brass switch yet.

examples.text: 老板，这是三十年的老电线。我检查以前，千万别按开关。
examples.trans: Boss, this wire is thirty years old. Never flip a switch before I check it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi tóu. Noun (or separable verb) 开 ('open/start') + 头 ('head/beginning').

examples.text: 这首圆舞曲开头的旋律轻快又明亮。
examples.trans: The opening melody of this waltz is light and bright.

examples.text: 故事的开头发生在一个下着大雨的五月夜晚。
examples.trans: The beginning of the story takes place on a rainy night in May.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi shǐ. Everyday verb for starting work, breakfast, or a lesson.

examples.text: 听……街口钟楼开始敲十二下了！
examples.trans: Listen... the clock tower at the end of the street is starting to strike twelve!

examples.text: 从明天早上八点开始！屋里四张桌，树下三张桌！
examples.trans: Starting tomorrow morning at eight! Four tables indoors, three tables under the tree!

开幕.gloss: opening (of an exhibition, festival, or venue)

meanings.en: opening (of an exhibition, festival, or venue)
meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi mù. Literally 开 ('open/raise') + 幕 ('stage curtain').

examples.text: 志豪决定留在成都参加星期五的开幕之夜。
examples.trans: Hao decided to stay in Chengdu for Friday's opening night.

examples.text: 社区音乐节将在下星期六正式开幕。
examples.trans: The neighborhood music festival will officially open next Saturday.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi xīn. Literally 'open-hearted'—everyday word for feeling happy.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 宋老师，那怎么哄他开心呢？
examples.trans: Teacher Song, how did you coax him into smiling again?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi fàng. Describes opening a courtyard, garden, or café to visitors.

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

examples.text: 比现在翻一倍！我们真的要对整条街开放小院咖啡馆吗？
examples.trans: Double what I bake now! Are we really opening the courtyard café to our whole street?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi shān. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件开衫 ('a cardigan').

examples.text: 您看，这件软羊毛开衫是全新的，试试吧。
examples.trans: Look, this soft wool cardigan is brand-new; try it on.

examples.text: 起风了，披上一件羊毛开衫吧。
examples.trans: The breeze is picking up—put on a wool cardigan.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi guò. Directional/resultative compound 开 ('drive') + 过 ('past/across').

examples.text: 刚才有一辆送货卡车从巷子口开过。
examples.trans: A delivery truck just drove past the mouth of the lane.

examples.text: 公交车慢慢开过种满梧桐树的老街。
examples.trans: The bus drove slowly down the old street lined with plane trees.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi suǒ. Separable verb-object compound.

examples.text: 老板正在开锁呢！别挂电话，等一秒。
examples.trans: The owner is unlocking it right now! Stay on the phone, wait one second.

examples.text: 老铜锁需要先把钥匙往右转才能开锁。
examples.trans: With the old brass lock, turn the key right first to unlock it.

meanings.en: open the door; open for business
meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi mén. Means both opening a physical door and opening a shop for the day.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 晚上九点？你站这儿，我们一起去开门。
examples.trans: Nine in the evening? Stay right here; let us go open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nòng. Colloquial action verb before result complements (弄丢 'lose', 弄湿 'get wet', 弄好 'fix up').

examples.text: 下雨的时候，纸不会弄丢房间名单。
examples.trans: When it rains, paper will not lose the room list.

examples.text: 弄好了！蓝地毯放在床旁边正合适。
examples.trans: Done! And the blue rug right beside the bed fits just right.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nòng huài. Colloquial resultative compound 弄 ('make/do/handle') + 坏 ('broken/spoiled').

examples.text: 三十年前的那场暴风雨弄坏了阳光房的屋顶。
examples.trans: That storm thirty years ago damaged the sunroom roof.

examples.text: 用工具的时候慢一点，别弄坏了旧木头。
examples.trans: Go slowly with the tools so you don't damage the old wood.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nòng liè. Resultative compound 弄 ('cause to become') + 裂 ('cracked/split').

examples.text: 老陈用细镊子装轴销，一点也没弄裂山毛榉木。
examples.trans: Chen seated the pin with fine tweezers without splitting the beechwood at all.

examples.text: 钉钉子以前先钻个小孔，才不会把木板弄裂。
examples.trans: Drill a tiny pilot hole before hammering a nail so you won't split the board.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì di. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个弟弟 ('a younger brother').

examples.text: 那里住着一位老木匠和两个孙子——哥哥弹钢琴，弟弟最爱小火车！
examples.trans: An old carpenter lived there with two grandsons—the older brother played piano, and the younger loved toy trains!

examples.text: 那抱着木头小火车的弟弟呢？
examples.trans: And what about the younger brother holding the wooden train?

张.gloss: measure word for flat surfaces and paper

meanings.en: measure word for flat surfaces and paper
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhāng. Counts tables, beds, paper sheets, tickets, receipts, and luggage tags (一张桌子, 一张纸).

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 旁边的把手上系着一张小纸牌。
examples.trans: There is a small paper card tied on the side handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tán. Used for playing the piano or guitar (弹钢琴 'play the piano').

examples.text: 那里住着一位老木匠和两个孙子——哥哥弹钢琴，弟弟最爱小火车！
examples.trans: An old carpenter lived there with two grandsons—the older brother played piano, and the younger loved toy trains!

examples.text: 哥哥性格爽朗声音大，弹音阶总是急匆匆的。
examples.trans: The older brother was bold and loud, always rushing through his scales.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tán qín. Separable verb-object compound.

examples.text: 宋老师？！每星期五教我哥哥弹琴的宋老师？！
examples.trans: Teacher Song?! The Teacher Song who taught my brother piano every Friday?!

examples.text: 每天下午她都在窗边安静地弹琴。
examples.trans: Every afternoon she plays the piano quietly by the window.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dāng. Means 'act in the role of' (当哥哥 'be an older brother', 当前台主管 'serve as front-desk manager').

examples.text: 老陈，你真懂当哥哥的人。
examples.trans: Chen, you really understand older brothers.

examples.text: 别抢人，小美！小晴，你愿意留下来当正式前台主管吗？
examples.trans: No poaching, Mei! Qing, are you willing to stay on as our permanent front-desk manager?

当上.gloss: become; take up a post or role

meanings.en: become; take up a post or role
meanings.note: Pinyin: dāng shàng. Resultative compound 当 ('serve as') + 上 ('attain a role').

examples.text: 志鹏笑着说他们兄弟俩当上了正式试吃员。
examples.trans: Peng joked that the two brothers had become official taste testers.

examples.text: 苦练三年以后，她终于当上了乐团的首席乐手。
examples.trans: After three years of dedicated practice, she finally became first chair in the orchestra.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dāng xīn. Friendly caution on slippery steps or with hot pots.

examples.text: 当心那把角落椅子，等十秒我拧紧螺丝。
examples.trans: Mind that corner chair—wait ten seconds while I tighten the screw.

examples.text: 石板路刚下过雨，走路请当心。
examples.trans: It just rained on the flagstones—watch your step.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dāng rán. Warm, reassuring reply ('Of course!').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐng zi. Second syllable neutral tone. Measure word: 个 (gè) or 道 (dào).

examples.text: 夕阳把竹子的影子投在白墙上。
examples.trans: The setting sun casts the bamboo's shadow onto the white wall.

examples.text: 灯光下，我看见琴盖后面有一个白纸影子。
examples.trans: Under the lamplight, I spotted the shadow of white paper behind the piano lid.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎng. Guides movement in directions (往上提 'lift upward', 往左拐 'turn left').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎng shàng. Directional phrase 往 ('toward') + 上 ('up'), placed directly before action verbs (往上抬 'lift upward').

examples.text: 先把窗板轻轻往上抬一点，再往外拉。
examples.trans: Lift the shutter slightly upward first, then pull outward.

examples.text: 到了中间部分，圆舞曲的旋律一步步往上升。
examples.trans: In the middle section, the waltz melody climbs upward step by step.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎng wài. Directional phrase 往 ('toward') + 外 ('outside').

examples.text: 透过擦干净的拱窗往外看，整个院子绿油油的。
examples.trans: Looking outward through the clean arched window, the whole courtyard is lush green.

examples.text: 这两扇木头窗板是往外推开的。
examples.trans: These two wooden shutters swing open outward.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hěn. Links a subject to a simple predicate adjective without needing 是 (今天很冷 'It is cold today').

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
examples.trans: Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!

examples.text: 没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
examples.trans: Exactly! You already fit right in here.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hén jiǔ. Often follows a verb or precedes 以前.

examples.text: 老砖房顶楼平时要等很久水才热。
examples.trans: Top floors in old brick houses usually wait ages before the water warms up.

examples.text: 我们在站台上等了很久。
examples.trans: We waited on the platform for a long time.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hěn kuài. Describes quick speed or imminent arrival.

examples.text: 箱子的主人肯定很快会来找的。
examples.trans: The suitcase's owner will surely come looking for it soon.

examples.text: 别着急，热水很快就会上来了。
examples.trans: No rush—the hot water will come up very soon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǜ shī. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位律师 ('a lawyer').

examples.text: 房东律师寄来的？奇怪——我们房租一直交到明年夏天了。
examples.trans: Sent by the landlord's lawyer? Strange—our rent is paid right through next summer.

examples.text: 我弟弟是一位专门管房产合同的律师。
examples.trans: My younger brother is a lawyer specializing in property contracts.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Read de after a verb to introduce how it goes (走得快 'walk fast'); read děi before a verb to mean 'must'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de hěn. Post-adjectival degree complement (干爽得很 'bone-dry / very dry').

examples.text: 搬进走廊的四扇木窗板全都干爽得很。
examples.trans: All four wooden shutters carried into the hallway are bone-dry.

examples.text: 老陈修门锁的手艺稳当得很。
examples.trans: Chen's craftsmanship in fixing door locks is rock-steady.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dé jiù. Note second tone dé ('obtain rescue').

examples.text: 得救了！失陪一分钟，宋老师，您慢喝热茶！
examples.trans: Saved! Excuse me one minute, Teacher Song—enjoy your hot tea!

examples.text: 找到那份老条例，我们的客栈终于得救了！
examples.trans: Finding that historic regulation finally saved our inn!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wēi xiào. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个微笑 ('a smile').

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 哎呀！透过窗户看见周经理了？我明明加倍用力微笑了！
examples.trans: Oh dear! You spotted Manager Zhou through the window? I smiled twice as wide!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīn. Measure word (量词): 颗 (kē), e.g. 一颗心 ('a heart').

examples.text: 我心跳得好快！小晴你去说，你声音稳重诚实！
examples.trans: My heart is pounding! Qing, you explain it—you sound calm and honest!

examples.text: 志鹏不会走的。他总是嘴硬五秒钟，心马上就软了。
examples.trans: Zhipeng will not leave. He always talked tough for five seconds, then softened right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīn yì. Measure word (量词): 份 (fèn), e.g. 一份心意 ('a thoughtful gesture').

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 这盒茶叶是我的一点心意，请收下。
examples.trans: This box of tea leaves is a small token of appreciation—please take it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhì háo. Given name of Zhipeng's older brother, an acoustic architect.

examples.text: 没关系！您就是志豪先生吧？
examples.trans: No problem at all! You must be Mr Zhihao, right?

examples.text: 是的，我叫志豪。昨天打电话订了七号房。
examples.trans: Yes, my name is Zhihao. Yesterday I booked room seven by phone.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhì péng. Given name of Zhihao's younger brother.

examples.text: 白纸里面包的东西是给我哥哥志鹏的，不是我的。
examples.trans: What is wrapped inside that white paper is for my brother Zhipeng, not mine.

examples.text: 您为什么不直接去志鹏家门口把木头小火车交给他呢？
examples.trans: Why not go straight to Zhipeng's door and hand him the wooden train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: wàng. Everyday verb for forgetting an item or fact (忘了 'forgot').

examples.text: 您刚才忘在楼下前台汤碗旁边了。
examples.trans: You left it downstairs beside the soup bowl at the front desk.

examples.text: 星期五之前我想在附近找个安静地方，结果忘了箱子还在这儿！
examples.trans: Before Friday I wanted a quiet place nearby, and forgot my bag was still here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: máng. Describes a busy person, morning, or shop.

examples.text: 啊！忙着行李箱、热水器和来信，我完全忘了！
examples.trans: Oh! With the suitcases, the water heater, and the letter, I completely forgot!

examples.text: 早上前台总是特别忙。
examples.trans: The front desk is always especially busy in the morning.

meanings.note: Pinyin: máng luàn. Describes a frantic morning rush.

examples.text: 你看，早餐忙乱和神秘电话你都挺过来了！
examples.trans: Look, you made it through both the breakfast rush and the mystery phone call!

examples.text: 早高峰虽然人多，前台却一点也不忙乱。
examples.trans: Even with the morning crowd, the front desk is never hectic.

meanings.en: bustle about; keep busy with chores
meanings.note: Pinyin: máng huo. Warm colloquial verb for working busily.

examples.text: 小美，千万别因为我们多忙活。
examples.trans: Mei, please do not go to extra trouble on our account.

examples.text: 她在厨房里忙活了一整个早上。
examples.trans: She bustled around the kitchen all morning long.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. As an adjective/adverb, 'fast/quickly'; in 快…了, 'about to'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài diǎn. Everyday prompt to pick up speed.

examples.text: 快点——我刚听到二楼楼梯有脚步声！
examples.trans: Hurry—I just heard footsteps on the second-floor stairs!

examples.text: 火车快开了，我们走快点吧。
examples.trans: The train is about to leave—let's walk a bit faster.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài sòng. Concise shopfront/van phrase combining 快 ('fast/express') + 送 ('deliver').

examples.text: 家具店的货车上写着“同城快送”四个字。
examples.trans: The furniture shop's van has 'Same-City Express Delivery' painted on the side.

examples.text: 早上订的新鲜牛奶，中午快送就到了。
examples.trans: The fresh milk ordered in the morning arrived by express delivery at noon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: niàn. Used for reading a letter or notice out loud (念第一行 'read the first line aloud').

examples.text: 二十毫米、铜的、热水器阀门——我一路念过去！
examples.trans: Twenty millimetres, brass, water-heater valve—I will repeat it all the way!

examples.text: 十九条理由？！您是迎接哥哥，还是念火车时刻表呀？
examples.trans: Nineteen reasons?! Are you welcoming your brother or reading a train timetable?

meanings.note: Pinyin: niàn dao. Describes mentioning someone warmly over and over.

examples.text: 别念叨它，宋老师！我现在差不多喜欢上那两声响了。
examples.trans: Don't tempt it, Teacher Song! I have almost grown fond of those two rings now.

examples.text: 奶奶平时总爱念叨小时候的老街。
examples.trans: Grandmother always talks fondly about the old street from her childhood.

meanings.note: Pinyin: niàn nian. Softened reduplication of 念 ('read out').

examples.text: 我念念：对不起拿错了，请帮我保管到星期五。
examples.trans: Let me read it: Sorry for taking the wrong one; please keep mine until Friday.

examples.text: 字太小了，你帮我念念信上写的什么。
examples.trans: The print is tiny—read aloud for me what the letter says.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zěn me. Before a verb, asks 'how to do X?' (怎么走) or 'how come…?' (怎么还没来).

examples.text: 我的眼镜怎么会在……哎呀！在我头上！
examples.trans: Why would my glasses be in... oh dear! They are on my head!

examples.text: 宋老师，怎么了？您按了门铃！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, what happened? You rang the bell!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zěn me bàn. Everyday phrase when facing a dilemma.

examples.text: 外面下着大雨，街上酒店全满了！我们怎么办？
examples.trans: It is pouring rain outside and every hotel on the street is full! What do we do?

examples.text: 钥匙锁在屋里了，这下我们怎么办？
examples.trans: The key is locked inside the room—what do we do now?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zěn me yàng. Asks for an opinion or update on how things are going.

examples.text: 怎么样？他发火了吗？要退钱吗？
examples.trans: How did it go? Did he lose his temper? Did he ask for a refund?

examples.text: 小晴，今天我的领带怎么样？一滴橙汁都没有！
examples.trans: Qing, how does my tie look today? Not a single drop of orange juice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: pà. Expresses fear, worry, or sensitivity to noise/cold (怕吵 'dislike noise').

examples.text: 说真的，我怕一楼吵。我太喜欢这间房了！
examples.trans: Truthfully, I dislike noisy ground-floor rooms. I love this room!

examples.text: 哈！你怕签了名字，倔脾气大哥就不出门了！
examples.trans: Aha! You feared that if you signed your name, stubborn big brother would stay home!

meanings.note: Pinyin: sī kǎo. More deliberate and analytical than everyday 想 ('think/want').

examples.text: 志豪站在拱门下，安静地思考房间的回声。
examples.trans: Hao stood under the archway quietly pondering the room's acoustics.

examples.text: 做决定以前，最好先坐下来认真思考一下。
examples.trans: Before making a decision, it is best to sit down and think it through carefully.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jí. Describes rushing or feeling anxious.

examples.text: 哎呀！我跑得太急，包装看着都一样！
examples.trans: Oh no! I was running in such a rush that the wrappers all looked alike!

examples.text: 快坐在向阳窗户边，宋老师！先别急着上楼！
examples.trans: Sit right down by the sunny window, Teacher Song! No rush to go back upstairs yet!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jí shì. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件急事 ('an urgent matter').

examples.text: 糟了！周经理，小晴，厨房出急事了！
examples.trans: Oh no! Manager Zhou, Qing, we have a kitchen emergency!

examples.text: 我还没喝早咖啡呢，千万别说急事！
examples.trans: I have not had my morning coffee yet; please do not say emergency!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jí cōng cōng. Vivid ABB-pattern adverb.

examples.text: 哥哥性格爽朗声音大，弹音阶总是急匆匆的。
examples.trans: The older brother was bold and loud, always rushing through his scales.

examples.text: 他夹着公文包急匆匆地跑进了院子。
examples.trans: Tucking his briefcase under his arm, he hurried into the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xìng gé. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种性格 ('a personality').

examples.text: 哥哥性格爽朗声音大，弹音阶总是急匆匆的。
examples.trans: The older brother was bold and loud, always rushing through his scales.

examples.text: 两兄弟性格不同，却都很热心。
examples.trans: The two brothers have different personalities, yet both are warm-hearted.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guài. As a verb, 'blame' (别怪我); as an adjective/adverb, 'strange / quite'.

examples.text: 不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
examples.trans: It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!

examples.text: 为了一个木头小火车紧张？这事越来越怪了。
examples.trans: Nervous over a wooden toy train? This story gets stranger by the hour.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guài bu de. Literally 'cannot blame it'—used when a puzzle suddenly clicks.

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

examples.text: 原来窗户没关严，怪不得屋里有点凉！
examples.trans: So the window was not shut tight—no wonder the room felt cool!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǒng. Indicates what consistently happens or must happen (总得有人 'somebody has to').

examples.text: 总得有人照顾院子里的花草嘛。
examples.trans: Somebody has to look after the courtyard plants, after all.

examples.text: 拿稳了！你已经关掉总水阀了吗？
examples.trans: Steady! Did you turn off the main water valve already?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǒng shì. Placed before a verb to describe a consistent habit.

examples.text: 哥哥性格爽朗声音大，弹音阶总是急匆匆的。
examples.trans: The older brother was bold and loud, always rushing through his scales.

examples.text: 志鹏不会走的。他总是嘴硬五秒钟，心马上就软了。
examples.trans: Zhipeng will not leave. He always talked tough for five seconds, then softened right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nín. Respectful singular 'you' used with elders, teachers, and guests (您好！).

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nín hǎo. Respectful greeting using polite 您 ('you') for elders, teachers, and guests.

examples.text: 您好，欢迎来到小院客栈！
examples.trans: Hello, welcome to Courtyard Inn!

examples.text: 老师您好，请进屋喝杯热茶。
examples.trans: Hello, Teacher—please come inside for a cup of hot tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīng yà. Describes surprise at unexpected news.

examples.text: 宋老师，您一脸惊讶！您认识梧桐巷十二号吗？
examples.trans: Teacher Song, you look amazed! Do you know Number twelve, Wutong Lane?

examples.text: 看到二十年没见的老朋友，他十分惊讶。
examples.trans: Seeing an old friend after twenty years, he was astonished.

meanings.en: want to; would like to; think; miss
meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎng. Before a verb, expresses a polite wish ('would like to'); before a noun/person, 'think of / miss'.

examples.text: 太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
examples.trans: Wonderful! Now I would like to eat a big breakfast.

examples.text: 宋老师早！您想喝咖啡还是红茶？
examples.trans: Morning, Teacher Song! Would you like coffee or black tea?

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiáng qǐ lái. Literally 'think up-come': a memory coming back to mind (我想起来了 'now I remember').

examples.text: 我想起来了！我十岁的时候，叔叔叫它冬天茶室！
examples.trans: Now I remember! When I was ten, my uncle called it the winter tea room!

examples.text: 我想起来了，钥匙在抽屉里！
examples.trans: Now I remember, the key is in the drawer!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì wài. Works as an adjective ('unexpected') or noun ('a surprise').

examples.text: 完全是意外！到表哥家打开一看，里面是乐谱和红丝带。
examples.trans: Completely by accident! At my cousin's home I opened it and saw sheet music and a red ribbon.

examples.text: 真是个让人开心的意外惊喜！
examples.trans: What a delightful surprise!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì si. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个意思 ('a meaning').

examples.text: 周经理的意思是……希望每位客人都觉得有十分满意！
examples.trans: What Manager Zhou means is... we hope every guest feels ten-out-of-ten satisfied!

examples.text: 哎呀，怎么好意思拿房东烦心事打扰付钱的客人！
examples.trans: Oh dear, how could we bother a paying guest with our landlord troubles!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuàn yì. Used when accepting an invitation or job offer.

examples.text: 我们替他看管了一周蓝箱子，他一定愿意帮忙！
examples.trans: After we guarded his blue suitcase all week, he will gladly help!

examples.text: 别抢人，小美！小晴，你愿意留下来当正式前台主管吗？
examples.trans: No poaching, Mei! Qing, are you willing to stay on as our permanent front-desk manager?

meanings.note: Pinyin: huāng. Describes feeling rattled or panicked (别慌 'don't panic').

examples.text: 等周经理听说他为分贝慌了一整夜，表情一定精彩！
examples.trans: Wait until Manager Zhou hears he panicked all night over decibels!

examples.text: 对。我一慌，按了门铃，把星期五纸条贴在把手上。
examples.trans: Yes. In a panic I rang the bell and taped the Friday note onto the handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: màn. Everyday adjective for slow speed; doubled in 慢慢 ('slowly, take your time').

examples.text: 得救了！失陪一分钟，宋老师，您慢喝热茶！
examples.trans: Saved! Excuse me one minute, Teacher Song—enjoy your hot tea!

examples.text: 再等几分钟，志豪先生。中午城里堵车总是很慢。
examples.trans: Give it a few more minutes, Mr Zhihao. Midday city traffic is always slow.

meanings.note: Pinyin: màn màn. Polite host phrase: 慢慢吃 ('take your time eating'), 慢慢走 ('walk safely').

examples.text: 凉？啊——对！老街水管早上需要慢慢热身！
examples.trans: Cool? Ah—yes! Old-street water pipes need a gentle morning warm-up!

examples.text: 把蓝色转轮慢慢往左拧开——别太快。
examples.trans: Turn the blue wheel open slowly to the left—not too fast.

meanings.note: Pinyin: màn yòng. Courteous café and restaurant phrase meaning 'please enjoy at your leisure'.

examples.text: 一定转达！请慢用。
examples.trans: I certainly will! Please enjoy your meal.

examples.text: 您的热红茶和肉桂卷齐了，请慢用。
examples.trans: Here are your hot black tea and cinnamon roll—please enjoy.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǒng. Means 'understand' (听懂 'understand by listening').

examples.text: 老陈，你真懂当哥哥的人。
examples.trans: Chen, you really understand older brothers.

examples.text: 房产信？让志豪和我看看——我管市政合同，他懂老建筑保护法！
examples.trans: A property letter? Let Zhihao and me see it—I handle municipal contracts, and he knows heritage building law!

懂行.gloss: know the ropes; know the trade

meanings.en: know the ropes; know the trade
meanings.note: Pinyin: dǒng háng. Note 行 is read 2nd-tone háng ('trade/profession') here, not xíng! Literally 'understand the trade'.

examples.text: 小美一闻柠檬皮就知道新不新鲜，真懂行！
examples.trans: Mei knows whether lemons are fresh from one whiff of the peel—she really knows her stuff!

examples.text: 买老木头家具，最好请懂行的师傅一起去看。
examples.trans: When buying old wooden furniture, it's best to ask someone who knows the trade to come along.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chéng. Frequently serves as a result complement meaning 'into' (变成, 改成).

examples.text: 商业办公楼出售？！把我们的客栈和厨房变成灰色办公室？！
examples.trans: Commercial office sale?! Turn our inn and kitchen into grey offices?!

examples.text: 超过八十年的小院建筑，只要一楼每天服务街坊邻居，禁止改成私人办公室。
examples.trans: Any courtyard building over eighty years old may not become private offices as long as the ground floor serves neighbours daily.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chéng dū. Historic southwestern Chinese city famed for courtyards and tea houses.

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

examples.text: 真的吗？您在成都认识什么人吗？
examples.trans: Really? Do you know someone here in Chengdu?

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ men. First-person plural pronoun; add 的 for 'our' (我们的).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Pinyin: huò zhě. Joins options in statements—contrast 还是 ('or') in questions.

examples.text: 上面有名字或者电话号码吗？
examples.trans: Is there a name or a phone number on it?

examples.text: 早上您可以喝红茶，或者来一杯热咖啡。
examples.trans: In the morning you can have black tea or a cup of hot coffee.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dài. Specifically for accessories placed on the head, face, neck, or wrist—contrast 穿 for clothes/shoes.

examples.text: 哎呀，怎么拿错了！我戴眼镜看看行李牌。
examples.trans: Dear me, what a mix-up! Let me put on my glasses and check the luggage tag.

examples.text: 完了！昨天我没戴眼镜，在平板上接了电话预订！
examples.trans: Disaster! Yesterday without my glasses I took a phone booking on the tablet!

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间房 ('a room').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房今天到。
examples.trans: Right, eight guest rooms, eight brass keys. Room four arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng dōng. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位房东 ('a landlord').

examples.text: 房东律师寄来的？奇怪——我们房租一直交到明年夏天了。
examples.trans: Sent by the landlord's lawyer? Strange—our rent is paid right through next summer.

examples.text: 太好了……趁着等他们，我扫一眼这封房东来信。
examples.trans: Wonderful... while we wait, let me glance at this letter from the landlord.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng chǎn. Measure word (量词): 处, e.g. 一处房产 ('a piece of property').

examples.text: 邮递员刚让我签收的，上面盖着红色房产印章。
examples.trans: The postman just had me sign for it; it carries a red property-office stamp.

examples.text: 房产信？让志豪和我看看——我管市政合同，他懂老建筑保护法！
examples.trans: A property letter? Let Zhihao and me see it—I handle municipal contracts, and he knows heritage building law!

related.gloss: a piece of property (measure word 处)

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng hào. Short compound 房 ('room') + 号 ('number').

examples.text: 绿色登记本的每一页都记着日期和房号。
examples.trans: Every page of the green guest book records the date and room number.

examples.text: 请看钥匙牌上的房号，您的房间在二楼。
examples.trans: Please check the room number on the key tag; your room is on the second floor.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng zi. Measure word (量词): 栋 (dòng), e.g. 一栋房子 ('a house').

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng liáng. Measure word (量词): 根 (gēn), e.g. 一根房梁 ('a roof beam').

examples.text: 哇，看这间房！大木头房梁，窗户正对着院子！
