examples.trans: Wow, look at this room! Big wooden beams, and a window facing the courtyard!

examples.text: 先生，到了。小心碰头，这根木房梁比较低。
examples.trans: Here we are, sir. Mind your head—this wooden beam is fairly low.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng zū. Measure word (量词): 笔 (bǐ), e.g. 一笔房租 ('a rent payment').

examples.text: 房东律师寄来的？奇怪——我们房租一直交到明年夏天了。
examples.trans: Sent by the landlord's lawyer? Strange—our rent is paid right through next summer.

examples.text: 这家小店每个月一号交房租。
examples.trans: This little shop pays its rent on the first of every month.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng jiān. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间房间 ('a room').

examples.text: 下雨的时候，纸不会弄丢房间名单。
examples.trans: When it rains, paper will not lose the room list.

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

meanings.note: Pinyin: suó yǐ. Introduces a result or conclusion, often after 因为.

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

examples.text: 分贝？所以九分不是给我前台服务打的分？
examples.trans: Decibels? So nine points was not a score for my front-desk service?

meanings.note: Pinyin: suó yǒu. Usually followed by 的 or a noun (所有的客人 'all the guests').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 院子里所有的灯笼都亮起来了。
examples.trans: All the lanterns across the courtyard lit up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: biǎn dòu. Literally 扁 ('flat') + 豆 ('bean/legume'), used for flat-podded beans and lentils.

examples.text: 加了柠檬和橄榄油的金黄扁豆汤又香又暖胃。
examples.trans: Golden lentil soup with lemon and olive oil is fragrant and warming.

examples.text: 小美前一天晚上先把扁豆洗干净泡好。
examples.trans: Mei washed and soaked the lentils the night before.

扇.gloss: measure word for doors and windows

meanings.en: measure word for doors and windows
meanings.note: Pinyin: shàn. Counts hinged or sliding doors and windows (一扇门 'a door', 一扇窗户 'a window').

examples.text: 上楼梯，平台往左拐，最上面最后一扇门。
examples.trans: Up the stairs, turn left at the landing, last door at the very top.

examples.text: 再往左拐进小广场，找一扇蓝木门。
examples.trans: Then turn left into the small square and look for a blue wooden door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shǒu. Measure word (量词): 双 (shuāng), e.g. 一双手 ('a pair of hands').

examples.text: 谢谢你，小美。刚才吓了一跳，手都凉了！
examples.trans: Thank you, Mei. That gave me such a start just now that my hands went cold!

examples.text: 我手在发抖——车上下来穿深灰色外套的高个子男人吗？
examples.trans: My hands are shaking—is a tall man in a dark grey coat stepping out?

related.gloss: a pair of hands (measure word 双)

meanings.note: Pinyin: shǒu xiě. Compound 手 ('hand') + 写 ('write'); frequently used before 的 to mean 'handwritten' (手写的菜单).

examples.text: 咖啡馆门口立着一块手写的木头菜单牌。
examples.trans: A handwritten wooden menu board stands by the café entrance.

examples.text: 这张手写的明信片比打印的更有温度。
examples.trans: This handwritten postcard feels much warmer than a printed one.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shǒu zhǐ. Compound 手 ('hand') + 指 ('digit/point'). Measure word: 根 (gēn), e.g. 两根手指 ('two fingers').

examples.text: 宋老师的手指轻轻落在黑白琴键上。
examples.trans: Teacher Song's fingers landed gently on the black and white piano keys.

examples.text: 墙上的油漆还没干，千万别用手指碰。
examples.trans: The paint on the wall isn't dry yet—don't touch it with your fingers.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shǒu diàn tǒng. Measure word (量词): 把 (bǎ), e.g. 一把手电筒 ('a flashlight').

examples.text: 手电筒拿稳，照着这儿的水管接口。
examples.trans: Hold the flashlight steady and shine it on the pipe joint here.

examples.text: 两位快拿手电筒——我的第二周现在就开始！
examples.trans: Grab the flashlight, both of you—my second week starts right now!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shǒu jiǎo. Compound 手 ('hands') + 脚 ('feet'); idiomatic for agility and speed at tasks (手脚真快 'move really fast').

examples.text: 小晴收拾东西手脚真快，两分钟就整理好了。
examples.trans: Qing moves really fast tidying up; she had everything in order in two minutes.

examples.text: 冬天先喝碗热汤，手脚马上就暖和起来了。
examples.trans: Have a bowl of hot soup first in winter and your hands and feet warm right up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shóu biǎo. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块手表 ('a wristwatch').

examples.text: 我手表七点二十九分。客人下楼了。
examples.trans: Seven twenty-nine on my watch. Guests are coming down the stairs.

examples.text: 只要一点黄油，谢谢。周经理，您怎么老看手表？
examples.trans: Just a little butter, thank you. Manager Zhou, why do you keep looking at your watch?

meanings.note: Pinyin: cái. Signals that something happened later than expected or in a small amount—contrast 就.

examples.text: 老砖房顶楼平时要等很久水才热。
examples.trans: Top floors in old brick houses usually wait ages before the water warms up.

examples.text: 因为房子只是砖头和木头，志鹏，家人才是留住的东西。
examples.trans: Because a house is only brick and timber, Zhipeng—family is what we keep.

meanings.en: cling to; hold onto; push aside
meanings.note: Pinyin: bā. Describes holding onto a doorway or ledge to peek inside (扒着门).

examples.text: 说这话的人每隔三十秒就扒着窗帘偷看一次！
examples.trans: Says the man peeking through the window curtain every thirty seconds!

examples.text: 小猫扒着窗台往外看。
examples.trans: The kitten clung to the windowsill looking outside.

meanings.en: hit; make (a call); give (a score); fetch
meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎ. Light verb forming dozens of everyday expressions (打电话 'make a phone call').

examples.text: 小晴，马上给火车站失物处打电话。
examples.trans: Qing, call the train station lost-and-found office right away.

examples.text: 我正在打……您好，请问有人找蓝色行李箱吗？
examples.trans: I am calling now... Hello, excuse me, is anyone looking for a blue suitcase?

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎ jiǔ zhé. In Chinese retail, 打九折 means charging 9/10 (90%) of the list price—i.e. a 10% discount!

examples.text: 老板说买满十二个茶杯就给我们打九折。
examples.trans: The stall owner said if we buy a full twelve teacups, he'll give us ten percent off.

examples.text: 周二带自己的杯子买咖啡可以打九折。
examples.trans: Bringing your own mug for coffee on Tuesdays gets you ten percent off.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎ kāi. Result compound for opening suitcases, envelopes, boxes, or laptops.

examples.text: 我的行李箱！快打开上面口袋……对，红丝带！
examples.trans: My suitcase! Let me open the top pocket... yes, the red ribbon!

examples.text: 先生？他说：请别打开白纸包，我星期五中午来。
examples.trans: Sir? He says: Please do not open the white paper parcel; I will come Friday at noon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dá sǎo. Used for cleaning rooms and courtyards.

examples.text: 我打扫储藏室，把这个蓝色行李箱在这儿放五分钟。
examples.trans: While I sweep the storeroom, let me set this blue suitcase here for five minutes.

examples.text: 客房每天上午都会仔细打扫干净。
examples.trans: Every guest room is thoroughly cleaned each morning.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dá rǎo. Polite opener 打扰一下 ('excuse me for interrupting').

examples.text: 打扰一下，志豪先生？不好意思这么晚敲门。
examples.trans: Excuse me, Mr Zhihao? Sorry to knock so late.

examples.text: 打扰两位先生——热茶来了，热柠檬蛋糕马上到。
examples.trans: Excuse me, gentlemen—here is hot tea, and warm lemon cake is right on the way.

meanings.en: say hello; greet; give a heads-up
meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎ zhāo hu. Separable verb-object phrase.

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

examples.text: 每天早上路过花摊，她都会笑着打招呼。
examples.trans: Passing the flower stall each morning, she greets the owner with a smile.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎ diàn huà. Separable verb-object phrase: 打 ('make/dial') + 电话 ('telephone'); recipient takes 给 (给老陈打电话).

examples.text: 周经理早上打电话订了花园木椅。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou made a phone call in the morning to order wooden garden chairs.

examples.text: 到车站以后记得给我打个电话。
examples.trans: Remember to give me a phone call once you reach the station.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎ mó. Combines 打 ('work/strike') + 磨 ('grind/rub smooth').

examples.text: 刷绿油漆以前，老陈先用细砂纸把旧木板打磨平整。
examples.trans: Before brushing on green paint, Chen sanded the old boards smooth with fine sandpaper.

examples.text: 这块老木头经过仔细打磨，露出了漂亮的木纹。
examples.trans: After careful sanding, this old piece of wood revealed beautiful grain.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎ suàn. Works as both verb ('plan to do') and noun ('a plan').

examples.text: 等等——您本来打算把箱子交给店员，自己躲在街对面看？！
examples.trans: Wait—you originally planned to leave the bag with the clerk and hide across the street watching?!

examples.text: 明年春天我们打算把院子再修一修。
examples.trans: Next spring we plan to spruce up the courtyard again.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rēng. Used for tossing trash or items into a bin (扔进).

examples.text: 看，已经十二点零四分了。也许他把明信片扔进垃圾桶了。
examples.trans: Look, it is twelve-oh-four already. Maybe he tossed the postcard into the bin.

examples.text: 请把废纸扔进垃圾桶里。
examples.trans: Please toss the scrap paper into the trash bin.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sǎo. Means 'sweep the floor', 'scan a code', or 'sweep one's eyes over' (扫一眼 'take a quick glance').

examples.text: 太好了……趁着等他们，我扫一眼这封房东来信。
examples.trans: Wonderful... while we wait, let me glance at this letter from the landlord.

examples.text: 他每天早上都会扫院子。
examples.trans: He sweeps the courtyard every morning.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bān shou. Measure word (量词): 把 (bǎ), e.g. 一把扳手 ('a wrench').

examples.text: 关掉了，水也放空了。把左边那把重扳手递给我。
examples.trans: Turned off and drained. Pass me that heavy wrench on your left.

examples.text: 这把大铁扳手吗？给你。
examples.trans: This big iron wrench? Here you go.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǎo. Focuses on searching; add 到 (找到) for actually finding.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 我正在打……您好，请问有人找蓝色行李箱吗？
examples.trans: I am calling now... Hello, excuse me, is anyone looking for a blue suitcase?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǎo dào. Resultative compound 找 ('look for') + 到 ('succeed in reaching/finding').

examples.text: 我们在绿色登记本里找到了三十年前那一页！
examples.trans: We found that page from thirty years ago in the green guest book!

examples.text: 你在最下面的抽屉里找到调音扳手了吗？
examples.trans: Did you find the tuning key in the bottom drawer?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǎo huí. Compound 找 ('give change / look for') + 回 ('back'); used for coins/notes returned after paying cash.

examples.text: 我付了五十块现金，老板找回六个硬币。
examples.trans: I paid fifty yuan in cash and the vendor gave back six coins in change.

examples.text: 小晴在坐垫下面找回了丢失的铜钥匙。
examples.trans: Qing recovered the missing brass key from underneath the seat cushion.

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房今天到。
examples.trans: Right, eight guest rooms, eight brass keys. Room four arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ shou. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个把手 ('a door/suitcase handle').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 旁边的把手上系着一张小纸牌。
examples.trans: There is a small paper card tied on the side handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuā zhù. Resultative compound 抓 ('grab') + 住 ('hold fast').

examples.text: 小晴稳稳抓住了第一扇木窗板的左头。
examples.trans: Qing grabbed firm hold of the left end of the first wooden shutter.

examples.text: 下梯子的时候请双手抓住两边的扶手。
examples.trans: When coming down the ladder, please hold tightly onto both side rails.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhé. Used for folding chairs, blueprints, or paper.

examples.text: 等等，换房间我们给他打多少折？
examples.trans: Wait—what discount do we offer him for changing rooms?

examples.text: 快把那张纸折起来，塞进口袋里。
examples.trans: Fold up that sheet of paper right now and tuck it into your pocket.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhé dié. Used as a verb ('fold up') or directly before nouns to mean 'folding / collapsible' (折叠桌, 折叠谱架).

examples.text: 这种木头折叠桌不用的时候可以靠墙收好。
examples.trans: This wooden folding table can be folded against the wall when not in use.

examples.text: 请把这张大地图顺着折痕折叠起来。
examples.trans: Please fold this large map up along the creases.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhé dié yǐ. Measure word (量词): 把 (bǎ), e.g. 一把折叠椅 ('a folding chair').

examples.text: 老陈，热水器后面那三把折叠椅找到了吗？
examples.trans: Chen, did you find those three folding chairs behind the water heater?

examples.text: 客人多的时候，我们在院子里加四把木折叠椅。
examples.trans: When guests fill the yard, we set out four extra wooden folding chairs.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhé kòu. Noun for a price discount (有折扣 'there is a discount', 给点折扣 'give a small discount').

examples.text: 一次买两箱柠檬，老板给了很不错的折扣。
examples.trans: When we bought two crates of lemons at once, the seller gave a great discount.

examples.text: 星期六早市的水果新鲜，买多还有折扣。
examples.trans: Fruit at the Saturday morning market is fresh, and buying in bulk gets a discount.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhé zhǐ. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张折纸 ('a folded sheet').

examples.text: 看合页边露出来的折纸图纸——一楼画着一扇暗门！
examples.trans: Look at the folded blueprint sticking out of the hinge—a hidden door is drawn on the ground floor!

examples.text: 桌子上放着一只小巧的蓝色折纸小鸟。
examples.trans: A neat little folded-paper blue bird sits on the table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiǎng. Used playfully for 'poaching staff' (抢人) or rushing to grab the bill.

examples.text: 啊！黄色柠檬糖霜——每个星期五我们俩都抢边角那一块！
examples.trans: Oh! Yellow lemon glaze—every single Friday the two of us fought over the corner piece!

examples.text: 别抢人，小美！小晴，你愿意留下来当正式前台主管吗？
examples.trans: No poaching, Mei! Qing, are you willing to stay on as our permanent front-desk manager?

meanings.note: Pinyin: bào zhǐ. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng) for single sheets of newsprint, 份 (fèn) for a full issue.

examples.text: 摊主用干净的旧报纸把十二个白杯子包好。
examples.trans: The stallholder wrapped the twelve white cups securely in clean old newsprint.

examples.text: 爷爷每天早上喝茶的时候都要看一份报纸。
examples.trans: Grandpa reads a newspaper every morning while drinking his tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tái. Means raising upward or two people lifting an object together.

examples.text: 我们俩一起把这扇长窗板抬进走廊吧。
examples.trans: Let's lift this tall shutter together and carry it into the hallway.

examples.text: 按下琴键时，里面的小琴槌就会稳稳抬起来。
examples.trans: When you press the piano key, the small hammer inside rises smoothly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tái tóu. Separable verb-object compound; opposite of 低头.

examples.text: 高个子，深灰色外套，正抬头看我们客栈招牌呢！
examples.trans: Tall, dark grey coat, looking up at our inn sign right now!

examples.text: 抬头看夜空下那些金色灯笼——真宁静啊！
examples.trans: Look up at those golden lanterns against the night sky—how peaceful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bào. Used for carrying a box, cushion, or child in both arms.

examples.text: 老陈，抱起那些纸箱，我们下楼吧！
examples.trans: Chen, pick up those cardboard boxes—down the stairs we go!

examples.text: 那抱着木头小火车的弟弟呢？
examples.trans: And what about the younger brother holding the wooden train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: chōu. Describes sliding a thin sheet, drawer, or card smoothly out of a tight space (抽出来).

examples.text: 他从书架中间轻轻抽出一本旧相册。
examples.trans: He gently slid an old photo album out from the middle of the bookshelf.

examples.text: 小心一点把信纸从信封里抽出来。
examples.trans: Slide the letter paper carefully out of the envelope.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chōu ti. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个抽屉 ('a drawer').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 备用钥匙放在前台右边的抽屉里。
examples.trans: The spare keys are kept in the right-hand drawer at reception.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dān xīn. Common in 别担心 ('don't worry').

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

examples.text: 请别担心！我们特意为您准备好了安静的三楼阁楼书房。
examples.trans: Please do not worry! We specially prepared our quiet third-floor attic study for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chāi. Used for tearing open envelopes, unwrapping packages, or dismantling old structures.

examples.text: 十二点以后再拆吧，老板！看钟：差五分十二点！
examples.trans: Open it after twelve, boss! Look at the clock: five minutes to twelve!

examples.text: 拆开白纸……不会吧！爷爷亲手雕的木头火车头！
examples.trans: Unwrap the white paper... no way! Grandfather's hand-carved wooden locomotive!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lā. Opposite of 推 ('push'); used for pulling doors, shutters, or suitcase handles.

examples.text: 电线本来就该拉直了。正常保养，别多想。
examples.trans: The wire needed straightening anyway. Routine maintenance—don't read into it.

examples.text: 让我把眼镜从额头上拉下来……九号房？！
examples.trans: Let me pull my glasses down from my forehead... Room Nine?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lā liàn. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条拉链 ('a zipper').

examples.text: 看拉链旁边……对，有她的名字缩写！
examples.trans: Check beside the zipper... yes, her name initials are here!

examples.text: 蓝色行李箱侧面的拉链有点紧。
examples.trans: The side zipper on the blue suitcase is a little stiff.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pāi. Used for clapping (拍手), patting someone, and taking photos (拍照).

examples.text: 您拍一下手——听，街上的声音多安静！
examples.trans: Clap your hands once—listen, how quiet the street sounds!

examples.text: 大家拍拍手，欢迎新同事！
examples.trans: Everyone, give a clap to welcome our new colleague!

meanings.note: Pinyin: guǎi. Everyday direction verb (往左拐 'turn left').

examples.text: 上楼梯，平台往左拐，最上面最后一扇门。
examples.trans: Up the stairs, turn left at the landing, last door at the very top.

examples.text: 出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
examples.trans: Go out the front gate, turn left, and walk straight to the stone bridge.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guǎi wān. Separable verb-object compound for street directions.

examples.text: 拐弯小心点，别碰到墙！
examples.trans: Careful on the turn—do not bump the wall!

examples.text: 走到前面那棵大树再往左拐弯。
examples.trans: Walk up to that big tree ahead and turn left.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jù jué. Used for declining an offer or request.

examples.text: 早上七点有热乎乎的肉桂面包，谁会拒绝呢。
examples.trans: At seven in the morning, who could say no to piping-hot cinnamon bread.

examples.text: 这么真诚的邀请，谁也舍不得拒绝。
examples.trans: No one could bear to turn down such a warm invitation.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhāo shǒu. Separable verb-object compound (朝我招手 'wave toward me').

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 她在咖啡馆门口笑着向我们招手。
examples.trans: Smiling at the café entrance, she waved to us.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhāo pái. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块招牌 ('a shop signboard').

examples.text: 店门外面有大招牌吗？
examples.trans: Is there a big shop sign outside the door?

examples.text: 正往前走……啊，看见金钥匙招牌和蓝木门了！
examples.trans: Walking forward now... oh, I see the golden key sign and the blue wooden door!

meanings.note: Pinyin: níng. Used for twisting a tap, valve, wrench, or bottle cap (拧开 'twist open', 拧紧 'tighten').

examples.text: 当心那把角落椅子，等十秒我拧紧螺丝。
examples.trans: Mind that corner chair—wait ten seconds while I tighten the screw.

examples.text: 把蓝色转轮慢慢往左拧开——别太快。
examples.trans: Turn the blue wheel open slowly to the left—not too fast.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gǒng chuāng. Combines 拱 ('arch') + 窗 ('window').

examples.text: 九号房高高的拱窗擦干净以后透进满屋阳光。
examples.trans: Once Room Nine's tall arched windows were wiped clean, sunlight flooded the room.

examples.text: 站在木梯子上正好能够到拱窗的最顶端。
examples.trans: Standing on the wooden ladder lets you reach right to the top of the arched window.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gǒng mén. Compound 拱 ('arch') + 门 ('door/gate'). Measure word: 道 (dào) or 扇 (shàn).

examples.text: 志豪在速写本上画下了院子的石头拱门。
examples.trans: Hao sketched the courtyard's stone archway in his sketchbook.

examples.text: 穿过这道砖拱门，就能看见后面的小花园。
examples.trans: Walk through this brick archway and you can see the little garden behind.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ná. Core verb for holding or fetching objects in the hand.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

examples.text: 火车站有人拿错了我的蓝色行李箱！
examples.trans: Someone at the train station took my blue suitcase by mistake!

related.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

meanings.note: Pinyin: guà. Used for hanging keys, coats, lanterns, or hanging up a phone.

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

examples.text: 挂在书桌右边吧，那里光线好。
examples.trans: Hang it to the right of the desk, where the light is good.

挂不住.gloss: fail to stick; unable to hold onto a surface

meanings.en: fail to stick; unable to hold onto a surface
meanings.note: Pinyin: guà bú zhù. Negative potential complement 挂 ('hang/cling/coat') + 不住 ('cannot hold fast'); bù shifts to bú before zhù.

examples.text: 木头要是淋湿了，刷上去的油漆根本挂不住。
examples.trans: If the wood gets wet from rain, brushed-on paint will never stick.

examples.text: 墙面灰尘太多的话，胶带是挂不住的。
examples.trans: If there is too much dust on the wall, tape won't stick.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guà hào xìn. Measure word (量词): 封 (fēng), e.g. 一封挂号信 ('a registered letter').

examples.text: 比水管严重……中午房东寄来了一封挂号信。
examples.trans: Worse than a pipe... at noon a registered letter arrived from the landlord.

examples.text: 邮递员请前台签收一封市政厅寄来的挂号信。
examples.trans: The mail carrier asked reception to sign for a registered letter from City Hall.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guà duàn. Result compound meaning a phone line disconnected.

examples.text: 来不及了！他说了声谢谢就挂断了！
examples.trans: Too late! He said thank you and hung up!

examples.text: 信号不好，刚才的电话突然挂断了。
examples.trans: The reception was poor, and the call just dropped.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guà zhōng. Combines 挂 ('hang on a wall') + 钟 ('clock').

examples.text: 前台后面的老挂钟每到整点就会轻轻敲响。
examples.trans: The old wall clock behind the front desk chimes softly every hour on the hour.

examples.text: 老陈修好了大堂里那座停了很久的挂钟。
examples.trans: Chen repaired the wall clock in the lobby that had been stopped for a long time.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ. Used for pointing toward a sign, map, or clue (指着).

examples.text: 谁也没走开！志豪正指着那两把椅子呢！
examples.trans: Neither of them walked away! Hao is pointing at those two chairs right now!

examples.text: 周经理，快看志豪先生用铅笔指的地方！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, look where Mr Zhihao is pointing with his pencil!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ nán. Measure word (量词): 本 (běn), e.g. 一本指南 ('a guidebook').

examples.text: 除非他是写成都旅游指南的神秘评审员！
examples.trans: Unless he is a secret inspector writing the Chengdu Travel Guide!

examples.text: 冰凉的洗澡水？！成都旅游指南评审员就住在三楼啊！
examples.trans: Ice-cold shower water?! The Chengdu Travel Guide inspector is staying on floor three!

meanings.note: Pinyin: àn. Used for pressing a doorbell, elevator button, or key (按门铃).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 宋老师，怎么了？您按了门铃！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, what happened? You rang the bell!

meanings.note: Pinyin: tà dǐ. Combines 挞 ('tart') + 底 ('base/crust').

examples.text: 用烤香的杏仁粉做的挞底既酥脆又香甜。
examples.trans: A tart crust made with toasted almond flour is crisp and fragrant.

examples.text: 把挞底烤成金黄色以后，再填入柠檬酱。
examples.trans: Bake the tart shell until golden, then fill it with lemon curd.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎng. Used for blocking wind, rain, or a doorway (挡住).

examples.text: 主要设计小图书馆和院子，测量老石墙怎么挡住街上噪音。
examples.trans: Mostly small libraries and courtyards, measuring how old stone walls block street noise.

examples.text: 大树挡住了下午的阳光。
examples.trans: The big tree shaded the afternoon sun.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huī hui shǒu. Friendly reduplication of separable verb-object 挥手 ('wave a hand').

examples.text: 小晴透过干净的玻璃向院子里的大家挥挥手。
examples.trans: Qing waved through the clean glass to everyone in the courtyard.

examples.text: 火车开动的时候，他在站台上笑着向我们挥挥手。
examples.trans: As the train pulled out, he smiled on the platform and waved to us.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tǐng. As an adverb, 'quite' (挺好); as a verb, 'straighten up' (挺起) or 'pull through' (挺过).

examples.text: 你看，早餐忙乱和神秘电话你都挺过来了！
examples.trans: Look, you made it through both the breakfast rush and the mystery phone call!

examples.text: 挺起肩膀，志豪先生。记住那三句简单的话——我去开门！
examples.trans: Shoulders back, Mr Zhihao. Remember those three simple lines—I will open the gate!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huàn. Used for swapping suitcases, changing rooms, or replacing broken parts.

examples.text: 上周刚换了新灯泡，有干净肥皂和热水。
examples.trans: Put in a new bulb last week, with clean soap and plenty of hot water.

examples.text: 等等，换房间我们给他打多少折？
examples.trans: Wait—what discount do we offer him for changing rooms?

meanings.note: Pinyin: diào. As a verb, 'drop'; after another verb, marks removal or disposal (关掉 'turn off', 擦掉 'wipe away').

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

examples.text: 冬天用掉最后一个了。只有桥那边的老五金店有这个尺寸。
examples.trans: Used the last one in winter. Only the old hardware shop past the bridge carries this size.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pái. Counts rows of keys, seats, or houses (一排钥匙 'a row of keys').

examples.text: 等星期五中午箱子主人进来，我一定坐第一排看！
examples.trans: When the suitcase owner walks in Friday at noon, I am sitting in the front row!

examples.text: 墙上整整齐齐挂着一排钥匙。
examples.trans: A neat row of keys hangs on the wall.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē. Used for answering calls (接电话), meeting someone at a station, or catching drips.

examples.text: 完了！昨天我没戴眼镜，在平板上接了电话预订！
examples.trans: Disaster! Yesterday without my glasses I took a phone booking on the tablet!

examples.text: 志豪接干毛巾的时候随手放下的！
examples.trans: Hao set it down casually when he took the dry towel!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē kǒu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个接口 ('a pipe joint').

examples.text: 手电筒拿稳，照着这儿的水管接口。
examples.trans: Hold the flashlight steady and shine it on the pipe joint here.

examples.text: 老陈用扳手把铜管接口拧紧了。
examples.trans: Chen tightened the copper pipe joint with a wrench.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē dài. Hospitality verb for welcoming and serving guests.

examples.text: 完全正确！目前你们四张桌子只接待住店客人。
examples.trans: Exactly right! Right now your four tables only serve overnight inn guests.

examples.text: 这家小客栈一天最多接待十位客人。
examples.trans: This boutique inn hosts at most ten guests a day.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tuī. Opposite of 拉 ('pull'); used for pushing doors open.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 这扇木门往里推就开了。
examples.trans: Push this wooden door inward and it opens.

meanings.en: lift up; carry (by a handle); mention
meanings.note: Pinyin: tí. Used for lifting a door handle or carrying a bag by its strap/handle.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chā. Used for inserting a key into a keyhole or plugging in a cord.

examples.text: 插上老陈的铜台灯……哇，黄色灯光真暖和！
examples.trans: Plug in Chen's brass lamp... wow, how warm that yellow light is!

examples.text: 他把铜钥匙插进锁孔里。
examples.trans: He inserted the brass key into the keyhole.

meanings.en: latch; bolt (on a window or door)
meanings.note: Pinyin: chā xiāo. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个插销 ('a latch').

examples.text: 我先画一下窗户的插销，让院子里的新鲜空气进来。
examples.trans: First let me sketch the window latches, so fresh air comes in from the courtyard.

examples.text: 窗户的插销坏了，关不上。
examples.trans: The window latch is broken, so it won't close.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bān. Used for moving furniture, boxes, or moving house.

examples.text: 四个纸箱五分钟就能搬走。现在就上去看！
examples.trans: We can move four boxes in five minutes. Let's go up and look right now!

examples.text: 请帮我把这张桌子搬到院子里。
examples.trans: Please help me move this table out to the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bān jiā. Separable verb-object compound.

examples.text: 搬家公司清空梧桐巷之前，我从阁楼架子救下了这个盒子。
examples.trans: Before the movers cleared Wutong Lane, I saved this box from the attic shelf.

examples.text: 上个月他们刚搬家到梧桐巷附近。
examples.trans: Last month they moved house to the Wutong Lane neighborhood.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dā dàng. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位搭档 ('a partner').

examples.text: 三分钟就能送上三楼。今天跑得漂亮，搭档。
examples.trans: Three minutes to reach the third floor. Fine run today, partner.

examples.text: 小晴和老陈已经是配合默契的好搭档了。
examples.trans: Qing and Chen have already become a great team.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎi. Used for setting out plates, chairs, or flowers neatly (摆好).

examples.text: 四张桌子，八把椅子，全摆好了！
examples.trans: Four tables, eight chairs—everything is set in place!

examples.text: 桌子上摆好了四个蓝茶杯。
examples.trans: Four blue teacups are neatly set out on the table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tān. Open-air market table or vendor stall (水果摊 'fruit stall', 陶瓷摊 'pottery stall'). Measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 星期六广场上摆满了卖鲜花和水果的小摊。
examples.trans: On Saturdays, the square is lined with stalls selling fresh flowers and fruit.

examples.text: 转角那个陶瓷摊的茶杯又厚又好看。
examples.trans: The teacups at that pottery stall on the corner are both thick and handsome.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhāi. Used for picking herbs, fruit, or flowers, and also for taking off glasses or hats.

examples.text: 这碗番茄汤里放了刚从院子里摘的新鲜香草。
examples.trans: This bowl of tomato soup has fresh herbs just picked from the courtyard.

examples.text: 宋老师摘下眼镜，轻轻合上了那本旧登记本。
examples.trans: Teacher Song took off her glasses and gently closed the old guest book.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mō mo. Reduplicated verb for feeling whether a pipe or cup is warm.

examples.text: 摸摸铜管！已经热起来了！
examples.trans: Touch the copper pipe! It is warming up already!

examples.text: 你摸摸茶壶，水还是热乎乎的。
examples.trans: Feel the teapot—the water is still nice and warm.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sǎ. Used for sprinkling powdered sugar or salt over food.

examples.text: 好。端上去之前，在上面撒这些新鲜绿香草。
examples.trans: Good. Before serving them, sprinkle these fresh green herbs on top.

examples.text: 他爷爷会切热柠檬蛋糕，上面撒一层白糖粉！
examples.trans: His grandfather sliced warm lemon cake with a dusting of powdered sugar on top!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuàng. Used for bumping into someone or rushing through a doorway.

examples.text: 老弟，你到底撞进了一家什么神奇客栈？
examples.trans: Little brother, what kind of magical inn did you stumble into?

examples.text: 他跑得太急，差点撞到门上。
examples.trans: He ran so fast he nearly bumped into the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bō fàng. Used for playing recorded messages, music tracks, or videos (contrast 弹 tán for playing piano).

examples.text: 小晴按下按钮，播放前台电话里的语音留言。
examples.trans: Qing pressed the button to play the voice message on the front-desk phone.

examples.text: 咖啡厅里正在轻轻播放一首钢琴曲。
examples.trans: A piano piece is playing softly in the café right now.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cā. Used for wiping tables, drying water, or polishing lanterns.

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

examples.text: 先生，给您干毛巾擦外套，还有一碗热汤。
examples.trans: Sir, here is a dry towel to wipe your coat, plus a bowl of hot soup.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shōu. Versatile verb meaning 'gather / put away / fold shut' (收起来, 收平) as well as 'receive'.

examples.text: 快下雨了，我们把院子里的布伞收起来吧。
examples.trans: It's about to rain—let's fold up the cloth umbrellas in the courtyard.

examples.text: 木椅子收好以后，走廊一下子宽敞多了。
examples.trans: Once the wooden chairs were folded away, the corridor immediately felt much roomier.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shōu jù. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张收据 ('a receipt').

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 钱箱里拿五十块，记得要收据！
examples.trans: Here is fifty yuan from the cash box; remember to get a receipt!

meanings.note: Pinyin: gǎi. Used for changing plans or converting a building.

examples.text: 超过八十年的小院建筑，只要一楼每天服务街坊邻居，禁止改成私人办公室。
examples.trans: Any courtyard building over eighty years old may not become private offices as long as the ground floor serves neighbours daily.

examples.text: 我们把见面时间改到下午吧。
examples.trans: Let's change our meeting time to the afternoon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gǎi jiàn. Used for remodeling an old building into something new.

examples.text: 志豪先生，看第一页：下个月改建商业办公室。我们完了！
examples.trans: Mr Zhihao, look at page one: commercial office conversion next month. We are finished!

examples.text: 这间书房是由老阁楼改建成的。
examples.trans: This study was converted from the old attic.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fàng. Everyday verb for placing an object somewhere (放在桌子上).

examples.text: 我们不知道。有人放在台阶上，按了门铃。
examples.trans: We do not know. Someone set it on the step and rang the bell.

examples.text: 小勺子和餐巾放在哪里？
examples.trans: Where do the small spoons and napkins go?

related.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

meanings.note: Pinyin: fàng xīn. Literally 'set one's heart down' (请放心 'rest assured!').

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

examples.text: 放心吧，老陈，我们替你保密！
examples.trans: Rest assured, Chen—we will keep your secret!

related.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

meanings.note: Pinyin: gù shi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个故事 ('a story').

examples.text: 宋老师早上讲了我们星期五的故事，小美特意烤的。
examples.trans: After Teacher Song told our Friday story this morning, Mei baked it specially.

examples.text: 这栋老砖房里有很多温暖的故事。
examples.trans: This old brick house holds many warm stories.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Used for saving a historic building or rescuing breakfast.

examples.text: 你们这些好人真是救了我这趟旅行。
examples.trans: You kind people have truly saved this whole trip of mine.

examples.text: 呼，好在反应快，早餐又有救了！
examples.trans: Phew, quick thinking saves breakfast once again!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù xīng. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位救星 ('a lifesaver').

examples.text: 小晴你真是救星！先给我牛奶冲咖啡。
examples.trans: Qing, you are a lifesaver! Hand me the milk first to make coffee.

examples.text: 你带了备用伞来，真是我的大救星！
examples.trans: You brought a spare umbrella—you are a real lifesaver!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiāo. Read first tone jiāo when teaching a skill or person (教钢琴 'teach piano').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 何止认识！整整六年，每个星期五我都爬那座木楼梯教钢琴！
examples.trans: More than know it! Every Friday for six whole years I climbed those wooden stairs to teach piano!

meanings.en: throw wide open; leave wide open
meanings.note: Pinyin: chǎng kāi. Describes gates or windows opened wide.

examples.text: 敬好邻居、热面包，还有敞开的大门！
examples.trans: To good neighbours, warm bread, and wide-open gates!

examples.text: 每天早上八点，小院木门准时敞开。
examples.trans: Every morning at eight, the wooden courtyard gates swing wide open.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gǎn. Modal verb expressing courage to act (不敢相信 'dare not believe').

examples.text: 真不敢相信您也住在这家客栈，宋老师。
examples.trans: I can hardly believe you are staying at this very same inn, Teacher Song.

examples.text: 我真不敢相信这个好消息。
examples.trans: I can hardly believe this good news.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìng. Used when raising a teacup or glass in honor of someone (敬你一杯 'toast you a cup').

examples.text: 敬好邻居、热面包，还有敞开的大门！
examples.trans: To good neighbours, warm bread, and wide-open gates!

examples.text: 我以热茶代酒，敬您一杯。
examples.trans: With hot tea in place of wine, I raise a cup to you.

meanings.en: respect deeply; hold in high esteem
meanings.note: Pinyin: jìng zhòng. Warm, respectful verb for admiring elders or teachers.

examples.text: 别瞒了，小晴，我们很专业！先生，我们敬重成都旅游指南！
examples.trans: No hiding it, Qing, let's be professional! Sir, we respect the Chengdu Travel Guide!

examples.text: 整条巷子的街坊都很敬重宋老师。
examples.trans: Neighbors all along the lane deeply respect Teacher Song.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shù zì. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个数字 ('a number / digit').

examples.text: 全是灰色小数字！我看到第一页心就停了！
examples.trans: Nothing but tiny grey numbers! My heart stopped at page one!

examples.text: 把上面铜牌的灰尘擦掉……等等，快念那个数字！
examples.trans: Brush the dust off the brass plate on top... wait, read that number!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiāo. Used for knocking on doors or pipes clanking.

examples.text: 听……街口钟楼开始敲十二下了！
examples.trans: Listen... the clock tower at the end of the street is starting to strike twelve!

examples.text: 十二下敲完了……大门外面街上空荡荡的。
examples.trans: Twelve chimes have finished... and the street outside the gate is completely empty.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiāo zhòng. Resultative compound 敲 ('strike/knock') + 中 (zhòng, 4th tone 'hit the target').

examples.text: 包着毛毡的琴槌稳稳敲中了三根钢丝琴弦。
examples.trans: The felt-wrapped piano hammer struck the three steel strings squarely.

examples.text: 鼓槌清脆地敲中鼓心，发出了洪亮的声音。
examples.trans: The drumstick struck the center of the drum crisply with a resonant sound.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiāo jī. Describes rhythmic tapping or knocking in pipes.

examples.text: 非常安静！不过刚才你听到奇怪的金属敲击声了吗？
examples.trans: Very quiet! Though did you hear a strange metallic knocking sound just now?

examples.text: 雨点轻轻敲击着三楼的木窗。
examples.trans: Raindrops tapped softly against the third-floor wooden window.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiāo mén. Separable verb-object compound.

examples.text: 打扰一下，志豪先生？不好意思这么晚敲门。
examples.trans: Excuse me, Mr Zhihao? Sorry to knock so late.

examples.text: 进客人的房间以前一定要先敲门。
examples.trans: Always knock before entering a guest's room.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěng. Combines with a measure word to mean 'the entire' (整条街 'the whole street', 整栋楼 'the whole building').

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 今晚半价，而且一整周早餐免费！
examples.trans: Half price tonight, plus free breakfast all week!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěng gè. Combines 整 ('whole') + 个; modifies singular nouns directly without another measure word (整个中央八度).

examples.text: 修好那根琴槌以后，宋老师给整个中央八度调了音。
examples.trans: After fixing that hammer, Teacher Song tuned the entire middle octave.

examples.text: 柠檬挞的香味飘满了整个咖啡角。
examples.trans: The aroma of lemon tart drifted through the entire café corner.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěng yè. Combines 整 ('whole') + 夜 ('night').

examples.text: 三十年前的那个五月十号，成都整夜都在下大雨。
examples.trans: On that May tenth thirty years ago, heavy rain fell all night in Chengdu.

examples.text: 春雨整夜轻轻敲打着小院的青瓦屋顶。
examples.trans: Spring rain pattered softly on the courtyard's grey-tiled roof all night.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěng tiān. Combines 整 ('whole') + 天 ('day').

examples.text: 要是星期一整天都下大雨，我们就没法在院子里刷漆了。
examples.trans: If heavy rain falls all day Monday, we won't be able to paint in the courtyard.

examples.text: 小美整天都在厨房里忙着试烤新点心。
examples.trans: Mei was busy in the kitchen all day test-baking new pastries.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěng pái. Combines 整 ('whole') + measure word 排 ('row/line').

examples.text: 透过擦亮的玻璃，能看见院子里整排金黄的灯笼。
examples.trans: Through the polished glass, you can see the whole line of golden lanterns in the courtyard.

examples.text: 钢琴盖打开后，露出了里面整整齐齐的整排琴槌。
examples.trans: Once the piano panel opened, it revealed the neat whole row of hammers inside.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhéng zhěng. Placed before numbers to stress entirety (整整六年 'six whole years').

examples.text: 何止认识！整整六年，每个星期五我都爬那座木楼梯教钢琴！
examples.trans: More than know it! Every Friday for six whole years I climbed those wooden stairs to teach piano!

examples.text: 这架老钢琴他已经弹了整整三十年。
examples.trans: He has played this old piano for a full thirty years.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěng zhěng qí qí. AABB reduplication of 整齐 ('neat/orderly'), often followed by 地 before verbs or 的 before nouns.

examples.text: 十二个白茶杯整整齐齐地摆在木托盘上。
examples.trans: Twelve white teacups are lined up neatly on the wooden tray.

examples.text: 小晴把前台的账本和钥匙收得整整齐齐。
examples.trans: Qing tidied up the front-desk ledgers and keys in neat order.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhéng lǐ. Used for tidying a room, desk, or luggage.

examples.text: 失陪一下，宋老师，我先回办公室整理一下！
examples.trans: Excuse me a moment, Teacher Song; I shall step back to my office to tidy up!

examples.text: 擦亮铜钥匙、整理领带十五年……三十天就全没了！
examples.trans: Fifteen years of polishing brass keys and straightening ties... gone in thirty days!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěng qí. Describes neatly arranged keys, chairs, or handwriting.

examples.text: 上面怎么用铅笔整齐画了这条街三家客栈？
examples.trans: Why are three inns on this street neatly sketched in pencil on it?

examples.text: 明信片上整齐的方格字，我两秒钟就认出来了。
examples.trans: That neat block handwriting on the postcard—I recognized it in two seconds.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wén jiàn. Measure word (量词): 份 (fèn), e.g. 一份文件 ('a document').

examples.text: 整份文件还没读完呢，周经理，别先认输。
examples.trans: We have not even finished reading the whole document, Manager Zhou—don't give up yet.

examples.text: 请把桌上的那份合同文件拿给我。
examples.trans: Please hand me that contract document on the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xié. Describes sunlight slanting across a courtyard or a tilted angle.

examples.text: 听我把箱子斜过来——里面有金属东西滑了一下。
examples.trans: Listen as I tilt the box—something metal slid inside.

examples.text: 温暖的阳光斜照在木地板上。
examples.trans: Warm sunlight slants across the wooden floor.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duàn. Often a result after another verb: 烧断 ('burn through'), 摔断 ('break in a fall').

examples.text: 是旧电线，把一楼的保险丝烧断了。
examples.trans: It was the old wire—it blew the ground-floor fuse.

examples.text: 电话突然断了。
examples.trans: The phone call suddenly cut off.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīn. Everyday adjective for new people, items, or beginnings.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīn shǒu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个新手 ('a newcomer').

examples.text: 第二天上班，干得不错，新手。
examples.trans: For day two on the job, nicely done, rookie.

examples.text: 虽然她是新手，做事却非常有条理。
examples.trans: Even though she is new to the job, she works very methodically.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīn xiān. Describes fresh fruit, fresh juice, or fresh herbs.

examples.text: 好。端上去之前，在上面撒这些新鲜绿香草。
examples.trans: Good. Before serving them, sprinkle these fresh green herbs on top.

examples.text: 闻闻看！热面包、热炒蛋，还有新鲜香草。
examples.trans: Smell that! Warm bread, hot scrambled eggs, and fresh herbs.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fāng gé. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个方格 ('a grid square').

examples.text: 明信片上整齐的方格字，我两秒钟就认出来了。
examples.trans: That neat block handwriting on the postcard—I recognized it in two seconds.

examples.text: 他的方格笔记本上画满了建筑草图。
examples.trans: His grid notebook is filled with architectural sketches.

meanings.note: Pinyin: páng. Compact locality noun placed after nouns (钢琴旁 'beside the piano', 窗旁 'by the window').

examples.text: 宋老师正坐在阳光房的钢琴旁微笑呢。
examples.trans: Teacher Song is sitting beside the piano in the sunroom smiling.

examples.text: 客栈大门旁挂着一块擦得发亮的铜牌。
examples.trans: Beside the inn's front gate hangs a brightly polished brass plaque.

meanings.note: Pinyin: páng biān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 旁边位置 ('a spot beside').

examples.text: 旁边的把手上系着一张小纸牌。
examples.trans: There is a small paper card tied on the side handle.

examples.text: 看拉链旁边……对，有她的名字缩写！
examples.trans: Check beside the zipper... yes, her name initials are here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǚ yóu. Everyday word for leisure travel.

examples.text: 除非他是写成都旅游指南的神秘评审员！
examples.trans: Unless he is a secret inspector writing the Chengdu Travel Guide!

examples.text: 冰凉的洗澡水？！成都旅游指南评审员就住在三楼啊！
examples.trans: Ice-cold shower water?! The Chengdu Travel Guide inspector is staying on floor three!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǚ xíng. Measure word (量词): 次 (cì), e.g. 一次旅行 ('a trip').

examples.text: 你们这些好人真是救了我这趟旅行。
examples.trans: You kind people have truly saved this whole trip of mine.

examples.text: 坐早班火车去成都是一次难忘的旅行。
examples.trans: Taking the morning train to Chengdu was an unforgettable trip.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xuán lǜ. Musical melody or tune. Measure word: 段 (duàn, 'passage/melody').

examples.text: 这段钢琴旋律听起来既温柔又熟悉。
examples.trans: This piano melody sounds both gentle and familiar.

examples.text: 哪怕过了很多年，我还是记得那首歌的旋律。
examples.trans: Even after many years, I still remember the melody of that song.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wú dí. Literally 无 ('without') + 敌 ('match/rival'); lively spoken praise for great food or skill.

examples.text: 酥脆的杏仁挞底配上新鲜柠檬，味道简直无敌了！
examples.trans: Crisp almond crust paired with fresh lemon is simply unbeatable!

examples.text: 小美烤的热面包在整条梧桐巷都是无敌的。
examples.trans: Mei's warm baked bread is unbeatable on all of Wutong Lane.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wú yán. Baking label meaning 'salt-free' (无盐黄油 'unsalted butter').

examples.text: 那是海盐咸黄油！甜果酱面包卷要无盐黄油！
examples.trans: That is sea-salt butter! Sweet jam rolls need unsalted butter!

examples.text: 烤柠檬蛋糕需要用新鲜的无盐黄油。
examples.trans: Baking lemon cake calls for fresh unsalted butter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wú liáo. Describes dull paperwork or feeling bored.

examples.text: 欢迎来到小院客栈，小晴。明天不会无聊了。
examples.trans: Welcome to Courtyard Inn, Qing. Tomorrow will not be boring.

examples.text: 多半是粉刷街边木窗那种无聊通知吧。
examples.trans: Probably some boring notice about painting the street shutters.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rì zi. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 一段好日子 ('happy days').

examples.text: 小时候就住隔两条街。星期五对我来说……是重要日子。
examples.trans: Two streets over, when I was little. Friday for me... is an important day.

examples.text: 在小院喝茶看书的日子真舒服。
examples.trans: Days spent drinking tea and reading in the courtyard are lovely.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rì qī. Calendar date written on a letter, ticket, or score (对比 星期 'day of the week').

examples.text: 明信片右下角写着三十年前五月的日期。
examples.trans: The bottom right corner of the postcard bears a date from May thirty years ago.

examples.text: 订车票的时候一定要看清楚出发日期。
examples.trans: Always double-check the departure date when booking train tickets.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Describes old houses, pipes, or letters—never a person's age (use 老 for people).

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù shì. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件旧事 ('an old matter').

examples.text: 说实话，我选这一带，也是为了一桩家里的旧事。
examples.trans: Honestly, I also chose this neighbourhood for an old family matter.

examples.text: 老朋友见面，聊起许多二十年前的旧事。
examples.trans: Old friends met up and chatted about many memories from twenty years ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù wù. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件旧物 ('an old keepsake').

examples.text: 原来留着爷爷旧物的神秘人一直是你，志豪。
examples.trans: So the mystery person holding Grandfather's keepsake was you all along, Zhihao.

examples.text: 木盒里整整齐齐收着几件珍贵的旧物。
examples.trans: Several treasured keepsakes are tucked neatly inside the wooden box.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǎo. Alone as a greeting, 早！ means a brisk, friendly 'Morning!'.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǎo shang. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个早上 ('a morning').

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǎo chén. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个早晨 ('an early morning').

examples.text: 小晴早！经理您好！雨后的早晨真晴朗。
examples.trans: Morning, Qing! Hello, Manager! How bright the morning is after the rain.

examples.text: 雨后的早晨，院子里全是草木清香。
examples.trans: On a morning after rain, the courtyard is filled with fresh greenery.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǎo jiān. Measure word (量词): 班 (bān), e.g. 早间火车 ('a morning train').

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

examples.text: 早间七点的街道安静又清爽。
examples.trans: At seven in the morning, the street is quiet and crisp.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǎo cān. Measure word (量词): 顿 (dùn), e.g. 一顿早餐 ('a breakfast').

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
examples.trans: Wonderful! Now I would like to eat a big breakfast.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǎo fàn. Measure word (量词): 顿 (dùn), e.g. 一顿早饭 ('a breakfast').

examples.text: 我弟弟早饭还没吃完，就拿着卷尺跑下来了。
examples.trans: My little brother grabbed his tape measure before he even finished breakfast.

examples.text: 你吃早饭了吗？
examples.trans: Have you had breakfast?

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个时期 ('a time').

examples.text: 因为星期一晚上我走过来时，看见我哥哥正走在这条街上！
examples.trans: Because when I walked here Monday night, I saw my older brother walking down this street!

examples.text: 不看纸条，他走进大门时我说什么？
examples.trans: Without my notes, what do I say when he walks in the gate?

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí hou. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 这个时候 ('this moment').

examples.text: 下雨的时候，纸不会弄丢房间名单。
examples.trans: When it rains, paper will not lose the room list.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí kè biǎo. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张时刻表 ('a timetable').

examples.text: 十九条理由？！您是迎接哥哥，还是念火车时刻表呀？
examples.trans: Nineteen reasons?! Are you welcoming your brother or reading a train timetable?

examples.text: 墙上贴着去成都东站的最新火车时刻表。
examples.trans: The latest train timetable for Chengdu East Station is posted on the wall.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí jiān. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 一段时间 ('a period of time').

examples.text: 新买家来看房子之前，只给我们三十天时间！
examples.trans: Before new buyers inspect the building, they give us only thirty days!

examples.text: 离火车开还有半个小时的时间。
examples.trans: There is still half an hour before the train departs.

related.gloss: a period of time (measure word 段)

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng liàng. Describes both well-lit spaces and clear, ringing musical tones.

examples.text: 擦掉灰尘以后，九号房变得格外宽敞明亮。
examples.trans: After wiping away the dust, Room Nine became remarkably spacious and bright.

examples.text: 这个琴键弹出来的声音干净又明亮。
examples.trans: The sound played by this piano key is clean and bright.

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng xìn piàn. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张明信片 ('a postcard').

examples.text: 从那个星期天起我们再也没说话。上周我给他寄了一张明信片。
examples.trans: Since that Sunday we have not spoken again. Last week I mailed him a postcard.

examples.text: 看，已经十二点零四分了。也许他把明信片扔进垃圾桶了。
examples.trans: Look, it is twelve-oh-four already. Maybe he tossed the postcard into the bin.

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 明天一天 ('all day tomorrow').

examples.text: 欢迎来到小院客栈，小晴。明天不会无聊了。
examples.trans: Welcome to Courtyard Inn, Qing. Tomorrow will not be boring.

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng nián. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 明年一年 ('next year').

examples.text: 两个都买下！留一个备用明年冬天也省心。
examples.trans: Buy both! Keeping a spare saves worry next winter too.

examples.text: 房东律师寄来的？奇怪——我们房租一直交到明年夏天了。
examples.trans: Sent by the landlord's lawyer? Strange—our rent is paid right through next summer.

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng zǎo. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 明天早上 ('tomorrow morning').

examples.text: 定好闹钟吧，老陈。明早我们跑赢冷水！
examples.trans: Set your alarm, Chen. Tomorrow morning we outrun the cold water!

examples.text: 明早七点半我们在楼下咖啡馆见。
examples.trans: Let's meet downstairs in the café tomorrow morning at seven thirty.

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng míng. Highlights a clear fact that contradicts what just happened.

examples.text: 哎呀！透过窗户看见周经理了？我明明加倍用力微笑了！
examples.trans: Oh dear! You spotted Manager Zhou through the window? I smiled twice as wide!

examples.text: 钥匙明明放在桌上，怎么不见了？
examples.trans: The key was clearly on the table—how did it vanish?

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng zhì. Praises a sensible choice.

examples.text: 太明智了！旁边要配蜂蜜还是苹果果酱？
examples.trans: Wise choice! Would you like honey or apple jam on the side?

examples.text: 提前预订向阳的房间是个明智的选择。
examples.trans: Booking a sunny room in advance was a wise choice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng. Measure word (量词): 颗 (kē), e.g. 一颗星 ('a star').

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

examples.text: 晴朗的夜空能看见很多星。
examples.trans: On a clear night sky you can see many stars.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个星期 ('a week').

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 脑子转得快，小晴。志豪每星期都读城市建筑规定。
examples.trans: Quick thinking, Qing. Hao reads city building rules every single week.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī yī. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 上星期一 ('last Monday').

examples.text: 呀，这就是星期一火车上那只双胞胎箱子吗？
examples.trans: Oh, is this that twin suitcase from Monday's train?

examples.text: 您尽管看，宋老师。星期一下午大堂暗。
examples.trans: Go right ahead, Teacher Song. Monday afternoon the lobby was dim.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī sān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 这星期三 ('this Wednesday').

examples.text: 等等——星期三晚上你又用真名住进来了？
examples.trans: Wait—and Wednesday night you checked in here under your real name?

examples.text: 每到星期三下午，小美都会试烤新甜点。
examples.trans: Every Wednesday afternoon, Mei test-bakes a new pastry.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī èr. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 这星期二 ('this Tuesday').

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

examples.text: 难怪星期二您打电话请我们别打开白纸包！
examples.trans: No wonder you phoned on Tuesday asking us not to open the white parcel!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī wǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 每个星期五 ('every Friday').

examples.text: 我念念：对不起拿错了，请帮我保管到星期五。
examples.trans: Let me read it: Sorry for taking the wrong one; please keep mine until Friday.

examples.text: 到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
examples.trans: Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī liù. Literally 'week-day six'; Mainland standard alongside informal 周六 (zhōu liù).

examples.text: 每个星期六早上，这条老街都有热闹的集市。
examples.trans: Every Saturday morning, this old street hosts a lively market.

examples.text: 星期六下午来院子里喝杯热柠檬茶吧。
examples.trans: Come to the courtyard for a cup of hot lemon tea on Saturday afternoon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī sì. Literally 'week-day four'; Mainland standard alongside informal 周四 (zhōu sì).

examples.text: 周经理本来想让司机星期四下午送椅子来。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou originally meant to have the driver deliver the chairs on Thursday afternoon.

examples.text: 我们每个星期四晚上都会核对一次账本。
examples.trans: Every Thursday evening we check the account ledger together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个星期天 ('a Sunday').

examples.text: 从那个星期天起我们再也没说话。上周我给他寄了一张明信片。
examples.trans: Since that Sunday we have not spoken again. Last week I mailed him a postcard.

examples.text: 星期天早上大家都不急着赶车，慢慢喝早茶。
examples.trans: On Sunday mornings nobody rushes for trains, lingering over tea instead.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng jí. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 五星级 ('a five-star rating').

examples.text: 仔细看这一页——记的是分贝和安静度，不是酒店星级！
examples.trans: Look closely at this page—it records decibels and quietness, not hotel stars!

examples.text: 小客栈虽小，干净程度不输星级酒店。
examples.trans: Though small, the inn is every bit as spotless as a star-rated hotel.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chūn tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个春天 ('a spring season').

examples.text: 五分钟演讲稿，列了十九条理由解释那年春天我们都错了。
examples.trans: A five-minute speech listing nineteen reasons why we were both wrong that spring.

examples.text: 春天一到，院子里的老树就发新芽了。
examples.trans: As soon as spring arrives, the old courtyard tree puts out fresh shoots.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuó tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 昨天一天 ('yesterday').

examples.text: 完了！昨天我没戴眼镜，在平板上接了电话预订！
examples.trans: Disaster! Yesterday without my glasses I took a phone booking on the tablet!

examples.text: 是的，我叫志豪。昨天打电话订了七号房。
examples.trans: Yes, my name is Zhihao. Yesterday I booked room seven by phone.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuó wǎn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 昨天晚上 ('last night').

examples.text: 宋老师早上好！看昨晚大门口送来了什么。
examples.trans: Good morning, Teacher Song! Look what arrived at our front gate last night.

examples.text: 昨晚您的本子在柜台翻开了，我们看到九分……
examples.trans: Last night your notebook fell open on the counter, and we saw nine points...

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Links two nouns (我是小晴); do NOT use simple 是 before plain adjectives like 好 or 忙.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì bú shì. A-not-A affirmative-negative question tag; bù shifts to bú before 4th-tone shì.

examples.text: 我们俩是不是刚升职当上正式试吃员了？
examples.trans: Did the two of us just get promoted to official taste testers?

examples.text: 你是不是把绿色登记本夹在胳膊底下了？
examples.trans: Didn't you tuck the green guest book under your arm?

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎn de. Linking verb introducing how something looks by comparison or lighting (显得多大 'looks how big').

examples.text: 两面都透着干净玻璃，院子显得宽敞多了！
examples.trans: With clean glass showing on two sides, the courtyard looks so much bigger!

examples.text: 刷上暖绿色油漆以后，旧木窗板显得很有精神。
examples.trans: Painted warm green, the old wooden shutters look lively and fresh.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎn. Describes arriving late or evening time.

examples.text: 打扰一下，志豪先生？不好意思这么晚敲门。
examples.trans: Excuse me, Mr Zhihao? Sorry to knock so late.

examples.text: 这是我这个月睡得最香的一晚，洗澡水也热极了！
examples.trans: Best sleep I have had all month, and the shower water was wonderfully hot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎn shang. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个晚上 ('an evening').

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

examples.text: 晚上九点？你站这儿，我们一起去开门。
examples.trans: Nine in the evening? Stay right here; let us go open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎn ān. Warm bedtime greeting.

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

examples.text: 时间不早了，早点休息，晚安！
examples.trans: It is getting late—get some rest, good night!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎn chá. Compound 晚 ('evening') + 茶 ('tea'): an early-evening tea gathering with light pastries.

examples.text: 三十年前，客栈每个星期五都办花园晚茶。
examples.trans: Thirty years ago, the inn hosted garden evening tea every Friday.

examples.text: 晚茶时间到了，小美端出了一盘刚烤好的柠檬塔。
examples.trans: When evening tea time arrived, Mei brought out a tray of freshly baked lemon tarts.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎn fàn. Measure word (量词): 顿 (dùn), e.g. 一顿晚饭 ('a dinner').

examples.text: 宋老师，志豪和我订了附近安静的晚饭——明天请您一起去好吗？
examples.trans: Teacher Song, Hao and I booked a quiet dinner nearby—will you join us tomorrow?

examples.text: 今晚我们在附近安静的小饭馆吃晚饭。
examples.trans: Tonight we are having dinner at a quiet little restaurant nearby.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qíng tiān. Combines 晴 ('clear/sunny sky') + 天 ('day/weather').

examples.text: 姑姑把乐谱收进琴盖里，等着晴天再拿出来弹。
examples.trans: My aunt tucked the score inside the piano lid, waiting for sunny weather to play it again.

examples.text: 大家都盼着明天是个大晴天，好把油漆晒干。
examples.trans: Everyone is hoping tomorrow is a bright sunny day so the paint can dry.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qíng lǎng. Describes bright skies after rain.

examples.text: 小晴早！经理您好！雨后的早晨真晴朗。
examples.trans: Morning, Qing! Hello, Manager! How bright the morning is after the rain.

examples.text: 下了一夜雨，今天终于晴朗起来了。
examples.trans: After raining all night, the sky has finally cleared up today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nuǎn. Describes cozy warmth of tea, sunlight, or clothing.

examples.text: 每次弹完琴，他都问为什么下雨天钢琴声音更暖。
examples.trans: Whenever I finished playing, he asked why the piano sounded warmer on rainy days.

examples.text: 喝碗热汤，身子一下子就暖了。
examples.trans: Drink a bowl of hot soup and you warm right up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nuǎn huo. Note neutral-tone huo in spoken Mandarin ('cozy and warm').

examples.text: 真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
examples.trans: Is that really alright? It looks both lovely and warm!

examples.text: 干燥、暖和、安静。快说还缺什么。
examples.trans: Dry, warm, and quiet. Tell me quickly what is still missing.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nuán nuǎn. Affectionate reduplicated verb (暖暖身子 'warm yourself up').

examples.text: 早上好！在楼上就闻到暖暖的肉桂香味了！
examples.trans: Good morning! All the way upstairs I smelled warm cinnamon!

examples.text: 先喝碗热汤暖暖手和胃吧。
examples.trans: Drink a bowl of hot soup first to warm up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: àn. Describes dim lighting or a concealed door.

examples.text: 您尽管看，宋老师。星期一下午大堂暗。
examples.trans: Go right ahead, Teacher Song. Monday afternoon the lobby was dim.

examples.text: 走廊里的灯光有点暗。
examples.trans: The light in the hallway is a little dim.

meanings.note: Pinyin: àn mén. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇暗门 ('a hidden door').

examples.text: 看合页边露出来的折纸图纸——一楼画着一扇暗门！
examples.trans: Look at the folded blueprint sticking out of the hinge—a hidden door is drawn on the ground floor!

examples.text: 老书架后面居然藏着一扇窄暗门。
examples.trans: Behind the old bookshelf was hidden a narrow secret door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bào fēng yǔ. Combines 暴 ('fierce/sudden') + 风 ('wind') + 雨 ('rain').

examples.text: 暴风雨来得真快，幸好我们及时把窗板搬进了走廊。
examples.trans: The storm came on fast; thankfully we carried the shutters into the hallway in time.

examples.text: 暴风雨过后，院子里的树叶被洗得翠绿发亮。
examples.trans: After the storm passed, the leaves in the courtyard were washed bright emerald green.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǔ zi. Conversational word for an instrumental piece or song tune (second syllable neutral tone). Measure word: 首 (shǒu).

examples.text: 这首轻快的小曲子是姑姑年轻时手写的。
examples.trans: This lively little tune was handwritten by my aunt when she was young.

examples.text: 吃完晚饭，宋老师常在阳光房弹两首曲子。
examples.trans: After dinner, Teacher Song often plays a couple of pieces in the sunroom.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gèng. Placed before an adjective or mental verb to form a comparative ('even better' 更好).

examples.text: 每次弹完琴，他都问为什么下雨天钢琴声音更暖。
examples.trans: Whenever I finished playing, he asked why the piano sounded warmer on rainy days.

examples.text: 生活安排的二重奏比我们自己写得更妙，孩子们。
examples.trans: Life arranges finer duets than we write ourselves, boys.

meanings.en: for; in place of; on behalf of
meanings.note: Pinyin: tì. Introduces the person you step in to help (替我念 'read it for me').

examples.text: 小晴，炒蛋真好吃，替我夸夸小美！
examples.trans: Qing, the scrambled eggs are delicious—praise Mei for me!

examples.text: 放心吧，老陈，我们替你保密！
examples.trans: Rest assured, Chen—we will keep your secret!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuì. Superlative adverb placed before adjectives or feeling verbs (最好 'best', 最喜欢 'like best').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 最上面架子上金色包装那包。怎么了？
examples.trans: The gold-wrapped packet on the top shelf. Why?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuì hòu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最后一个 ('the last one').

examples.text: 上楼梯，平台往左拐，最上面最后一扇门。
examples.trans: Up the stairs, turn left at the landing, last door at the very top.

examples.text: 冬天用掉最后一个了。只有桥那边的老五金店有这个尺寸。
examples.trans: Used the last one in winter. Only the old hardware shop past the bridge carries this size.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuì duō. Gives an upper limit on time or quantity.

examples.text: 只有三个小纸箱！最多四个！
examples.trans: Only three small cardboard boxes! Four at most!

examples.text: 小美，你的烤箱每天早上最多能烤多少肉桂卷和柠檬蛋糕？
examples.trans: Mei, how many cinnamon rolls and lemon cakes can your oven bake each morning?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuè. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个月 ('a month').

examples.text: 这是我这个月睡得最香的一晚，洗澡水也热极了！
examples.trans: Best sleep I have had all month, and the shower water was wonderfully hot!

examples.text: 志豪先生，看第一页：下个月改建商业办公室。我们完了！
examples.trans: Mr Zhihao, look at page one: commercial office conversion next month. We are finished!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuè dǐ. Built from 月 ('month') + 底 ('bottom'); opposite of 月初 ('start of the month').

examples.text: 而且城里要我们月底以前开咖啡馆！
examples.trans: And the city wants our café open before the end of the month!

examples.text: 房租要在月底以前付。
examples.trans: The rent has to be paid before the end of the month.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǒu. Expresses both possession ('I have') and existence ('there is'); ALWAYS negated with 没 (没有), never 不.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǒu lì. Describes firm handwriting or steady hands.

examples.text: 大门门铃响了。干脆有力的一下。
examples.trans: There goes the gate bell. One firm, decisive ring.

examples.text: 虽然八十岁了，老先生握手依然很有力。
examples.trans: Even at eighty, the old gentleman still has a firm handshake.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǒu shí hou. Placed before or after the subject.

examples.text: 啊！老水管晚上有时候会进一点空气。
examples.trans: Oh! Old water pipes sometimes get a little air bubble at night.

examples.text: 有时候院子里安静得只听见风吹树叶。
examples.trans: Sometimes the courtyard is so quiet you hear only wind in the leaves.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yóu diǎn. Placed BEFORE an adjective/feeling verb (有点冷 'a bit cold')—contrast 一点 after adjectives.

examples.text: 声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
examples.trans: Soft-spoken, very polite, around thirty-something, and a bit nervous.

examples.text: 墙上也没镜子，地上没铺地毯有点空。
examples.trans: No mirror on the wall either, and the floor feels bare without a rug.

meanings.note: Pinyin: péng you. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个朋友 ('a friend').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 今天有两位老朋友从外地来看我。
examples.trans: Two old friends are visiting me from out of town today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fú wù. Measure word (量词): 项, e.g. 一项服务 ('a service').

examples.text: 我们客栈都是五星级服务……哎呀！
examples.trans: At our inn, everything is five-star service... whoops!

examples.text: 分贝？所以九分不是给我前台服务打的分？
examples.trans: Decibels? So nine points was not a score for my front-desk service?

meanings.note: Pinyin: cháo. Describes which way a window faces or waving toward someone (朝院子 'facing the courtyard').

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块木头 ('a piece of wood').

examples.text: 有，结实的木床、干净书桌，风景全院最好。
examples.trans: Yes, a solid wooden bed, a clean desk, and the best view in the courtyard.

examples.text: 先生，到了。小心碰头，这根木房梁比较低。
examples.trans: Here we are, sir. Mind your head—this wooden beam is fairly low.

related.gloss: a piece of wood (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù jiang. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位木匠 ('a carpenter').

examples.text: 那里住着一位老木匠和两个孙子——哥哥弹钢琴，弟弟最爱小火车！
examples.trans: An old carpenter lived there with two grandsons—the older brother played piano, and the younger loved toy trains!

examples.text: 老木匠……还有箱子里的木头小火车！
examples.trans: An old carpenter... and the wooden toy train inside the bag!

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù tou. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块木头 ('a piece of wood').

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

related.gloss: a piece of wood (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù gōng. Combines 木 ('wood') + 工 ('craft/artisan'); modifies tools and materials like 木工胶水 ('woodworking glue').

examples.text: 老陈的工具箱里常备着细砂纸和木工胶水。
examples.trans: Chen's toolbox always keeps fine sandpaper and woodworking glue on hand.

examples.text: 这把结实的圆木椅是一位老木工亲手做的。
examples.trans: This sturdy wooden chair was handmade by a veteran carpenter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù gōng fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间木工房 ('a carpentry workshop').

examples.text: 这是爷爷木工房里那个旧深蓝箱子吗？
examples.trans: Is that the old dark-blue case from Grandfather's carpentry workshop?

examples.text: 爷爷以前在一楼后面的木工房做小木车。
examples.trans: Grandfather used to carve toy wooden trains in the back carpentry workshop.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù zhuō. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张木桌 ('a wooden table').

examples.text: 把小木桌放在树下面吧，离门口远一点。
examples.trans: Let's put the small wooden table right under the tree, a little farther from the doorway.

examples.text: 阳光照在擦得发亮的旧木桌上。
examples.trans: Sunlight falls across the polished old wooden table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù chuāng. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇木窗 ('a wooden window').

examples.text: 多半是粉刷街边木窗那种无聊通知吧。
examples.trans: Probably some boring notice about painting the street shutters.

examples.text: 推开二楼的木窗就能闻到桂花香。
examples.trans: Push open the second-floor wooden window and smell sweet osmanthus.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù xiāng. Combines 木 ('wood') + 箱 ('chest/box').

examples.text: 最下面的抽屉里没有的话，再找找那个旧木箱吧。
examples.trans: If it isn't in the bottom drawer, check inside that old wooden chest.

examples.text: 老陈把修钢琴的小工具整齐地收进木箱。
examples.trans: Chen packed the small piano-repair tools neatly into the wooden chest.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù huā jià. Combines 木 ('wooden') + 花 ('flower/vine') + 架 ('frame/trellis').

examples.text: 我们轻轻把绿藤条抬到旁边的木花架上。
examples.trans: We gently lifted the green vine onto the wooden trellis beside it.

examples.text: 院子角落的木花架上爬满了常春藤。
examples.trans: The wooden trellis in the corner of the courtyard is covered in climbing ivy.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù mén. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇木门 ('a wooden door').

examples.text: 再往左拐进小广场，找一扇蓝木门。
examples.trans: Then turn left into the small square and look for a blue wooden door.

examples.text: 正往前走……啊，看见金钥匙招牌和蓝木门了！
examples.trans: Walking forward now... oh, I see the golden key sign and the blue wooden door!

本.gloss: measure word for books and notebooks

meanings.en: measure word for books and notebooks
meanings.note: Pinyin: běn. Counts bound volumes, notebooks, ledgers, and albums (一本书, 一本账本).

examples.text: 等等——柜台上这本棕色小皮笔记本是谁的？
examples.trans: Wait—whose small brown leather notebook is this on the counter?

examples.text: 书桌上放着两本旧乐谱。
examples.trans: Two old music books sit on the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: běn dì. Modifies nouns directly or with 的 (本地蜂蜜 'local honey', 本地人 'locals').

examples.text: 集市上卖的全是本地果园早上摘的水果。
examples.trans: Everything sold at the market is fruit picked this morning from local orchards.

examples.text: 本地人最喜欢去转角那家小店喝早茶。
examples.trans: Locals love going to that little shop on the corner for morning tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: běn zi. Measure word (量词): 本 (běn), e.g. 一本本子 ('a notebook').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: běn lái. Indicates what was originally planned or true.

examples.text: 等等——您本来打算把箱子交给店员，自己躲在街对面看？！
examples.trans: Wait—you originally planned to leave the bag with the clerk and hide across the street watching?!

examples.text: 电线本来就该拉直了。正常保养，别多想。
examples.trans: The wire needed straightening anyway. Routine maintenance—don't read into it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jī yóu. Combines 机 ('machinery/mechanism') + 油 ('oil').

examples.text: 往生锈的合页轴上滴两滴机油，窗板就容易打开了。
examples.trans: Put two drops of lubricating oil on the rusty hinge pin and the shutter opens easily.

examples.text: 老陈随身带着一小瓶机油，专门对付发紧的旧门锁。
examples.trans: Chen carries a small bottle of machine oil specifically for stiff old locks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xìng rén. Combines 杏 ('apricot/almond') + 仁 ('nut kernel').

examples.text: 小美端来了一盘刚出炉的温热杏仁饼干。
examples.trans: Mei brought over a plate of warm almond biscuits fresh from the oven.

examples.text: 用杏仁粉做的柠檬挞底吃起来特别香酥。
examples.trans: A lemon tart crust made with ground almonds tastes wonderfully crisp and nutty.

条.gloss: measure word for streets, rivers, towels, clauses

meanings.en: measure word for streets, rivers, towels, clauses
meanings.note: Pinyin: tiáo. Counts long, narrow, or winding things: streets, rivers, scarves, towels, trousers, and legal clauses (一条街).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiáo lì. Measure word (量词): 部, e.g. 一部条例 ('a municipal regulation').

examples.text: 成都老城区保护条例第十四条——窗外我哥哥刚点头了！
examples.trans: Clause fourteen of the Chengdu Old Quarter Act—and my brother outside just nodded!

examples.text: 根据城市历史街区条例，老砖墙必须保留。
examples.trans: Under the historic district regulation, the old brick wall must stay.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiáo wén. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条条文 ('a legal clause').

examples.text: 法律条文我戴两副眼镜看都头疼！
examples.trans: Legal clauses give me a headache even with two pairs of glasses!

examples.text: 律师把合同里的每一条条文都读了一遍。
examples.trans: The lawyer read through every single clause in the contract.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lái. Movement toward the speaker, as main verb or directional complement (进来 'come in').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

meanings.en: not have enough time; be too late
meanings.note: Pinyin: lái bu jí. Opposite of 来得及 ('make it in time').

examples.text: 来不及了！他说了声谢谢就挂断了！
examples.trans: Too late! He said thank you and hung up!

examples.text: 再不出发就来不及赶八点的火车了！
examples.trans: If we do not head out now, we will never make the eight o'clock train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lái xìn. Measure word (量词): 封 (fēng), e.g. 一封来信 ('a letter received').

examples.text: 太好了……趁着等他们，我扫一眼这封房东来信。
examples.trans: Wonderful... while we wait, let me glance at this letter from the landlord.

examples.text: 啊！忙着行李箱、热水器和来信，我完全忘了！
examples.trans: Oh! With the suitcases, the water heater, and the letter, I completely forgot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lái huí. Describes pacing back and forth or a round trip.

examples.text: 十分钟之内你能跑个来回吗？
examples.trans: Can you run there and back within ten minutes?

examples.text: 从客栈到五金店走一个来回只要十分钟。
examples.trans: A round trip on foot from the inn to the hardware shop takes ten minutes.

杯.gloss: measure word for cups and glasses

meanings.en: measure word for cups and glasses
meanings.note: Pinyin: bēi. Counts cups of tea, coffee, water, or juice (一杯热茶 'a cup of hot tea').

examples.text: 太客气了，周经理。半杯就好。
examples.trans: How polite of you, Manager Zhou. Half a glass is fine.

examples.text: 坐下吧，小晴！早上你跑了半条街，喝杯咖啡。
examples.trans: Sit down, Qing! You ran half the street this morning—drink a cup of coffee.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bēi zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个杯子 ('a cup').

examples.text: 每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
examples.trans: Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.

examples.text: 请往我的杯子里再加一点热水。
examples.trans: Please add a little more hot water to my cup.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sōng. Describes a loose screw/handle or relaxing tension (松一口气 'breathe a sigh of relief').

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

examples.text: 太松一口气了！志豪先生，给您银钥匙。
examples.trans: What a relief! Mr Zhihao, here is your silver key.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jí le. Follows directly after an adjective to boost it to the max (棒极了！ 'amazing!', 热极了 'super hot!').

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 这是我这个月睡得最香的一晚，洗澡水也热极了！
examples.trans: Best sleep I have had all month, and the shower water was wonderfully hot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěn tou. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个枕头 ('a pillow').

examples.text: 储藏室里有两个软枕头和一块蓝地毯！
examples.trans: In the storeroom there are two soft pillows and a blue rug!

examples.text: 小晴，把床单角塞紧！放上两个软枕头。
examples.trans: Qing, tuck the sheet corner tight! On go the two soft pillows.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guǒ jiàng. Measure word (量词): 瓶 (píng), e.g. 一瓶果酱 ('a jar of jam').

examples.text: 那是海盐咸黄油！甜果酱面包卷要无盐黄油！
examples.trans: That is sea-salt butter! Sweet jam rolls need unsalted butter!

examples.text: 咸黄油能配甜草莓果酱吗？
examples.trans: Can salted butter go with sweet strawberry jam?

related.gloss: a jar of jam (measure word 瓶)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhī tiáo. Combines 枝 ('branch') + 条 ('slender twig/strip').

examples.text: 请把常春藤的绿枝条轻轻挂到花架上。
examples.trans: Please drape the green branch of ivy gently onto the trellis.

examples.text: 春风一吹，柳树的细枝条在院墙外轻轻摇晃。
examples.trans: When the spring breeze blows, slender willow branches sway gently outside the courtyard wall.

架.gloss: measure word for pianos, planes, framed machines

meanings.en: measure word for pianos, planes, framed machines
meanings.note: Pinyin: jià. Counts pianos, airplanes, and framed instruments (一架钢琴 'a piano').

examples.text: 三年前爷爷去世以后，我和志鹏因为卖老房子大吵了一架。
examples.trans: Three years ago after Grandfather passed away, Zhipeng and I argued bitterly over selling the old house.

examples.text: 客厅角落里放着一架老钢琴。
examples.trans: An old piano stands in the corner of the living room.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jià zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个架子 ('a shelf').

examples.text: 最上面架子上金色包装那包。怎么了？
examples.trans: The gold-wrapped packet on the top shelf. Why?

examples.text: 他拿旧阀门比对了——架子上正好还剩两个！
examples.trans: He matched it against the old valve—he has two left on the shelf!

meanings.note: Pinyin: róu huà. Describes wooden beams or curtains softening echoes.

examples.text: 因为湿木头百叶窗会柔化石板路传回来的回声……
examples.trans: Because wet wooden shutters soften the echo bouncing off the flagstones...

examples.text: 厚实的棉窗帘柔化了早晨刺眼的阳光。
examples.trans: Thick cotton curtains softened the bright morning sun.

meanings.note: Pinyin: róu hé. Describes soothing light, warm colours, or gentle acoustic tones.

examples.text: 磨砂玻璃让顶灯的光线变得非常柔和。
examples.trans: Frosted glass makes the light from the ceiling lamp wonderfully soft.

examples.text: 傍晚柔和的阳光照在院子的石桌子上。
examples.trans: Soft late-afternoon sunlight falls across the stone table in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guì tái. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个柜台 ('a counter').

examples.text: 等等——柜台上这本棕色小皮笔记本是谁的？
examples.trans: Wait—whose small brown leather notebook is this on the counter?

examples.text: 昨晚您的本子在柜台翻开了，我们看到九分……
examples.trans: Last night your notebook fell open on the counter, and we saw nine points...

meanings.note: Pinyin: guì zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个柜子 ('a cabinet').

examples.text: 先生，箱子安全锁在柜子里。请问您贵姓？
examples.trans: Sir, the bag is locked safely in our closet. May I ask your surname?

examples.text: 我去柜子拿干净的白床单！
examples.trans: I will fetch clean white bedsheets from the cupboard!

meanings.note: Pinyin: níng méng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个柠檬 ('a lemon').

examples.text: 他爷爷会切热柠檬蛋糕，上面撒一层白糖粉！
examples.trans: His grandfather sliced warm lemon cake with a dusting of powdered sugar on top!

examples.text: 啊！黄色柠檬糖霜——每个星期五我们俩都抢边角那一块！
examples.trans: Oh! Yellow lemon glaze—every single Friday the two of us fought over the corner piece!

meanings.note: Pinyin: níng méng tǎ. Compound 柠檬 ('lemon') + 塔 ('tart', phonetic loan). Measure word: 个 (gè) or 块 (kuài).

examples.text: 小美用新鲜黄柠檬烤了一盘香喷喷的柠檬塔。
examples.trans: Mei baked a fragrant tray of lemon tarts with fresh yellow lemons.
